```ts
import { Inject, Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { canTransition, type OrderStatus } from '@sanchay/domain';
import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { DB, type DbExecutor, type DbHandle } from '../../db/client.js';
import { marketHolidays, schemes, sebiCategories } from '../catalogue/catalogue.schema.js';
import { Notify } from '../notifications/notify.service.js';
import type { FpRedemptionView } from '../orders/fp-redemption.js';
import { moveOrder } from '../orders/order-transitions.js';
import { ORDER_AUDIT_ACTIONS, orders } from '../orders/orders.schema.js';
import { AuditService } from '../platform/audit.service.js';
import { CLOCK, type Clock } from '../platform/clock.js';
import { ReconBreaks } from '../platform/runtime-config.js';
import { Ledger } from './ledger.service.js';
import { payoutSchedule } from './payout.js';
import { type ExitParse, parseExit } from './redemption-exit.js';
import { releaseReservation, settleReservation } from './reservations.js';

const SETTLEABLE: readonly OrderStatus[] = ['PROCESSING', 'UNITS_PENDING'];

function triggerFor(from: OrderStatus, to: OrderStatus): string | null {
  switch (to) {
    case 'SETTLED':
      return from === 'UNITS_PENDING' ? 'units_reconciled' : 'fp_successful_with_units';
    case 'UNITS_PENDING':
      return 'fp_successful_units_null';
    case 'FAILED':
      return 'fp_failed';
    case 'EXPIRED':
      return 'fp_expired';
    default:
      return null;
  }
}

function targetOf(state: string, parsed: ExitParse): OrderStatus | null {
  switch (state) {
    case 'successful':
      return parsed.kind === 'COMPLETE' ? 'SETTLED' : 'UNITS_PENDING';
    case 'failed':
    case 'cancelled':
      return 'FAILED';
    case 'expired':
      return 'EXPIRED';
    default:
      return null;
  }
}

async function holidaysOf(exec: DbExecutor) {
  const rows = await exec.select({ date: marketHolidays.holidayDate }).from(marketHolidays);
  const dates = new Set(rows.map((r) => r.date));
  return { has: (isoDate: string) => dates.has(isoDate) };
}

/**
 * Applies a re-fetched FP redemption to an order FP has submitted (PROCESSING or UNITS_PENDING), in one
 * transaction with the order row locked (spec §4.4):
 * - `successful` with units → SETTLED: `Ledger.applyExit` with FP's units (rounded HALF_UP to 3 dp, FP's
 *   figure kept in `redeemed_units_reported`), proceeds, NAV and NAV date, the reservation SETTLED, payout
 *   EXPECTED with its D-MONEY-053 dates, the REDEMPTION_PROCESSED email, audit;
 * - `successful` without units → UNITS_PENDING (an invalid report also opens a CRITICAL break);
 * - `failed`/`cancelled`/`expired` → FAILED/EXPIRED with the reservation RELEASED on that evidence;
 * - `reversed` after SETTLED → a CRITICAL break only (a reversed exit needs ops to restore the lots).
 * Idempotent, so the `mf_redemption` handler, the advance job and `orders.units.reconcile` all call it.
 * The caller re-fetches first; nothing in here calls a provider.
 */
@Injectable()
export class RedemptionSettlement {
  constructor(
    @Inject(DB) private readonly dbh: DbHandle,
    @Inject(Ledger) private readonly ledger: Ledger,
    @Inject(Notify) private readonly notify: Notify,
    @Inject(AuditService) private readonly audit: AuditService,
    @Inject(CLOCK) private readonly clock: Clock,
  ) {}

  async apply(orderId: string, redemption: FpRedemptionView): Promise<OrderStatus | null> {
    const now = this.clock.now();
    return this.dbh.db.transaction(async (tx) => {
      const [order] = await tx.select().from(orders).where(eq(orders.id, orderId)).for('update');
      if (order === undefined || order.type !== 'REDEMPTION') return null;
      if (order.status === 'SETTLED' && redemption.state === 'reversed') {
        await ReconBreaks.open(tx, {
          kind: 'REDEMPTION_REVERSED',
          entityType: 'orders',
          entityId: order.id,
          severity: 'CRITICAL',
          detail: { fpOrderId: redemption.id },
        });
        return null;
      }
      if (!SETTLEABLE.includes(order.status)) return null;
      const parsed: ExitParse =
        redemption.state === 'successful' ? parseExit(redemption) : { kind: 'INCOMPLETE' };
      const to = targetOf(redemption.state, parsed);
      if (to === null || to === order.status) {
        if (parsed.kind === 'INVALID') await this.invalidExit(tx, order.id, parsed.reason);
        return null;
      }
      const trigger = triggerFor(order.status, to);
      if (trigger === null || !canTransition('ORDER', order.status, to, trigger)) {
        await ReconBreaks.open(tx, {
          kind: 'FP_ORDER_STATE_UNEXPECTED',
          entityType: 'orders',
          entityId: order.id,
          severity: 'WARNING',
          detail: { status: order.status, fpState: redemption.state },
        });
        return null;
      }
      const fp = { fpState: redemption.state, failureCode: redemption.failureCode };

      if (parsed.kind === 'COMPLETE') {
        const exit = parsed.exit;
        const [scheme] = await tx
          .select({
            name: schemes.name,
            assetClass: sebiCategories.assetClass,
            cutoffClass: sebiCategories.cutoffClass,
          })
          .from(schemes)
          .innerJoin(sebiCategories, eq(sebiCategories.code, schemes.categoryCode))
          .where(eq(schemes.id, order.schemeId));
        if (scheme === undefined) throw new Error(`redemption ${order.id}: scheme not found`);
        const payout = payoutSchedule({
          assetClass: scheme.assetClass,
          cutoffClass: scheme.cutoffClass,
          tradeDate: exit.tradeDate,
          holidays: await holidaysOf(tx),
        });
        await moveOrder(tx, order, 'SETTLED', trigger, {
          ...fp,
          redeemedUnits: exit.units.toWire(),
          redeemedUnitsReported: exit.reportedUnits,
          redeemedAmount: exit.amount?.toWire() ?? null,
          redeemedNav: exit.nav?.toWire() ?? null,
          redeemedNavDate: exit.navDate,
          unitsSource: 'PROVIDER',
          payoutStatus: 'EXPECTED',
          payoutExpectedOn: payout.expectedOn,
          payoutDueBy: payout.dueBy,
          payoutUpdatedAt: now,
          finalAt: now,
        });
        await this.ledger.applyExit(
          tx,
          { ...order, status: 'SETTLED' },
          {
            units: exit.units.toWire(),
            amount: exit.amount?.toWire() ?? null,
            nav: exit.nav?.toWire() ?? null,
            navDate: exit.navDate,
          },
        );
        await settleReservation(tx, order.id);
        await this.notify.enqueue(tx, 'REDEMPTION_PROCESSED', {
          investorId: order.investorId,
          data: { units: exit.units.toWire(), schemeName: scheme.name },
          dedupeKey: `redemption-processed:${order.id}`,
        });
        await this.audit.record(tx, {
          action: ORDER_AUDIT_ACTIONS.ORDER_SETTLED,
          actorType: 'SYSTEM',
          entityType: 'orders',
          entityId: order.id,
        });
        await this.audit.record(tx, {
          action: ORDER_AUDIT_ACTIONS.REDEMPTION_PAYOUT_EXPECTED,
          actorType: 'SYSTEM',
          entityType: 'orders',
          entityId: order.id,
          data: { status: 'EXPECTED' },
        });
        return 'SETTLED';
      }
      if (to === 'UNITS_PENDING') {
        await moveOrder(tx, order, 'UNITS_PENDING', trigger, { ...fp, unitsPendingSince: now });
        if (parsed.kind === 'INVALID') await this.invalidExit(tx, order.id, parsed.reason);
        return 'UNITS_PENDING';
      }
      await moveOrder(tx, order, to, trigger, { ...fp, finalAt: now });
      await releaseReservation(tx, this.audit, {
        orderId: order.id,
        evidence: `fp_${redemption.state}:${redemption.id}`,
        now,
      });
      await this.audit.record(tx, {
        action: ORDER_AUDIT_ACTIONS.ORDER_FAILED,
        actorType: 'SYSTEM',
        entityType: 'orders',
        entityId: order.id,
        data: { status: to },
      });
      return to;
    });
  }

  /** FP reported an exit the ledger cannot hold exactly (beyond the 3-dp units rounding): ops resolves it. */
  private async invalidExit(tx: DbExecutor, orderId: string, reason: string): Promise<void> {
    await ReconBreaks.open(tx, {
      kind: 'REDEMPTION_EXIT_INVALID',
      entityType: 'orders',
      entityId: orderId,
      severity: 'CRITICAL',
      detail: { reason },
    });
  }
}
```

`apps/api/src/modules/orders/redemption-destinations.ts`:
```ts
/** A folio's FP-registered contacts as F4's folio.sync stored them (HMAC blind indexes). */
export interface FolioContacts {
  readonly registeredMobileBidx: readonly Buffer[];
  readonly registeredEmailBidx: readonly Buffer[];
  /** Null until folio.sync has read FP's folio record: the contacts are then unknown, not absent. */
  readonly contactsSyncedAt: Date | null;
}

/** Blind indexes of the investor's verified mobile and email (email null when none is verified). */
export interface InvestorContactIndexes {
  readonly mobileBidx: Buffer;
  readonly emailBidx: Buffer | null;
}

/**
 * Where a redemption's consent may go (H-21; a REDEMPTION needs SMS and email):
 * - FOLIO_REGISTERED: the investor's mobile and email are both among the folio's registered contacts;
 * - FOLIO_DEFAULTS: FP lists the folio with no registered contacts at all, and then takes the consent on
 *   the account's `folio_defaults` contacts (probe P-09, 2026-10-01). E11 set those from the investor's
 *   CURRENT verified mobile and email, so in the MVP they are the investor's own contacts (H-21);
 * - UNAVAILABLE: anything else, including contacts folio.sync has never read (CONSENT_DESTINATION_UNAVAILABLE).
 */
export type FolioConsentDestinations = 'FOLIO_REGISTERED' | 'FOLIO_DEFAULTS' | 'UNAVAILABLE';

export function folioConsentDestinations(
  folio: FolioContacts,
  investor: InvestorContactIndexes,
): FolioConsentDestinations {
  const email = investor.emailBidx;
  if (folio.contactsSyncedAt === null || email === null) return 'UNAVAILABLE';
  if (folio.registeredMobileBidx.length === 0 && folio.registeredEmailBidx.length === 0) {
    return 'FOLIO_DEFAULTS';
  }
  const mobileOk = folio.registeredMobileBidx.some((b) => b.equals(investor.mobileBidx));
  const emailOk = folio.registeredEmailBidx.some((b) => b.equals(email));
  return mobileOk && emailOk ? 'FOLIO_REGISTERED' : 'UNAVAILABLE';
}

} from '@sanchay/domain';
import { type Money, Nav, Units } from '@sanchay/money';
import { and, eq, ne, type SQL, sql } from 'drizzle-orm';
import type { DbExecutor } from '../../db/client.js';
import { marketHolidays, schemes, sebiCategories } from '../catalogue/catalogue.schema.js';
import { NavService } from '../catalogue/nav/nav.service.js';
import { consentChallenges } from '../legal-consent/legal-consent.schema.js';
import type { Clock } from '../platform/clock.js';
import { AppError } from '../platform/errors.js';
import type { FolioHoldingsSnapshot, folios } from '../portfolio/folios.schema.js';
import { lots, redemptionReservations } from '../portfolio/portfolio.schema.js';
import { orders } from './orders.schema.js';

export type FolioRow = typeof folios.$inferSelect;
type RedemptionCutoffClass = RedemptionNavDateInput['cutoffClass'];

/** R-09: the quote and the draft use the worker's FP holdings snapshot only while it is this fresh. */
export const SNAPSHOT_MAX_AGE_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

export interface SchemeFacts {
  id: string;
  isin: string;
  name: string;
  amcId: string;
  redemptionAllowed: boolean;
  assetClass: AssetClass;
  cutoffClass: CutoffClass;
  volatilityClass: VolatilityClass;
}

export async function loadScheme(exec: DbExecutor, isin: string): Promise<SchemeFacts | undefined> {
  const [row] = await exec
    .select({
      id: schemes.id,
      isin: schemes.isin,
      name: schemes.name,
      amcId: schemes.amcId,
      redemptionAllowed: schemes.redemptionAllowed,
      assetClass: sebiCategories.assetClass,
      cutoffClass: sebiCategories.cutoffClass,
      volatilityClass: sebiCategories.volatilityClass,
    })
    .from(schemes)
    .innerJoin(sebiCategories, eq(sebiCategories.code, schemes.categoryCode))
    .where(eq(schemes.isin, isin));
  return row;
}

/** `market_holidays` as E22's CutoffHolidays (every kind counts as a non-business day). */
export async function loadHolidays(exec: DbExecutor): Promise<CutoffHolidays> {
  const rows = await exec.select({ date: marketHolidays.holidayDate }).from(marketHolidays);
  const dates = new Set(rows.map((r) => r.date));
  return { has: (isoDate: string) => dates.has(isoDate) };
}

export function isSnapshotFresh(folio: FolioRow, now: Date): boolean {
  return (
    folio.fpHoldingsSyncedAt !== null &&
    now.getTime() - folio.fpHoldingsSyncedAt.getTime() <= SNAPSHOT_MAX_AGE_MS
  );
}

/**
 * FP's redeemable units for one scheme of a holdings snapshot. Null when FP's feed has no row for the
 * folio (FEED_UNAVAILABLE: F4 then stores an empty snapshot); a folio row without the scheme is 0.
 */
export function redeemableIn(
  snapshot: FolioHoldingsSnapshot | null,
  reconciliation: FolioReconciliation,
  isin: string,
): Units | null {
  if (snapshot === null || reconciliation === 'FEED_UNAVAILABLE') return null;
  const entry = snapshot.schemes.find((s) => s.isin === isin);
  return Units.platform(entry?.redeemableUnits ?? '0.000');
}

/**
 * A CONSENT_PENDING draft whose challenge can no longer be approved (expired, cancelled, superseded):
 * its reservation no longer counts, and the next draft on the folio-scheme cancels it.
 */
export function staleDraft(now: Date): SQL {
  return sql`(${orders.status} = 'CONSENT_PENDING' AND coalesce(${consentChallenges.status} IN ('EXPIRED', 'CANCELLED', 'SUPERSEDED') OR (${consentChallenges.status} = 'PENDING' AND ${consentChallenges.expiresAt} <= ${now}), false))`;
}

/** Σ units of the folio-scheme's live ACTIVE reservations, optionally without one order's own. */
export async function reservedUnits(
  exec: DbExecutor,
  input: { folioId: string; schemeId: string; now: Date; excludeOrderId: string | null },
): Promise<Units> {
  const [row] = await exec
    .select({
      units: sql<string>`coalesce(sum(${redemptionReservations.unitsReserved}), 0)::numeric(20,3)::text`,
    })
    .from(redemptionReservations)
    .innerJoin(orders, eq(orders.id, redemptionReservations.orderId))
    .leftJoin(consentChallenges, eq(consentChallenges.id, orders.consentChallengeId))
    .where(
      and(
        eq(redemptionReservations.folioId, input.folioId),
        eq(redemptionReservations.schemeId, input.schemeId),
        eq(redemptionReservations.status, 'ACTIVE'),
        input.excludeOrderId === null
          ? undefined
          : ne(redemptionReservations.orderId, input.excludeOrderId),
        sql`NOT ${staleDraft(input.now)}`,
      ),
    );
  return Units.platform(row?.units ?? '0.000');
}

function redemptionCutoffClass(cutoffClass: CutoffClass): RedemptionCutoffClass {
  // The reserved INTERNATIONAL class has no MVP scheme and no redemption cut-off rule yet.
  if (cutoffClass === 'INTERNATIONAL') throw new AppError('SCHEME_NOT_ORDERABLE');
  return cutoffClass;
}

export interface RedemptionEvaluation {
  availability: RedemptionAvailability;
  /** 4-dp fraction, rounded up (part 1). */
  buffer: string;
  nav: Nav;
  navDate: IsoDate;
  navGrade: NavGrade;
  exitNavDate: IsoDate;
  displayCutoff: string;
}

/**
 * Design §F.6 for one folio-scheme, from the DB and the given FP redeemable units (the snapshot at quote
 * and draft, the live holdings report in the submit job). Reads only; never calls a provider.
 */
export async function evaluateRedemption(
  exec: DbExecutor,
  clock: Clock,
  input: {
    folio: FolioRow;
    scheme: SchemeFacts;
    providerRedeemableUnits: Units | null;
    reconciliation: FolioReconciliation;
    excludeOrderId: string | null;
  },
): Promise<RedemptionEvaluation> {
  const now = clock.now();
  const latest = await new NavService(clock).latest(exec, toIsin(input.scheme.isin));
  if (latest === null) throw new AppError('NAV_UNAVAILABLE');
  const holidays = await loadHolidays(exec);
  const { navDate: exitNavDate, displayCutoff } = expectedRedemptionNavDate({
    cutoffClass: redemptionCutoffClass(input.scheme.cutoffClass),
    at: now,
    holidays,
  });
  const navDate = toIsoDate(latest.navDate);
  const { buffer } = redemptionBuffer({
    volatilityClass: input.scheme.volatilityClass,
    latestNavDate: navDate,
    exitNavDate,
    holidays,
  });
  const open = await exec
    .select({ id: lots.id, unitsRemaining: lots.unitsRemaining, lockInUntil: lots.lockInUntil })
    .from(lots)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(lots.folioId, input.folio.id),
        eq(lots.schemeId, input.scheme.id),
        eq(lots.status, 'OPEN'),
      ),
    );
  const nav = Nav.parse(latest.nav);
  const availability = redemptionAvailability({
    lots: open.map((lot) => ({
      id: lot.id,
      unitsRemaining: Units.platform(lot.unitsRemaining),
      lockInUntil: lot.lockInUntil === null ? null : toIsoDate(lot.lockInUntil),
    })),
    reservedUnits: await reservedUnits(exec, {
      folioId: input.folio.id,
      schemeId: input.scheme.id,
      now,
      excludeOrderId: input.excludeOrderId,
    }),
    exitNavDate,
    providerRedeemableUnits: input.providerRedeemableUnits,
    reconciliation: input.reconciliation,
    lastReconciledAt: input.folio.lastReconciledAt,
    now,
    nav,
    navGrade: latest.grade,
    buffer,
  });
  return { availability, buffer, nav, navDate, navGrade: latest.grade, exitNavDate, displayCutoff };
}

/** What a draft sends to FP and reserves: an amount (AMOUNT, or ALL with a residual), or FULL. */
export type RedemptionPlan =
  | { kind: 'AMOUNT'; amount: Money; units: Units }
  | { kind: 'FULL'; units: Units };

/** D-MONEY-051 at draft: AMOUNT within the buffered maximum; ALL as decided by part 1's rule. */
export function planRedemption(
  mode: 'AMOUNT' | 'ALL',
  amount: Money | null,
  evaluation: RedemptionEvaluation,
): RedemptionPlan {
  if (mode === 'AMOUNT') {
    if (amount === null) {
      throw new AppError('VALIDATION_FAILED', {
        fields: [{ path: 'amount', code: 'REQUIRED', message: 'Enter an amount' }],
      });
    }
    const refusal = checkRedemptionAmount(amount, evaluation.availability);
    if (refusal !== null) throw new AppError(refusal);
    return {
      kind: 'AMOUNT',
      amount,
      units: reservationUnits(amount, evaluation.nav, evaluation.buffer),
    };
  }
  const all = evaluation.availability.all;
  switch (all.kind) {
    case 'REFUSED':
      throw new AppError(all.code);
    case 'FULL':
      return { kind: 'FULL', units: all.units };
    case 'AMOUNT_WITH_RESIDUAL':
      return {
        kind: 'AMOUNT',
        amount: all.amount,
        units: reservationUnits(all.amount, evaluation.nav, evaluation.buffer),
      };
  }
}

/**
 * R-09 live re-check in the submit job, against the order as drafted: a FULL order still needs ALL to be
 * FULL; an amount (AMOUNT, or ALL's residual amount) must still fit under the buffered maximum.
 */
export function liveRefusal(
  orderAmount: Money | null,
  evaluation: RedemptionEvaluation,
): RedemptionRefusal | null {
  if (orderAmount === null) {
    const all = evaluation.availability.all;
    if (all.kind === 'FULL') return null;
    return all.kind === 'REFUSED' ? all.code : 'FOLIO_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED';
  }
  return checkRedemptionAmount(orderAmount, evaluation.availability);
}

`apps/api/src/modules/orders/redemption-snapshot.ts`:
```ts
import { type ConsentSnapshotV2, SNAPSHOT_VERSION } from '@sanchay/domain';
import { and, desc, eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { schemes } from '../catalogue/catalogue.schema.js';
import { legalDocuments } from '../legal-consent/legal-consent.schema.js';
import type { SnapshotBuilder } from '../legal-consent/snapshot-builders.js';
import { AppError } from '../platform/errors.js';
import { folios } from '../portfolio/folios.schema.js';
import { redemptionReservations } from '../portfolio/portfolio.schema.js';
import { orders } from './orders.schema.js';

/**
 * SNAPSHOT_BUILDERS.REDEMPTION. Deterministic: every fact comes from the order, its reservation, the
 * scheme, the folio and the published TPL_REDEMPTION, never from `ctx.fields`, so `approve` (which
 * passes the stored snapshot's fields) recomputes it from the DB and a changed subject (a released
 * reservation, an edited amount) is a CONSENT_MISMATCH. Inside approve's transaction the reservation row
 * is locked first: that is the "approve re-checks under FOR UPDATE" step of spec §4.4. The lock is its own
 * single-table query because Drizzle 0.45 renders `.for('update', { of: redemptionReservations })` as
 * `FOR UPDATE OF "app"."redemption_reservations"`, which PostgreSQL refuses ("FOR UPDATE must specify
 * unqualified relation names").
 */
export const redemptionSnapshotBuilder: SnapshotBuilder = async (
  exec,
  ctx,
): Promise<ConsentSnapshotV2> => {
  const subject = ctx.subjects[0];
  if (subject === undefined || subject.table !== 'orders' || ctx.subjects.length !== 1) {
    throw new AppError('INTERNAL', { message: 'a REDEMPTION consent covers exactly one order' });
  }
  await exec
    .select({ id: redemptionReservations.id })
    .from(redemptionReservations)
    .where(eq(redemptionReservations.orderId, subject.id))
    .for('update');
  const [row] = await exec
    .select({
      orderId: orders.id,
      investorId: orders.investorId,
      type: orders.type,
      mode: orders.mode,
      amount: orders.amount,
      isin: schemes.isin,
      schemeName: schemes.name,
      folioNumber: folios.folioNumber,
      payoutBank: folios.payoutBankMasked,
      unitsReserved: redemptionReservations.unitsReserved,
      reservationStatus: redemptionReservations.status,
    })
    .from(orders)
    .innerJoin(schemes, eq(schemes.id, orders.schemeId))
    .innerJoin(folios, eq(folios.id, orders.folioId))
    .innerJoin(redemptionReservations, eq(redemptionReservations.orderId, orders.id))
    .where(eq(orders.id, subject.id));
  if (row === undefined || row.type !== 'REDEMPTION' || row.investorId !== ctx.investorId) {
    throw new AppError('NOT_FOUND');
  }
  const [template] = await exec
    .select({ version: legalDocuments.version, sha256: legalDocuments.sha256 })
    .from(legalDocuments)
    .where(and(eq(legalDocuments.key, 'TPL_REDEMPTION'), eq(legalDocuments.status, 'PUBLISHED')))
    .orderBy(desc(legalDocuments.effectiveFrom))
    .limit(1);
  const bank = row.payoutBank;
  return {
    version: SNAPSHOT_VERSION,
    subjectType: 'REDEMPTION',
    investorId: ctx.investorId,
    subjects: [{ table: 'orders', subjectId: row.orderId }],
    legalDocuments:
      template === undefined
        ? []
        : [
            {
              key: 'TPL_REDEMPTION',
              version: template.version,
              sha256: template.sha256.toString('hex'),
            },
          ],
    moneyParamsVersion: ctx.moneyParamsVersion,
    destinationsMasked: [...ctx.destinationsMasked].sort(),
    fields: {
      action: 'redeem',
      mode: row.mode,
      amount: row.amount ?? 'ALL',
      unitsReserved: row.unitsReserved,
      reservationStatus: row.reservationStatus,
      schemeIsin: row.isin,
      schemeShort: row.schemeName.slice(0, 30),
      folioNumber: row.folioNumber ?? '',
      // D-MONEY-054: the payout goes to the folio-registered bank, never Sanchay's primary account.
      payoutBank: bank === null ? 'UNKNOWN' : `${bank.ifsc ?? ''} ••${bank.last4 ?? ''}`,
      executionOnly: 'true',
    },
  };
};

```ts
import { Inject, Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import type { FolioReconciliation, RedeemAllDecision } from '@sanchay/domain';
import { Money } from '@sanchay/money';
import { and, eq, sql } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { AppConfig } from '../../config/app-config.js';
import { DB, type DbExecutor, type DbHandle } from '../../db/client.js';
import { investors } from '../identity/identity.schema.js';
import { InvestorAccounts } from '../identity/investor-accounts.service.js';
import { ConsentEngine } from '../legal-consent/consent-engine.js';
import { consentChallenges } from '../legal-consent/legal-consent.schema.js';
import { bankAccounts } from '../onboarding/bank.schema.js';
import { AuditService } from '../platform/audit.service.js';
import { CLOCK, type Clock } from '../platform/clock.js';
import { Crypto } from '../platform/crypto.js';
import { AppError } from '../platform/errors.js';
import { newId } from '../platform/ids.js';
import { Jobs } from '../platform/jobs/jobs.service.js';
import { ReconBreaks, RuntimeConfig } from '../platform/runtime-config.js';
import {
  type FolioHoldingsSnapshot,
  folios,
  type PayoutBankMasked,
} from '../portfolio/folios.schema.js';
import { redemptionReservations } from '../portfolio/portfolio.schema.js';
import { releaseReservation } from '../portfolio/reservations.js';
import { moveOrder } from './order-transitions.js';
import { type InitiatedVia, ORDER_AUDIT_ACTIONS, orderEvents, orders } from './orders.schema.js';
import { folioConsentDestinations } from './redemption-destinations.js';
import {
  evaluateRedemption,
  type FolioRow,
  isSnapshotFresh,
  loadScheme,
  planRedemption,
  type RedemptionEvaluation,
  redeemableIn,
  type SchemeFacts,
  staleDraft,
} from './redemption-evaluation.js';

export type RedemptionMode = 'AMOUNT' | 'ALL';

export interface RedemptionTargetInput {
  folioId: string;
  isin: string;
}

export interface CreateRedemptionInput extends RedemptionTargetInput {
  investorId: string;
  mode: RedemptionMode;
  amount?: string;
  userIp: string;
  initiatedVia: InitiatedVia;
}

export interface RedemptionCreated {
  orderId: string;
  challengeId: string;
  expiresAt: string;
  mode: RedemptionMode;
  amount: string | null;
  unitsReserved: string;
}

export type RedemptionQuote =
  | { status: 'REFRESHING'; folioId: string; isin: string }
  | {
      status: 'READY';
      folioId: string;
      isin: string;
      schemeName: string;
      heldUnits: string;
      lockedUnits: string;
      unlockedUnits: string;
      reservedUnits: string;
      availableUnits: string;
      providerShort: boolean;
      reconciliation: FolioReconciliation;
      nav: string;
      navDate: string;
      navGrade: 'OK' | 'STALE' | 'UNAVAILABLE';
      buffer: string;
      exitNavDate: string;
      displayCutoff: string;
      maxAmount: string | null;
      all:
        | { kind: 'FULL'; units: string }
        | { kind: 'AMOUNT_WITH_RESIDUAL'; amount: string }
        | { kind: 'REFUSED'; code: Extract<RedeemAllDecision, { kind: 'REFUSED' }>['code'] };
      payoutBank: PayoutBankMasked | null;
      snapshotAsOf: string;
    };

interface Target {
  folio: FolioRow;
  scheme: SchemeFacts;
}

function wireAll(all: RedeemAllDecision): Extract<RedemptionQuote, { status: 'READY' }>['all'] {
  switch (all.kind) {
    case 'FULL':
      return { kind: 'FULL', units: all.units.toWire() };
    case 'AMOUNT_WITH_RESIDUAL':
      return { kind: 'AMOUNT_WITH_RESIDUAL', amount: all.amount.toWire() };
    case 'REFUSED':
      return { kind: 'REFUSED', code: all.code };
  }
}

/**
 * `orders.quoteRedemption` and `orders.createRedemption` (spec §4.4, design §F.6). Api role: never calls
 * FP. Both read the worker's FP holdings snapshot (R-09); a snapshot older than 24 h enqueues
 * `folio.sync {folioId}` (F4) and the quote answers REFRESHING. The draft serialises per folio-scheme with
 * `pg_advisory_xact_lock`, recomputes, reserves units and creates the REDEMPTION challenge in one
 * transaction; nothing reaches FP before the challenge is CONSUMED (the submit job, worker only).
 */
@Injectable()
export class RedemptionService {
  constructor(
    @Inject(DB) private readonly dbh: DbHandle,
    @Inject(AppConfig) private readonly config: AppConfig,
    @Inject(ConsentEngine) private readonly consent: ConsentEngine,
    @Inject(InvestorAccounts) private readonly accounts: InvestorAccounts,
    @Inject(Crypto) private readonly crypto: Crypto,
    @Inject(AuditService) private readonly audit: AuditService,
    @Inject(Jobs) private readonly jobs: Jobs,
    @Inject(CLOCK) private readonly clock: Clock,
  ) {}

  async quote(investorId: string, input: RedemptionTargetInput): Promise<RedemptionQuote> {
    const db = this.dbh.db;
    const { folio, scheme } = await this.target(db, investorId, input);
    if (!isSnapshotFresh(folio, this.clock.now())) {
      await this.refresh(db, folio.id);
      return { status: 'REFRESHING', folioId: folio.id, isin: scheme.isin };
    }
    const evaluation = await this.evaluate(db, folio, scheme, null);
    const a = evaluation.availability;
    return {
      status: 'READY',
      folioId: folio.id,
      isin: scheme.isin,
      schemeName: scheme.name,
      heldUnits: a.heldUnits.toWire(),
      lockedUnits: a.lockedUnits.toWire(),
      unlockedUnits: a.unlockedUnits.toWire(),
      reservedUnits: a.reservedUnits.toWire(),
      availableUnits: a.availableUnits.toWire(),
      providerShort: a.providerShort,
      reconciliation: folio.reconciliationStatus,
      nav: evaluation.nav.toWire(),
      navDate: evaluation.navDate,
      navGrade: evaluation.navGrade,
      buffer: evaluation.buffer,
      exitNavDate: evaluation.exitNavDate,
      displayCutoff: evaluation.displayCutoff,
      maxAmount: a.maxAmount?.toWire() ?? null,
      all: wireAll(a.all),
      payoutBank: folio.payoutBankMasked,
      snapshotAsOf: (folio.fpHoldingsSyncedAt ?? this.clock.now()).toISOString(),
    };
  }

  async createRedemption(input: CreateRedemptionInput): Promise<RedemptionCreated> {
    const db = this.dbh.db;
    const now = this.clock.now();
    // 1. Ownership first: a foreign or unknown folio is 404 before anything else is revealed (BOLA).
    const { folio, scheme } = await this.target(db, input.investorId, input);
    const [investor] = await db.select().from(investors).where(eq(investors.id, input.investorId));
    if (investor === undefined) throw new AppError('NOT_FOUND');
    // 2. Readiness (E11 trigger), 3. the kill switch, 4. the scheme still redeemable at FP.
    if (!investor.canExit) throw new AppError('EXIT_BLOCKED');
    if (!(await RuntimeConfig.get(db, 'orders.enabled'))) throw new AppError('ORDERS_DISABLED');
    if (!scheme.redemptionAllowed) throw new AppError('SCHEME_NOT_ORDERABLE');
    const amount = input.amount === undefined ? null : Money.parse(input.amount);
    if (input.mode === 'ALL' && amount !== null) {
      throw new AppError('VALIDATION_FAILED', {
        fields: [{ path: 'amount', code: 'NOT_ALLOWED', message: 'Redeem all takes no amount' }],
      });
    }
    // 5. R-09: the draft recomputes on a fresh snapshot only.
    if (!isSnapshotFresh(folio, now)) {
      await this.refresh(db, folio.id);
      throw new AppError('FOLIO_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED');
    }
    // 6. H-21: both consent factors must reach a folio-registered, verified contact.
    this.assertFolioDestinations(investor, folio);
    const [bank] = await db
      .select({ id: bankAccounts.id })
      .from(bankAccounts)
      .where(
        and(eq(bankAccounts.investorId, input.investorId), eq(bankAccounts.status, 'VERIFIED')),
      )
      .limit(1);
    if (bank === undefined) throw new AppError('EXIT_BLOCKED');

    return db.transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx.execute(
        sql`SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(${`redemption:${folio.id}:${scheme.id}`}, 0))`,
      );
      await this.cancelStaleDrafts(tx, folio.id, scheme.id, now);
      const evaluation = await this.evaluate(tx, folio, scheme, null);
      const plan = planRedemption(input.mode, amount, evaluation);
      if (evaluation.availability.providerShort) {
        await ReconBreaks.open(tx, {
          kind: 'REDEMPTION_PROVIDER_SHORT',
          entityType: 'folios',
          entityId: folio.id,
          severity: 'WARNING',
          detail: {
            isin: scheme.isin,
            unlockedUnits: evaluation.availability.unlockedUnits.toWire(),
          },
        });
      }
      const orderAmount = plan.kind === 'AMOUNT' ? plan.amount.toWire() : null;
      const orderId = newId('orders');
      await tx.insert(orders).values({
        id: orderId,
        createdBy: input.investorId,
        updatedBy: input.investorId,
        investorId: input.investorId,
        type: 'REDEMPTION',
        schemeId: scheme.id,
        folioId: folio.id,
        mode: input.mode,
        amount: orderAmount,
        bankAccountId: bank.id,
        arn: this.config.env.SANCHAY_PLATFORM_ARN,
        initiatedVia: input.initiatedVia,
        userIp: input.userIp,
        cutoffClass: scheme.cutoffClass,
      });
      await tx.insert(orderEvents).values({
        orderId,
        toStatus: 'CONSENT_PENDING',
        trigger: 'orders.createRedemption',
      });
      await tx.insert(redemptionReservations).values({
        orderId,
        investorId: input.investorId,
        folioId: folio.id,
        schemeId: scheme.id,
        unitsReserved: plan.units.toWire(),
      });
      await this.audit.record(tx, {
        action: ORDER_AUDIT_ACTIONS.ORDER_CREATED,
        actorType: 'INVESTOR',
        actorId: input.investorId,
        entityType: 'orders',
        entityId: orderId,
      });
      // R-10: an amount uses SANCHAY_CONSENT_OTP_V1 ("redeem Rs X"); FULL uses the units template with "all".
      const smsFields: Record<string, string> =
        orderAmount === null
          ? { action: 'redeem', units: 'all', schemeShort: scheme.name.slice(0, 30) }
          : { action: 'redeem', amount: orderAmount, schemeShort: scheme.name.slice(0, 30) };
      const challenge = await this.consent.create(tx, {
        investorId: input.investorId,
        subjectType: 'REDEMPTION',
        subjects: [{ table: 'orders', id: orderId }],
        templateKey: 'TPL_REDEMPTION',
        folioId: folio.id,
        amount: orderAmount,
        fields: smsFields,
      });
      await tx
        .update(orders)
        .set({ consentChallengeId: challenge.challengeId })
        .where(eq(orders.id, orderId));
      return {
        orderId,
        challengeId: challenge.challengeId,
        expiresAt: challenge.expiresAt.toISOString(),
        mode: input.mode,
        amount: orderAmount,
        unitsReserved: plan.units.toWire(),
      };
    });
  }

  /** The investor's own ACTIVE, numbered (platform ONDC) folio and a scheme of the same AMC; else 404. */
  private async target(
    exec: DbExecutor,
    investorId: string,
    input: RedemptionTargetInput,
  ): Promise<Target> {
    const [folio] = await exec
      .select()
      .from(folios)
      .where(and(eq(folios.id, input.folioId), eq(folios.investorId, investorId)));
    if (folio === undefined || folio.folioNumber === null || folio.status !== 'ACTIVE') {
      throw new AppError('NOT_FOUND');
    }
    const scheme = await loadScheme(exec, input.isin);
    if (scheme === undefined || scheme.amcId !== folio.amcId) throw new AppError('NOT_FOUND');
    return { folio, scheme };
  }

  private evaluate(
    exec: DbExecutor,
    folio: FolioRow,
    scheme: SchemeFacts,
    excludeOrderId: string | null,
  ): Promise<RedemptionEvaluation> {
    const snapshot: FolioHoldingsSnapshot | null = folio.fpHoldingsSnapshot;
    return evaluateRedemption(exec, this.clock, {
      folio,
      scheme,
      providerRedeemableUnits: redeemableIn(snapshot, folio.reconciliationStatus, scheme.isin),
      reconciliation: folio.reconciliationStatus,
      excludeOrderId,
    });
  }

  private async refresh(exec: DbExecutor, folioId: string): Promise<void> {
    // Stately (R-32, RV-04-F5-1): a refresh already queued for this folio absorbs this one (enqueue returns null).
    await this.jobs.enqueue(exec, 'folio.sync', { folioId }, { singletonKey: folioId });
  }

  /**
   * H-21 (existing folio): destinations are `folios.registered_*` ∩ the investor's verified contacts, and a
   * REDEMPTION needs SMS and email (`requiredFactorsFor`), so both must intersect. A folio FP lists with no
   * registered contacts takes the consent on the account's `folio_defaults` contacts, which are the
   * investor's own (probe P-09; `folioConsentDestinations`). Either way E4 sends the OTPs to the investor's
   * CURRENT contacts and the confirm PATCH carries them.
   */
  private assertFolioDestinations(investor: typeof investors.$inferSelect, folio: FolioRow): void {
    const mobile = this.accounts.decryptMobile(investor).replace(/\D/g, '').slice(-10);
    const email = this.accounts.decryptEmail(investor);
    const destinations = folioConsentDestinations(folio, {
      mobileBidx: this.crypto.blindIndex('mobile', mobile),
      emailBidx: email === null ? null : this.crypto.blindIndex('email', email),
    });
    if (destinations === 'UNAVAILABLE') throw new AppError('CONSENT_DESTINATION_UNAVAILABLE');
  }

  /** Under the advisory lock: drafts whose challenge can no longer be approved are cancelled and released. */
  private async cancelStaleDrafts(
    tx: DbExecutor,
    folioId: string,
    schemeId: string,
    now: Date,
  ): Promise<void> {
    const stale = await tx
      .select({ id: orders.id, status: orders.status, challengeId: orders.consentChallengeId })
      .from(redemptionReservations)
      .innerJoin(orders, eq(orders.id, redemptionReservations.orderId))
      .leftJoin(consentChallenges, eq(consentChallenges.id, orders.consentChallengeId))
      .where(
        and(
          eq(redemptionReservations.folioId, folioId),
          eq(redemptionReservations.schemeId, schemeId),
          eq(redemptionReservations.status, 'ACTIVE'),
          staleDraft(now),
        ),
      );
    for (const draft of stale) {
      await moveOrder(tx, draft, 'CANCELLED', 'local_cancel', {
        failureCode: 'DRAFT_ABANDONED',
        finalAt: now,
      });
      await releaseReservation(tx, this.audit, {
        orderId: draft.id,
        evidence: `draft_abandoned:${draft.challengeId ?? 'none'}`,
        now,
      });
    }
  }
}

`apps/api/src/modules/orders/redemption-submit.job.ts`:
```ts
import { Inject, Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import type { OrderStatus, RedemptionRefusal } from '@sanchay/domain';
import { Money } from '@sanchay/money';
import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { DB, type DbHandle } from '../../db/client.js';
import { FpAmbiguousError, FpRejectedError } from '../../integrations/fp/fp-errors.js';
import { FpRead } from '../../integrations/fp/fp-read.js';
import { FpTransact } from '../../integrations/fp/fp-transact.js';
import { schemes } from '../catalogue/catalogue.schema.js';
import { investors } from '../identity/identity.schema.js';
import { type ConsentApprovedJobData, ConsentEngine } from '../legal-consent/consent-engine.js';
import { AuditService } from '../platform/audit.service.js';
import { CLOCK, type Clock } from '../platform/clock.js';
import { AppError } from '../platform/errors.js';
import { type Job, JobHandler } from '../platform/jobs/job-registry.js';
import { Jobs } from '../platform/jobs/jobs.service.js';
import { ReconBreaks } from '../platform/runtime-config.js';
import { folios } from '../portfolio/folios.schema.js';
import { toFolioHoldingsSnapshot } from '../portfolio/fp-holdings.js';
import { releaseReservation } from '../portfolio/reservations.js';
import { toFpRedemptionView } from './fp-redemption.js';
import { moveOrder } from './order-transitions.js';
import { ORDER_AUDIT_ACTIONS, orders } from './orders.schema.js';
import {
  evaluateRedemption,
  liveRefusal,
  loadScheme,
  redeemableIn,
} from './redemption-evaluation.js';

const ADVANCE_POLL_SECONDS = 15;

type SubmitOutcome =
  | { kind: 'refused'; refusal: RedemptionRefusal | 'SCHEME_NOT_ORDERABLE' }
  | { kind: 'created'; raw: Record<string, unknown> };

/**
 * Worker only. Started by approve (CONSENT_SUBJECT_JOBS.REDEMPTION). Inside `useConsumed`, before any FP
 * write, it re-runs the MISMATCH, ALL-refusal and AMOUNT-cap checks against FP's live holdings report
 * (R-09). A refusal → SUBMITTING → REJECTED with no M write, the challenge CONSUMED_UNUSED and the
 * reservation RELEASED. Otherwise `POST /v2/mf_redemptions` (ambiguous → RECONCILING, reservation kept).
 */
@Injectable()
@JobHandler('orders.redemption.submit')
export class RedemptionSubmitJob {
  constructor(
    @Inject(DB) private readonly dbh: DbHandle,
    @Inject(ConsentEngine) private readonly consent: ConsentEngine,
    @Inject(FpRead) private readonly fpRead: FpRead,
    @Inject(FpTransact) private readonly fp: FpTransact,
    @Inject(AuditService) private readonly audit: AuditService,
    @Inject(Jobs) private readonly jobs: Jobs,
    @Inject(CLOCK) private readonly clock: Clock,
  ) {}

  async handle(job: Job<'orders.redemption.submit'>): Promise<void> {
    const { challengeId, subjectIds } = job.data as ConsentApprovedJobData;
    const orderId = subjectIds[0];
    if (orderId === undefined) return;
    const db = this.dbh.db;
    let [order] = await db.select().from(orders).where(eq(orders.id, orderId));
    if (order === undefined || order.type !== 'REDEMPTION') return;
    if (order.status === 'CONSENT_PENDING') {
      await moveOrder(db, order, 'CONSENTED', 'approve');
      order = { ...order, status: 'CONSENTED' as OrderStatus };
    }
    if (order.status !== 'CONSENTED') return; // already submitted or superseded

    const [investor] = await db.select().from(investors).where(eq(investors.id, order.investorId));
    const [folio] = await db
      .select()
      .from(folios)
      .where(eq(folios.id, order.folioId ?? ''));
    const [scheme] = await db
      .select({ isin: schemes.isin })
      .from(schemes)
      .where(eq(schemes.id, order.schemeId));
    const mfia = investor?.fpMfInvestmentAccountId ?? null;
    const mfiaOldId = investor?.fpMfiaOldId ?? null;
    if (
      folio === undefined ||
      folio.folioNumber === null ||
      scheme === undefined ||
      mfia === null ||
      mfiaOldId === null
    ) {
      throw new AppError('INTERNAL', {
        message: 'redemption has no folio, scheme or FP investment account',
      });
    }
    const folioNumber = folio.folioNumber;
    const current = order;
    const now = this.clock.now();

    let outcome: SubmitOutcome;
    try {
      outcome = await this.consent.useConsumed<SubmitOutcome>(challengeId, async (consumed) => {
        const live = toFolioHoldingsSnapshot(
          await this.fpRead.holdings({ investmentAccountOldId: mfiaOldId, folios: folioNumber }),
          folioNumber,
        );
        const refusal = await this.liveCheck(current, folio, scheme.isin, live);
        if (refusal !== null) return { kind: 'refused', refusal };
        await moveOrder(db, current, 'SUBMITTING', 'submit_job', {
          submitAttempts: current.submitAttempts + 1,
        });
        const raw = await this.fp.createRedemption(
          {
            mfInvestmentAccount: mfia,
            scheme: scheme.isin,
            folioNumber,
            ...(current.amount === null ? {} : { amount: current.amount }),
            userIp: current.userIp,
            sourceRefId: current.id,
          },
          consumed,
        );
        return { kind: 'created', raw };
      });
    } catch (err) {
      const [after] = await db.select().from(orders).where(eq(orders.id, orderId));
      if (
        err instanceof AppError &&
        err.code === 'CONSENT_EXPIRED' &&
        after?.status === 'CONSENTED'
      ) {
        await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
          await moveOrder(tx, after, 'CONSENT_EXPIRED', 'execute_before_missed', { finalAt: now });
          await releaseReservation(tx, this.audit, { orderId, evidence: 'consent_expired', now });
        });
        return;
      }
      if (after?.status === 'SUBMITTING' && err instanceof FpRejectedError) {
        // FP refused the create outright (4xx): no FP object exists, so the units are free again.
        const code = err.providerCode ?? `HTTP_${err.httpStatus}`;
        await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
          await moveOrder(tx, after, 'REJECTED', 'live_check_failed', {
            failureCode: code,
            finalAt: now,
          });
          await releaseReservation(tx, this.audit, {
            orderId,
            evidence: `fp_rejected:${code}`,
            now,
          });
          await this.audit.record(tx, {
            action: ORDER_AUDIT_ACTIONS.ORDER_REJECTED,
            actorType: 'SYSTEM',
            entityType: 'orders',
            entityId: orderId,
            data: { reason: code },
          });
        });
        return;
      }
      if (
        after?.status === 'SUBMITTING' &&
        (err instanceof FpAmbiguousError || !(err instanceof AppError))
      ) {
        // Spec §4.1: nothing is released while RECONCILING.
        await moveOrder(db, after, 'RECONCILING', 'ambiguous');
        return;
      }
      throw err; // e.g. the holdings read failed while CONSENTED: pg-boss retries within the saga window
    }

    if (outcome.kind === 'refused') {
      const refusal = outcome.refusal;
      await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
        await moveOrder(tx, current, 'SUBMITTING', 'submit_job');
        await moveOrder(
          tx,
          { id: orderId, status: 'SUBMITTING' },
          'REJECTED',
          'live_check_failed',
          {
            failureCode: refusal,
            finalAt: now,
          },
        );
        await releaseReservation(tx, this.audit, {
          orderId,
          evidence: `live_check_failed:${refusal}`,
          now,
        });
        await this.consent.markUnused(tx, challengeId, `live_check_failed:${refusal}`);
        await ReconBreaks.open(tx, {
          kind: 'REDEMPTION_LIVE_CHECK_FAILED',
          entityType: 'orders',
          entityId: orderId,
          severity: 'WARNING',
          detail: { refusal, folioId: folio.id },
        });
        await this.audit.record(tx, {
          action: ORDER_AUDIT_ACTIONS.ORDER_REJECTED,
          actorType: 'SYSTEM',
          entityType: 'orders',
          entityId: orderId,
          data: { reason: refusal },
        });
      });
      return;
    }

    const redemption = toFpRedemptionView(outcome.raw);
    await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
      await moveOrder(
        tx,
        { id: orderId, status: 'SUBMITTING' },
        'UNDER_REVIEW',
        'fp_under_review',
        {
          fpOrderId: redemption.id,
          fpOldId: redemption.oldId,
          fpState: redemption.state,
        },
      );
      await this.audit.record(tx, {
        action: ORDER_AUDIT_ACTIONS.ORDER_SUBMITTED,
        actorType: 'SYSTEM',
        entityType: 'orders',
        entityId: orderId,
      });
      await this.jobs.enqueue(
        tx,
        'orders.redemption.advance',
        { orderId, challengeId },
        { startAfter: ADVANCE_POLL_SECONDS, singletonKey: orderId },
      );
    });
  }

  /** The R-09 live re-check: the same rules as the draft, with FP's live redeemable units. */
  private async liveCheck(
    order: typeof orders.$inferSelect,
    folio: typeof folios.$inferSelect,
    isin: string,
    live: ReturnType<typeof toFolioHoldingsSnapshot>,
  ): Promise<RedemptionRefusal | 'SCHEME_NOT_ORDERABLE' | null> {
    const scheme = await loadScheme(this.dbh.db, isin);
    if (scheme === undefined) return 'SCHEME_NOT_ORDERABLE';
    const reconciliation = live === null ? 'FEED_UNAVAILABLE' : folio.reconciliationStatus;
    try {
      const evaluation = await evaluateRedemption(this.dbh.db, this.clock, {
        folio,
        scheme,
        providerRedeemableUnits: redeemableIn(live, reconciliation, isin),
        reconciliation,
        excludeOrderId: order.id,
      });
      return liveRefusal(order.amount === null ? null : Money.parse(order.amount), evaluation);
    } catch (err) {
      if (
        err instanceof AppError &&
        (err.code === 'NAV_UNAVAILABLE' || err.code === 'SCHEME_NOT_ORDERABLE')
      ) {
        return err.code;
      }
      throw err;
    }
  }
}

```ts
import { Inject, Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import type { OrderStatus } from '@sanchay/domain';
import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { DB, type DbHandle } from '../../db/client.js';
import { FpAmbiguousError } from '../../integrations/fp/fp-errors.js';
import { FpRead } from '../../integrations/fp/fp-read.js';
import { FpTransact } from '../../integrations/fp/fp-transact.js';
import { investors } from '../identity/identity.schema.js';
import { InvestorAccounts } from '../identity/investor-accounts.service.js';
import { ConsentEngine } from '../legal-consent/consent-engine.js';
import { AuditService } from '../platform/audit.service.js';
import { CLOCK, type Clock } from '../platform/clock.js';
import { AppError } from '../platform/errors.js';
import { type Job, JobHandler } from '../platform/jobs/job-registry.js';
import { Jobs } from '../platform/jobs/jobs.service.js';
import { RedemptionSettlement } from '../portfolio/redemption-settlement.js';
import { releaseReservation } from '../portfolio/reservations.js';
import { toFpRedemptionView } from './fp-redemption.js';
import { moveOrder } from './order-transitions.js';
import { ORDER_AUDIT_ACTIONS, orders } from './orders.schema.js';

export interface RedemptionAdvanceData {
  orderId: string;
  challengeId: string;
}

const REVIEW_POLL_SECONDS = 30;
const REVIEW_TERMINAL = ['failed', 'cancelled', 'expired'];

/**
 * Worker only. Drives a redemption from UNDER_REVIEW: FP `pending` (`review_completed`) → one
 * `PATCH {id, state: 'confirmed', consent}` under `useConsumed` (ONDC allows the single PATCH for
 * redemptions, research fp-api §2) → `submitted` = PROCESSING. Re-enqueues itself while FP reviews.
 * FP refusing in review → REJECTED with the reservation RELEASED; the saga window passing before the
 * confirm → CONSENT_EXPIRED (R-17), released too, because FP cannot process an unconfirmed redemption.
 */
@Injectable()
@JobHandler('orders.redemption.advance')
export class RedemptionAdvanceJob {
  constructor(
    @Inject(DB) private readonly dbh: DbHandle,
    @Inject(ConsentEngine) private readonly consent: ConsentEngine,
    @Inject(FpRead) private readonly fpRead: FpRead,
    @Inject(FpTransact) private readonly fp: FpTransact,
    @Inject(InvestorAccounts) private readonly accounts: InvestorAccounts,
    @Inject(RedemptionSettlement) private readonly settlement: RedemptionSettlement,
    @Inject(AuditService) private readonly audit: AuditService,
    @Inject(Jobs) private readonly jobs: Jobs,
    @Inject(CLOCK) private readonly clock: Clock,
  ) {}

  async handle(job: Job<'orders.redemption.advance'>): Promise<void> {
    const { orderId, challengeId } = job.data as RedemptionAdvanceData;
    const db = this.dbh.db;
    const [order] = await db.select().from(orders).where(eq(orders.id, orderId));
    if (order === undefined || order.type !== 'REDEMPTION' || order.fpOrderId === null) return;
    if (order.status !== 'UNDER_REVIEW' && order.status !== 'CONFIRMING') return;
    const now = this.clock.now();

    const redemption = toFpRedemptionView(await this.fpRead.redemption(order.fpOrderId));
    if (REVIEW_TERMINAL.includes(redemption.state)) {
      await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
        await moveOrder(tx, order, 'REJECTED', 'fp_review_failed', {
          fpState: redemption.state,
          failureCode: redemption.failureCode,
          finalAt: now,
        });
        await releaseReservation(tx, this.audit, {
          orderId,
          evidence: `fp_${redemption.state}:${redemption.id}`,
          now,
        });
        await this.audit.record(tx, {
          action: ORDER_AUDIT_ACTIONS.ORDER_REJECTED,
          actorType: 'SYSTEM',
          entityType: 'orders',
          entityId: orderId,
          data: { reason: redemption.failureCode ?? redemption.state },
        });
      });
      return;
    }
    if (
      order.status === 'CONFIRMING' &&
      (redemption.state === 'submitted' || redemption.state === 'successful')
    ) {
      // A retried confirm that had gone through: catch up, then let settlement apply a final state.
      await moveOrder(db, order, 'PROCESSING', 'fp_confirmed_submitted', {
        fpState: redemption.state,
      });
      await this.settlement.apply(orderId, redemption);
      return;
    }
    if (redemption.state !== 'pending') {
      await this.requeue(orderId, challengeId);
      return;
    }

    const confirming = { id: order.id, status: 'CONFIRMING' as OrderStatus };
    try {
      await this.consent.useConsumed(challengeId, async (consumed) => {
        if (order.status === 'UNDER_REVIEW') {
          await moveOrder(db, order, 'CONFIRMING', 'fp_pending', { fpState: redemption.state });
        }
        const [investor] = await db
          .select()
          .from(investors)
          .where(eq(investors.id, order.investorId));
        if (investor === undefined) throw new AppError('NOT_FOUND');
        // The investor's verified contacts: the folio-registered values (the draft checked them, H-21) or,
        // on a folio with none registered, the account's folio_defaults ones (probe P-09); the same in the MVP.
        // The 10-digit national number; a 10-digit mobile that starts with 91 keeps its digits.
        const mobile = this.accounts.decryptMobile(investor).replace(/\D/g, '').slice(-10);
        const email = this.accounts.decryptEmail(investor);
        const after = toFpRedemptionView(
          await this.fp.updateRedemption(
            {
              id: redemption.id,
              state: 'confirmed',
              consent: { isd_code: '91', mobile, ...(email === null ? {} : { email }) },
            },
            consumed,
          ),
        );
        if (after.state === 'submitted') {
          await moveOrder(db, confirming, 'PROCESSING', 'fp_confirmed_submitted', {
            fpState: after.state,
          });
        } else {
          await this.requeue(orderId, challengeId);
        }
      });
    } catch (err) {
      if (
        err instanceof AppError &&
        err.code === 'CONSENT_EXPIRED' &&
        order.status === 'UNDER_REVIEW'
      ) {
        await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
          await moveOrder(tx, order, 'CONSENT_EXPIRED', 'saga_expired_under_review', {
            finalAt: now,
          });
          await releaseReservation(tx, this.audit, {
            orderId,
            evidence: `saga_expired_unconfirmed:${redemption.id}`,
            now,
          });
        });
        return;
      }
      if (
        err instanceof AppError &&
        err.code === 'CONSENT_EXPIRED' &&
        order.status === 'CONFIRMING'
      ) {
        // RV-04-F5-3: the window closed before the confirm was sent. FP never processes an unconfirmed
        // redemption and expires it; the next re-fetch (F7's backstop) then moves the order REJECTED and
        // releases it. Rethrowing only failed this job again on every re-enqueue.
        return;
      }
      const [after] = await db.select().from(orders).where(eq(orders.id, orderId));
      if (after?.status === 'CONFIRMING' && err instanceof FpAmbiguousError) {
        // Spec §4.1: the confirm may have landed; nothing is released while RECONCILING.
        await moveOrder(db, after, 'RECONCILING', 'ambiguous');
        return;
      }
      throw err;
    }
  }

  private async requeue(orderId: string, challengeId: string): Promise<void> {
    await this.jobs.enqueue(
      this.dbh.db,
      'orders.redemption.advance',
      { orderId, challengeId },
      { startAfter: REVIEW_POLL_SECONDS, singletonKey: orderId },
    );
  }
}

`apps/api/src/modules/orders/redemption-events.ts`:
```ts
import type { OrderStatus } from '@sanchay/domain';
import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import type {
  FpEventHandler,
  FpEventHandlerContext,
} from '../../integrations/fp/webhooks/fp-event-handlers.js';
import type { RedemptionSettlement } from '../portfolio/redemption-settlement.js';
import { toFpRedemptionView } from './fp-redemption.js';
import { orders } from './orders.schema.js';

const ADVANCING: readonly OrderStatus[] = ['UNDER_REVIEW', 'CONFIRMING'];
const SETTLING: readonly OrderStatus[] = ['PROCESSING', 'UNITS_PENDING', 'SETTLED'];

/**
 * E1 handler for `mf_redemption.*` (including `review_completed`). Never trusts the payload: an order in
 * review is handed to `orders.redemption.advance` (which re-fetches and confirms under useConsumed); a
 * submitted one is re-fetched and applied by RedemptionSettlement. Webhooks are at-least-once; both paths
 * are idempotent.
 */
export function mfRedemptionEventHandler(
  settlement: RedemptionSettlement,
  enqueueAdvance: (orderId: string, challengeId: string) => Promise<void>,
): FpEventHandler {
  return async ({ db, event, fpRead }: FpEventHandlerContext): Promise<void> => {
    if (event.objectId === null) return;
    const [order] = await db
      .select({
        id: orders.id,
        type: orders.type,
        status: orders.status,
        challengeId: orders.consentChallengeId,
      })
      .from(orders)
      .where(eq(orders.fpOrderId, event.objectId));
    if (order === undefined || order.type !== 'REDEMPTION') return;
    if (ADVANCING.includes(order.status)) {
      if (order.challengeId !== null) await enqueueAdvance(order.id, order.challengeId);
      return;
    }
    if (!SETTLING.includes(order.status)) return;
    await settlement.apply(order.id, toFpRedemptionView(await fpRead.redemption(event.objectId)));
  };
}

`apps/api/src/modules/orders/payout-watch.job.ts`:
```ts
import { Inject, Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import { istIsoDate } from '@sanchay/domain';
import { and, eq, inArray } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { DB, type DbHandle } from '../../db/client.js';
import { FpRead } from '../../integrations/fp/fp-read.js';
import { schemes } from '../catalogue/catalogue.schema.js';
import { Notify } from '../notifications/notify.service.js';
import { AuditService } from '../platform/audit.service.js';
import { CLOCK, type Clock } from '../platform/clock.js';
import { type Job, JobHandler } from '../platform/jobs/job-registry.js';
import { reconBreaks } from '../platform/kernel.schema.js';
import { ReconBreaks } from '../platform/runtime-config.js';
import { toFpRedemptionView } from './fp-redemption.js';
import { ORDER_AUDIT_ACTIONS, orders } from './orders.schema.js';

type OrderRow = typeof orders.$inferSelect;

/**
 * Worker only, 10:00 IST (D-MONEY-053, spec §4.4). For every SETTLED redemption whose payout is EXPECTED
 * or DELAYED: CREDITED only on evidence (an ops-recorded `payout_ref`, or FP's `bank_credit_reference`
 * on the re-fetched redemption); otherwise, once today (IST) is past `payout_due_by`, the regulatory
 * maximum, EXPECTED → DELAYED with the PAYOUT_DELAYED email (15% p.a. interest owed by the AMC, AMC and
 * SCORES links), a WARNING break (REDEMPTION_PAYOUT_OVERDUE, the ops alert) and an audit row (R-20).
 */
@Injectable()
@JobHandler('payout.watch')
export class PayoutWatchJob {
  private readonly log = new Logger(PayoutWatchJob.name);

  constructor(
    @Inject(DB) private readonly dbh: DbHandle,
    @Inject(FpRead) private readonly fpRead: FpRead,
    @Inject(Notify) private readonly notify: Notify,
    @Inject(AuditService) private readonly audit: AuditService,
    @Inject(CLOCK) private readonly clock: Clock,
  ) {}

  async handle(_job: Job<'payout.watch'>): Promise<void> {
    const watched = await this.dbh.db
      .select()
      .from(orders)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(orders.type, 'REDEMPTION'),
          eq(orders.status, 'SETTLED'),
          inArray(orders.payoutStatus, ['EXPECTED', 'DELAYED']),
        ),
      );
    for (const order of watched) {
      const evidence = order.payoutRef ?? (await this.fpEvidence(order));
      if (evidence !== null) {
        await this.credit(order, evidence);
        continue;
      }
      const today = istIsoDate(this.clock.now());
      if (
        order.payoutStatus === 'EXPECTED' &&
        order.payoutDueBy !== null &&
        today > order.payoutDueBy
      ) {
        await this.delay(order);
      }
    }
  }

  /** FP's payout evidence on the redemption; a failed re-fetch is logged and the deadline still applies. */
  private async fpEvidence(order: OrderRow): Promise<string | null> {
    if (order.fpOrderId === null) return null;
    try {
      return toFpRedemptionView(await this.fpRead.redemption(order.fpOrderId)).bankCreditReference;
    } catch (err) {
      this.log.warn(
        `payout.watch_refetch_failed: order ${order.id} (${err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)})`,
      );
      return null;
    }
  }

  private async credit(order: OrderRow, evidence: string): Promise<void> {
    const now = this.clock.now();
    await this.dbh.db.transaction(async (tx) => {
      const updated = await tx
        .update(orders)
        .set({ payoutStatus: 'CREDITED', payoutRef: evidence, payoutUpdatedAt: now })
        .where(and(eq(orders.id, order.id), eq(orders.payoutStatus, order.payoutStatus)))
        .returning({ id: orders.id });
      if (updated.length === 0) return;
      await this.audit.record(tx, {
        action: ORDER_AUDIT_ACTIONS.REDEMPTION_PAYOUT_CREDITED,
        actorType: 'SYSTEM',
        entityType: 'orders',
        entityId: order.id,
        data: { status: 'CREDITED' },
      });
      // RV-04-F5-4: the payout arrived, so this job's own overdue break resolves itself.
      await tx
        .update(reconBreaks)
        .set({ status: 'RESOLVED', resolvedAt: now })
        .where(
          and(
            eq(reconBreaks.kind, 'REDEMPTION_PAYOUT_OVERDUE'),
            eq(reconBreaks.entityId, order.id),
            eq(reconBreaks.status, 'OPEN'),
          ),
        );
    });
  }

  private async delay(order: OrderRow): Promise<void> {
    const now = this.clock.now();
    await this.dbh.db.transaction(async (tx) => {
      const updated = await tx
        .update(orders)
        .set({ payoutStatus: 'DELAYED', payoutUpdatedAt: now })
        .where(and(eq(orders.id, order.id), eq(orders.payoutStatus, 'EXPECTED')))
        .returning({ id: orders.id });
      if (updated.length === 0) return;
      const [scheme] = await tx
        .select({ name: schemes.name })
        .from(schemes)
        .where(eq(schemes.id, order.schemeId));
      await this.notify.enqueue(tx, 'PAYOUT_DELAYED', {
        investorId: order.investorId,
        data: { schemeName: scheme?.name ?? 'your scheme' },
        dedupeKey: `payout-delayed:${order.id}`,
      });
      await ReconBreaks.open(tx, {
        kind: 'REDEMPTION_PAYOUT_OVERDUE',
        entityType: 'orders',
        entityId: order.id,
        severity: 'WARNING',
        detail: { payoutDueBy: order.payoutDueBy },
      });
      await this.audit.record(tx, {
        action: ORDER_AUDIT_ACTIONS.REDEMPTION_PAYOUT_DELAYED,
        actorType: 'SYSTEM',
        entityType: 'orders',
        entityId: order.id,
        data: { status: 'DELAYED' },
      });
    });
  }
}
```

    check(
      'orders_payout_dates_ck',
      sql`(payout_status = 'NONE') = (payout_expected_on IS NULL) AND (payout_expected_on IS NULL) = (payout_due_by IS NULL) AND (payout_due_by IS NULL OR payout_due_by >= payout_expected_on)`,

```
The generated `0031_redemptions` migration is nine `ALTER TABLE "app"."orders" ADD COLUMN …` statements and three `ADD CONSTRAINT … CHECK` statements; existing purchase rows (`payout_status = 'NONE'`, no dates) satisfy all three. `redeemed_units_reported` is deliberately not paired with `redeemed_units` by a check: it is evidence, and an ops or test write of `redeemed_units` alone (F20's evidence tests do this) stays legal.

const IsinSchema = z.string().regex(/^INF[A-Z0-9]{9}$/);

export const RedemptionTargetSchema = z.strictObject({ folioId: z.uuid(), isin: IsinSchema });

export const CreateRedemptionInputSchema = z.strictObject({

  amount: moneyWireSchema.optional(),
});

const RedeemAllSchema = z.discriminatedUnion('kind', [

      'FOLIO_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED',
      'INSUFFICIENT_REDEEMABLE',
      'NAV_UNAVAILABLE',
    ]),
  }),
]);

export const RedemptionQuoteSchema = z.discriminatedUnion('status', [

/** F5: the report-back fields a test sets when it advances a redemption (FP fills them at `successful`). */
export interface FakeFpRedemptionFields {
  redeemedUnits?: string | null;
  redeemedAmount?: string | null;
  redeemedPrice?: string | null;
  redeemedNavDate?: string | null;
  tradedOn?: string | null;
  bankCreditReference?: string | null;
}

function redemptionPayload(r: StoredRedemption): Record<string, unknown> {
  return {
    object: 'mf_redemption',
    id: r.id,
    old_id: r.oldId,
    state: r.state,
    scheme: r.scheme,
    folio_number: r.folioNumber,
    mf_investment_account: r.mfInvestmentAccount,
    source_ref_id: r.sourceRefId,
    amount: r.amount,
    consent: r.consent,
    redeemed_units: r.redeemedUnits,
    redeemed_amount: r.redeemedAmount,
    redeemed_price: r.redeemedPrice,
    redeemed_nav_date: r.redeemedNavDate,
    traded_on: r.tradedOn,
    bank_credit_reference: r.bankCreditReference,
  };
}

// FakeFp: add beside advance()
  /** F5: moves a redemption on; fields left undefined keep their value. */
  advanceRedemption(id: string, state: string, fields: FakeFpRedemptionFields = {}): void {
    const r = this.state.redemptions.get(id);
    if (r === undefined) throw new Error(`FakeFp.advanceRedemption: unknown redemption "${id}"`);
    r.state = state;
    if (fields.redeemedUnits !== undefined) r.redeemedUnits = fields.redeemedUnits;
    if (fields.redeemedAmount !== undefined) r.redeemedAmount = fields.redeemedAmount;
    if (fields.redeemedPrice !== undefined) r.redeemedPrice = fields.redeemedPrice;
    if (fields.redeemedNavDate !== undefined) r.redeemedNavDate = fields.redeemedNavDate;
    if (fields.tradedOn !== undefined) r.tradedOn = fields.tradedOn;
    if (fields.bankCreditReference !== undefined) r.bankCreditReference = fields.bankCreditReference;
  }

// route(), four cases before `default:`
      case 'redemption.create': {
        if (Object.hasOwn(body, 'units')) {
          return fpError(400, 'UNITS_NOT_SUPPORTED', 'Redemption by units only allowed for rta gateway');
        }
        if (typeof body.folio_number !== 'string' || body.folio_number === '') {
          return fpError(400, 'FOLIO_REQUIRED', 'folio_number is required');
        }
        const redemption: StoredRedemption = {
          id: this.state.nextId('mfr_'),
          oldId: this.state.nextOldId(),
          state: 'under_review',
          scheme: String(body.scheme ?? ''),
          folioNumber: body.folio_number,
          mfInvestmentAccount: String(body.mf_investment_account ?? ''),
          sourceRefId: String(body.source_ref_id ?? ''),
          amount: body.amount === undefined || body.amount === null ? null : String(body.amount),
          consent: null,
          redeemedUnits: null,
          redeemedAmount: null,
          redeemedPrice: null,
          redeemedNavDate: null,
          tradedOn: null,
          bankCreditReference: null,
        };
        this.state.redemptions.set(redemption.id, redemption);
        return { statusCode: 200, data: redemptionPayload(redemption) };
      }
      case 'redemption.get': {
        const redemption = this.state.redemptions.get(params.id ?? '');
        if (redemption === undefined) {
          return fpError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', `mf_redemption ${params.id ?? ''} not found`);
        }
        return { statusCode: 200, data: redemptionPayload(redemption) };
      }
      case 'redemption.list': {
        const sourceRefId = query.get('source_ref_id');
        const account = query.get('mf_investment_account');
        const items = [...this.state.redemptions.values()].filter(
          (r) =>
            (sourceRefId === null || r.sourceRefId === sourceRefId) &&
            (account === null || r.mfInvestmentAccount === account),
        );
        return { statusCode: 200, data: { object: 'list', data: items.map(redemptionPayload) } };
      }
      case 'redemption.update': {
        const redemption = this.state.redemptions.get(String(body.id ?? ''));
        if (redemption === undefined) {
          return fpError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', `mf_redemption ${String(body.id ?? '')} not found`);
        }
        if (body.state !== 'confirmed' || !Object.hasOwn(body, 'consent') || redemption.state !== 'pending') {
          return fpError(400, 'INVALID_STATE', 'an ONDC redemption is confirmed once, at pending, with its consent');
        }
        redemption.consent = body.consent as Record<string, unknown>;
        redemption.state = 'submitted';
        return { statusCode: 200, data: redemptionPayload(redemption) };
      }

F7's ops view `v_reconciling_orders` should show `orders.mode` and `orders.units` so a RECONCILING units order is told apart from an amount one.
- **For F17 (units-mode UI):** offer UNITS only when `meta.appConfig.flags.redeemByUnits` is true. When it is false, say so ("Redeem by units is not available yet") rather than hiding the option silently (spec §1, RED-01/02). Render `quote.all.kind === 'UNITS'` as "Redeem all: N units". The "Redeem remaining" action after an AMOUNT_WITH_RESIDUAL settlement (D-MONEY-051) is a UNITS draft of `quote.availableUnits` when the flag is on, else an AMOUNT draft of `quote.maxAmount`.
- **Decisions pinned here** (spec §4.4 row CONSENTED → SUBMITTING, design §F.6, D-MONEY-051, R-10, PO-2):
  - **Gate.** `features.redeemByUnits` is read at quote, at draft and again in the submit job. Flag off: a UNITS draft is `VALIDATION_FAILED` (`fields[0] = {path: 'mode', code: 'NOT_ALLOWED'}`) before anything is read or written; "Redeem all" keeps F5's floor2 amount. Flag switched off after approval: the submit job refuses with `UNITS_MODE_DISABLED` exactly like F5's live-check failure (SUBMITTING → REJECTED, reservation RELEASED, `markUnused`, a WARNING `REDEMPTION_LIVE_CHECK_FAILED`, an audit row, zero M writes). That makes the flag a working stop if FP withdraws units support mid-pilot.
  - **UNITS mode.** The units must be positive, at most 3 dp (`unitsWireSchema` on the wire, `Units.platform` in the service), and at most `availableUnits` (min(ledger unlocked, FP redeemable) after other live reservations, as F5 computes). The reservation is exactly the units: no buffer, because FP redeems units exactly. No NAV grade is needed (design §F.6: a NAV that is not OK leaves UNITS and ALL). A scheme with no NAV row at all still fails with F5's `NAV_UNAVAILABLE`, because the exit NAV date and buffer are computed for every quote. A MISMATCH folio caps UNITS the way F5 caps AMOUNT; it does not refuse.
  - **ALL with units proven (MED-8).** FULL (no locked lots, MATCHED within 24 h) still sends neither amount nor units. Every other ALL that part 1 would send as a floor2 amount sends the exact `availableUnits` instead, with `orders.mode = 'ALL'` and `orders.units` set. It also does so where part 1 refuses only because its amount fallback cannot run (NAV not OK, or an amount that floors to 0.00). Part 1's earlier refusals stand: a pending reservation, MISMATCH, FEED_UNAVAILABLE, FP short, nothing available. The live re-check of an ALL sent as units re-applies those refusals.
  - **Storage.** `orders.units` (E20's numeric(20,4)) carries the units sent, written from a 3-dp `Units`. `orders_redemption_units_ck` keeps it 3 dp, positive, never beside an amount, present for UNITS and absent for AMOUNT. F5's amount and FULL rows are unchanged (`units` null).
  - **Consent.** The REDEMPTION snapshot adds `units` (and labels `amount` as `UNITS` for a units order) from the order row, so the consented units are inside the hash. The SMS uses `SANCHAY_CONSENT_UNITS_OTP_V1` with the exact units, also for ALL as units: "all" would misstate an exit that leaves locked units behind. FULL keeps "all".
  - **FP.** `POST /v2/mf_redemptions` carries `units` (a 3-dp string, like F5's amount string) and no `amount`. If FP refuses it with a 4xx (its API reference says units are RTA-only, research fp-api §3.4), F5's path applies: REJECTED with FP's code (`UNITS_NOT_SUPPORTED` in FakeFp), released with `fp_rejected:<code>`. Settlement applies FP's `redeemed_units` as always (units come from the provider only). If they differ from the consented units, a WARNING `REDEMPTION_UNITS_DIFFER` is opened for ops. This also catches FP silently treating the order as a whole-holding redemption.
- **Deviations from the outline:**
  1. The outline lists only two tests. This task also implements D-MONEY-051's "ALL as explicit unlocked units when UNITS is proven", because without it UNITS mode would leave design §F.6 MED-8 half done, and the quote must show the same "Redeem all" the draft sends.
  2. F5's `planRedemption` typed `mode` as `'AMOUNT' | 'ALL'` and treated anything that was not AMOUNT as ALL. Once the contract admits `UNITS`, a UNITS request would have been drafted as a whole-holding redemption. F6 moves `planRedemption` and `liveRefusal` into `redemption-request.ts` with an exhaustive request parse, and unit-tests them without a database.
  3. Scheme withdrawal minimums and `units_multiple` (design §F.6) are not checked: `schemes.thresholds` (D8/D10) has no withdrawal fields (F5 records the same gap). FP's 4xx is the backstop: REJECTED and released.

import { Nav, Units } from '@sanchay/money';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import type { NavGrade } from '../src/catalogue.js';
import { toIsoDate } from '../src/ids.js';
import {
  type FolioReconciliation,
  redemptionAvailability,
} from '../src/rules/redemption-availability.js';
import { checkRedemptionUnits, redeemAllByUnits } from '../src/rules/redemption-units.js';

const u = (s: string): Units => Units.parse(s, 3);
const NOW = new Date('2026-11-03T04:30:00.000Z');

interface Case {
  lots?: Array<{ units: string; lockInUntil: string | null }>;
  reserved?: string;
  provider?: string | null;
  reconciliation?: FolioReconciliation;
  lastReconciledAt?: Date | null;
  nav?: string;
  navGrade?: NavGrade;
}

/** Part 1's availability for one folio-scheme; defaults: 100 unlocked units, MATCHED now, NAV 100, OK. */
function availability(c: Case = {}) {
  const lots = c.lots ?? [{ units: '100.000', lockInUntil: null }];
  return redemptionAvailability({
    lots: lots.map((lot, i) => ({
      id: `lot-${i}`,
      unitsRemaining: u(lot.units),
      lockInUntil: lot.lockInUntil === null ? null : toIsoDate(lot.lockInUntil),
    })),
    reservedUnits: u(c.reserved ?? '0.000'),
    exitNavDate: toIsoDate('2026-11-03'),
    providerRedeemableUnits:
      c.provider === undefined ? u('100.000') : c.provider === null ? null : u(c.provider),
    reconciliation: c.reconciliation ?? 'MATCHED',
    lastReconciledAt: c.lastReconciledAt === undefined ? NOW : c.lastReconciledAt,
    now: NOW,
    nav: Nav.parse(c.nav ?? '100.000000'),
    navGrade: c.navGrade ?? 'OK',
    buffer: '0.0360',
  });
}

const wire = (plan: ReturnType<typeof redeemAllByUnits>) =>
  plan.kind === 'UNITS' || plan.kind === 'FULL'
    ? { kind: plan.kind, units: plan.units.toWire() }
    : plan.kind === 'AMOUNT_WITH_RESIDUAL'
      ? { kind: plan.kind, amount: plan.amount.toWire() }
      : plan;

describe('redeemAllByUnits (F6: ALL as explicit units once P-09 proves UNITS)', () => {
  it('FULL stays FULL: no locked lots and MATCHED within 24 h send neither amount nor units', () => {
    expect(wire(redeemAllByUnits(availability()))).toEqual({ kind: 'FULL', units: '100.000' });
  });

  it('a locked ELSS lot: the exact unlocked units replace the floor2 amount and its residual', () => {
    const a = availability({
      lots: [
        { units: '100.000', lockInUntil: '2025-10-12' },
        { units: '100.000', lockInUntil: '2029-10-12' },
      ],
      provider: '100.000',
    });
    expect(wire(a.all)).toEqual({ kind: 'AMOUNT_WITH_RESIDUAL', amount: '9640.00' });
    expect(wire(redeemAllByUnits(a))).toEqual({ kind: 'UNITS', units: '100.000' });
  });

  it('not MATCHED within 24 h and the NAV not OK: units need no NAV', () => {
    const a = availability({ reconciliation: 'UNRECONCILED', navGrade: 'STALE' });
    expect(a.all).toEqual({ kind: 'REFUSED', code: 'NAV_UNAVAILABLE' });
    expect(wire(redeemAllByUnits(a))).toEqual({ kind: 'UNITS', units: '100.000' });
  });

  it('an amount that floors to zero still redeems the units', () => {
    const a = availability({
      lots: [{ units: '0.001', lockInUntil: null }],
      provider: '0.001',
      lastReconciledAt: new Date('2026-11-01T00:00:00.000Z'),
      nav: '1.000000',
    });
    expect(a.all).toEqual({ kind: 'REFUSED', code: 'INSUFFICIENT_REDEEMABLE' });
    expect(wire(redeemAllByUnits(a))).toEqual({ kind: 'UNITS', units: '0.001' });
  });

  it.each<[string, Case, string]>([
    ['another ACTIVE reservation', { reserved: '1.000' }, 'REDEMPTION_CONFLICT_PENDING'],
    ['MISMATCH', { reconciliation: 'MISMATCH' }, 'FOLIO_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED'],
    [
      'FEED_UNAVAILABLE',
      { reconciliation: 'FEED_UNAVAILABLE', provider: null },
      'FOLIO_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED',
    ],
    ['FP redeemable below the ledger', { provider: '80.000' }, 'FOLIO_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED'],
    [
      'nothing unlocked',
      { lots: [{ units: '10.000', lockInUntil: '2029-10-12' }], provider: '0.000' },
      'INSUFFICIENT_REDEEMABLE',
    ],
  ])('part 1 refusals stand: %s', (_name, c, code) => {
    expect(redeemAllByUnits(availability(c))).toEqual({ kind: 'REFUSED', code });
  });
});

describe('checkRedemptionUnits (UNITS mode)', () => {
  it('accepts up to the available units, with no buffer', () => {
    expect(checkRedemptionUnits(u('100.000'), availability())).toBeNull();
    expect(checkRedemptionUnits(u('0.001'), availability())).toBeNull();
  });

  it('accepts units while the NAV is not OK (AMOUNT would be NAV_UNAVAILABLE)', () => {
    const a = availability({ navGrade: 'UNAVAILABLE' });
    expect(a.maxAmount).toBeNull();
    expect(checkRedemptionUnits(u('25.500'), a)).toBeNull();
  });

  it('caps at min(ledger, FP) after other reservations', () => {
    const a = availability({ reserved: '51.800', provider: '80.000' });
    expect(a.availableUnits.toWire()).toBe('28.200');
    expect(checkRedemptionUnits(u('28.200'), a)).toBeNull();
    expect(checkRedemptionUnits(u('28.201'), a)).toBe('INSUFFICIENT_REDEEMABLE');
  });

  it.each(['0.000', '-1.000'])('refuses %s units', (units) => {
    expect(checkRedemptionUnits(u(units), availability())).toBe('INSUFFICIENT_REDEEMABLE');
  });
});
