```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import {
  allPlanOf,
  consentSmsFields,
  fpSendFields,
  liveRefusal,
  parseRedemptionRequest,
  planRedemption,
  type RedemptionPlan,
  sendOf,
} from './redemption-request.js';

const u = (s: string) => Units.platform(s);
const NOW = new Date('2026-11-03T04:30:00.000Z');
const NAV = Nav.parse('100.000000');

/** 100 unlocked units (optionally plus 100 locked), MATCHED now, NAV 100 OK, buffer 3.60% (F5's fixture). */
function pricing(options: { locked?: boolean; reserved?: string; provider?: string } = {}) {
  const lots: AvailabilityLot[] = [{ id: 'a', unitsRemaining: u('100.000'), lockInUntil: null }];
  if (options.locked === true) {
    lots.push({ id: 'b', unitsRemaining: u('100.000'), lockInUntil: toIsoDate('2029-10-12') });
  }
  return {
    availability: redemptionAvailability({
      lots,
      reservedUnits: u(options.reserved ?? '0.000'),
      exitNavDate: toIsoDate('2026-11-03'),
      providerRedeemableUnits: u(options.provider ?? '100.000'),
      reconciliation: 'MATCHED',
      lastReconciledAt: NOW,
      now: NOW,
      nav: NAV,
      navGrade: 'OK',
      buffer: '0.0360',
    }),
    nav: NAV,
    buffer: '0.0360',
  };
}

const wirePlan = (plan: RedemptionPlan) =>
  plan.kind === 'AMOUNT'
    ? { kind: plan.kind, amount: plan.amount.toWire(), units: plan.units.toWire() }
    : { kind: plan.kind, units: plan.units.toWire() };

describe('parseRedemptionRequest', () => {
  it('UNITS with the flag off → VALIDATION_FAILED on mode (outline F6)', () => {
    expect(() => parseRedemptionRequest({ mode: 'UNITS', units: '25.500' }, false)).toThrow(
      expect.objectContaining({
        code: 'VALIDATION_FAILED',
        options: {
          fields: [
            { path: 'mode', code: 'NOT_ALLOWED', message: 'Redeem by units is not available' },
          ],
        },
      }),
    );
  });

  it('UNITS with the flag on parses 3-dp units', () => {
    const request = parseRedemptionRequest({ mode: 'UNITS', units: '25.500' }, true);
    expect(request.mode === 'UNITS' && request.units.toWire()).toBe('25.500');
  });

  it.each([
    [{ mode: 'UNITS', amount: '100.00', units: '1.000' }, 'amount', 'NOT_ALLOWED'],
    [{ mode: 'UNITS' }, 'units', 'REQUIRED'],
    [{ mode: 'UNITS', units: '1.0005' }, 'units', 'INVALID'],
    [{ mode: 'AMOUNT', amount: '100.00', units: '1.000' }, 'units', 'NOT_ALLOWED'],
    [{ mode: 'AMOUNT' }, 'amount', 'REQUIRED'],
    [{ mode: 'ALL', amount: '100.00' }, 'amount', 'NOT_ALLOWED'],
    [{ mode: 'ALL', units: '1.000' }, 'units', 'NOT_ALLOWED'],
  ] as const)('%o → VALIDATION_FAILED on %s (%s)', (input, path, code) => {
    let caught: unknown;
    try {
      parseRedemptionRequest(input, true);
    } catch (err) {
      caught = err;
    }
    expect(caught).toMatchObject({
      code: 'VALIDATION_FAILED',
      options: { fields: [{ path, code }] },
    });
  });

  it('AMOUNT and ALL parse as before', () => {
    expect(parseRedemptionRequest({ mode: 'ALL' }, false)).toEqual({ mode: 'ALL' });
    const amount = parseRedemptionRequest({ mode: 'AMOUNT', amount: '5000.00' }, false);
    expect(amount.mode === 'AMOUNT' && amount.amount.toWire()).toBe('5000.00');
  });
});

describe('planRedemption', () => {
  it('AMOUNT reserves ceil3(amount ÷ NAV × 1.036) as in F5', () => {
    expect(
      wirePlan(planRedemption({ mode: 'AMOUNT', amount: Money.parse('5000.00') }, pricing(), true)),
    ).toEqual({ kind: 'AMOUNT', amount: '5000.00', units: '51.800' });
  });

  it('UNITS reserves exactly the units, up to every available unit (no buffer)', () => {
    expect(
      wirePlan(planRedemption({ mode: 'UNITS', units: u('100.000') }, pricing(), true)),
    ).toEqual({ kind: 'UNITS', units: '100.000' });
    expect(() => planRedemption({ mode: 'UNITS', units: u('100.001') }, pricing(), true)).toThrow(
      expect.objectContaining({ code: 'INSUFFICIENT_REDEEMABLE' }),
    );
    expect(() => planRedemption({ mode: 'UNITS', units: u('1.000') }, pricing(), false)).toThrow(
      expect.objectContaining({ code: 'VALIDATION_FAILED' }),
    );
  });

  it('ALL with a locked lot: the floor2 amount with the flag off, the exact unlocked units with it on', () => {
    expect(wirePlan(planRedemption({ mode: 'ALL' }, pricing({ locked: true }), false))).toEqual({
      kind: 'AMOUNT',
      amount: '9640.00',
      units: '99.871',
    });
    expect(wirePlan(planRedemption({ mode: 'ALL' }, pricing({ locked: true }), true))).toEqual({
      kind: 'UNITS',
      units: '100.000',
    });
  });

  it('ALL without locked lots stays FULL either way; a pending reservation refuses it', () => {
    expect(wirePlan(planRedemption({ mode: 'ALL' }, pricing(), true))).toEqual({
      kind: 'FULL',
      units: '100.000',
    });
    expect(() => planRedemption({ mode: 'ALL' }, pricing({ reserved: '1.000' }), true)).toThrow(
      expect.objectContaining({ code: 'REDEMPTION_CONFLICT_PENDING' }),
    );
  });

  it('allPlanOf: the quote shows the same decision the draft sends', () => {
    expect(allPlanOf(pricing({ locked: true }).availability, false).kind).toBe(
      'AMOUNT_WITH_RESIDUAL',
    );
    expect(allPlanOf(pricing({ locked: true }).availability, true).kind).toBe('UNITS');
  });
});

describe('sendOf and liveRefusal (submit job)', () => {
  it('reads numeric(20,4) units back at 3 dp; FP gets units, an amount, or neither (FULL)', () => {
    const units = sendOf({ amount: null, units: '25.5000' });
    expect(units.kind === 'UNITS' && units.units.toWire()).toBe('25.500');
    expect(fpSendFields(units)).toEqual({ units: '25.500' });
    expect(fpSendFields(sendOf({ amount: '5000.00', units: null }))).toEqual({ amount: '5000.00' });
    expect(fpSendFields(sendOf({ amount: null, units: null }))).toEqual({});
    expect(() => sendOf({ amount: null, units: '25.5005' })).toThrow();
  });

  it('UNITS: the flag switched off after approval → UNITS_MODE_DISABLED; FP short → INSUFFICIENT_REDEEMABLE', () => {
    const send = sendOf({ amount: null, units: '25.5000' });
    expect(liveRefusal('UNITS', send, pricing().availability, true)).toBeNull();
    expect(liveRefusal('UNITS', send, pricing().availability, false)).toBe('UNITS_MODE_DISABLED');
    expect(liveRefusal('UNITS', send, pricing({ provider: '10.000' }).availability, true)).toBe(
      'INSUFFICIENT_REDEEMABLE',
    );
  });

  it('ALL as units: ALL refusals apply live (FP short → FOLIO_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED)', () => {
    const send = sendOf({ amount: null, units: '100.0000' });
    expect(liveRefusal('ALL', send, pricing({ locked: true }).availability, true)).toBeNull();
    expect(liveRefusal('ALL', send, pricing({ provider: '90.000' }).availability, true)).toBe(
      'FOLIO_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED',
    );
  });

  it('AMOUNT and FULL keep F5 behaviour', () => {
    expect(
      liveRefusal(
        'AMOUNT',
        sendOf({ amount: '5000.00', units: null }),
        pricing().availability,
        false,
      ),
    ).toBeNull();
    expect(
      liveRefusal(
        'AMOUNT',
        sendOf({ amount: '5000.00', units: null }),
        pricing({ provider: '10.000' }).availability,
        false,
      ),
    ).toBe('INSUFFICIENT_REDEEMABLE');
    expect(liveRefusal('ALL', { kind: 'FULL' }, pricing().availability, false)).toBeNull();
    expect(
      liveRefusal('ALL', { kind: 'FULL' }, pricing({ locked: true }).availability, false),
    ).toBe('FOLIO_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED');
    expect(
      liveRefusal('ALL', { kind: 'FULL' }, pricing({ reserved: '1.000' }).availability, false),
    ).toBe('REDEMPTION_CONFLICT_PENDING');
  });
});

describe('consentSmsFields (R-10)', () => {
  const name = 'Test Flexi Cap Fund - Regular Growth';
  it('amount → CONSENT fields; units → the exact units; FULL → "all"', () => {
    expect(
      consentSmsFields(
        { kind: 'AMOUNT', amount: Money.parse('5000.00'), units: u('51.800') },
        name,
      ),
    ).toEqual({
      action: 'redeem',
      amount: '5000.00',
      schemeShort: 'Test Flexi Cap Fund - Regular ',
    });
    expect(consentSmsFields({ kind: 'UNITS', units: u('25.500') }, name)).toEqual({
      action: 'redeem',
      units: '25.500',
      schemeShort: 'Test Flexi Cap Fund - Regular ',
    });
    expect(consentSmsFields({ kind: 'FULL', units: u('100.000') }, name)).toMatchObject({
      units: 'all',
    });
  });
});
```

**3a. Domain.**

`packages/domain/src/rules/redemption-units.ts`:
```ts
import type { Units } from '@sanchay/money';
import type {
  RedeemAllDecision,
  RedemptionAvailability,
  RedemptionRefusal,
} from './redemption-availability.js';

/**
 * F6 (T5): what "Redeem all" sends once redeem-by-units is proven (P-09, `features.redeemByUnits`).
 * Part 1's decision plus `UNITS`: the exact available units at 3 dp, sent to FP as `units`.
 */
export type RedeemAllPlan = RedeemAllDecision | { readonly kind: 'UNITS'; readonly units: Units };

/**
 * D-MONEY-051 / design §F.6 MED-8 with UNITS proven: "Redeem all" with locked lots, or on a folio that
 * is not MATCHED within 24 h, sends the exact unlocked units instead of the floor2 amount, so no
 * residual is left and no NAV is needed. FULL stays FULL (neither amount nor units). The refusals part 1
 * raises before its amount fallback (a pending reservation, reconciliation, nothing available) stand;
 * the amount fallback's own refusals (NAV not OK, or an amount that floors to zero) do not apply to units.
 */
export function redeemAllByUnits(availability: RedemptionAvailability): RedeemAllPlan {
  const all = availability.all;
  if (all.kind === 'AMOUNT_WITH_RESIDUAL') {
    return { kind: 'UNITS', units: availability.availableUnits };
  }
  if (
    all.kind === 'REFUSED' &&
    (all.code === 'NAV_UNAVAILABLE' || all.code === 'INSUFFICIENT_REDEEMABLE') &&
    availability.availableUnits.isPositive()
  ) {
    return { kind: 'UNITS', units: availability.availableUnits };
  }
  return all;
}

/**
 * UNITS-mode check at draft and in the submit job's live re-check (design §F.6): positive and within
 * the available units, which are already min(ledger, FP) after other reservations. `units` is a
 * platform (3 dp) `Units`: the caller parses with `Units.platform`, which refuses a 4th decimal. Units
 * are exact, so no buffer and no NAV grade apply (design §F.6: NAV not OK → UNITS/ALL only).
 */
export function checkRedemptionUnits(
  units: Units,
  availability: RedemptionAvailability,
): RedemptionRefusal | null {
  if (!units.isPositive() || units.compare(availability.availableUnits) > 0) {
    return 'INSUFFICIENT_REDEEMABLE';
  }
  return null;
}
```

```ts
import {
  checkRedemptionAmount,
  checkRedemptionUnits,
  type RedeemAllPlan,
  type RedemptionAvailability,
  type RedemptionRefusal,
  redeemAllByUnits,
  reservationUnits,
} from '@sanchay/domain';
import { Money, type Nav, Units } from '@sanchay/money';
import { AppError } from '../platform/errors.js';

/** `orders.mode` for a redemption (E20's ORDER_MODES). UNITS only with `features.redeemByUnits` (F6). */
export type RedemptionMode = 'AMOUNT' | 'UNITS' | 'ALL';

/** A validated draft request: exactly the field its mode needs, parsed. */
export type RedemptionRequest =
  | { readonly mode: 'AMOUNT'; readonly amount: Money }
  | { readonly mode: 'UNITS'; readonly units: Units }
  | { readonly mode: 'ALL' };

/** The part of F5's `RedemptionEvaluation` a plan needs (structural, so the evaluation passes as is). */
export interface RedemptionPricing {
  readonly availability: RedemptionAvailability;
  readonly nav: Nav;
  readonly buffer: string;
}

/**
 * What a draft sends to FP and reserves (design §F.6, D-MONEY-051):
 * - AMOUNT: an amount (AMOUNT, or ALL's floor2 residual amount), reserving ceil3(amount ÷ NAV × (1 + buffer));
 * - UNITS: exact units (UNITS, or ALL as explicit unlocked units), reserving exactly those units;
 * - FULL: neither amount nor units (FP redeems the whole holding), reserving every available unit.
 */
export type RedemptionPlan =
  | { readonly kind: 'AMOUNT'; readonly amount: Money; readonly units: Units }
  | { readonly kind: 'UNITS'; readonly units: Units }
  | { readonly kind: 'FULL'; readonly units: Units };

/** What a drafted order sends, read back from its row (`orders.amount`, `orders.units`). */
export type RedemptionSend =
  | { readonly kind: 'AMOUNT'; readonly amount: Money }
  | { readonly kind: 'UNITS'; readonly units: Units }
  | { readonly kind: 'FULL' };

/** The submit job's live refusal: part 1's codes, or UNITS mode switched off after approval. */
export type LiveRefusal = RedemptionRefusal | 'UNITS_MODE_DISABLED';

function invalid(path: string, code: string, message: string): AppError {
  return new AppError('VALIDATION_FAILED', { fields: [{ path, code, message }] });
}

/**
 * Validates a draft's mode and fields before anything is read or written. UNITS needs
 * `features.redeemByUnits` (proven by probe P-09; otherwise VALIDATION_FAILED, outline F6). Each mode
 * takes exactly its own field: AMOUNT an amount, UNITS units (at most 3 dp), ALL neither.
 */
export function parseRedemptionRequest(
  input: { mode: RedemptionMode; amount?: string; units?: string },
  unitsEnabled: boolean,
): RedemptionRequest {
  switch (input.mode) {
    case 'AMOUNT':
      if (input.units !== undefined) {
        throw invalid('units', 'NOT_ALLOWED', 'Redeem by amount takes no units');
      }
      if (input.amount === undefined) throw invalid('amount', 'REQUIRED', 'Enter an amount');
      return { mode: 'AMOUNT', amount: Money.parse(input.amount) };
    case 'UNITS': {
      if (!unitsEnabled) {
        throw invalid('mode', 'NOT_ALLOWED', 'Redeem by units is not available');
      }
      if (input.amount !== undefined) {
        throw invalid('amount', 'NOT_ALLOWED', 'Redeem by units takes no amount');
      }
      if (input.units === undefined) throw invalid('units', 'REQUIRED', 'Enter the units');
      let units: Units;
      try {
        units = Units.platform(input.units);
      } catch {
        throw invalid('units', 'INVALID', 'Units have at most 3 decimal places');
      }
      return { mode: 'UNITS', units };
    }
    case 'ALL':
      if (input.amount !== undefined) {
        throw invalid('amount', 'NOT_ALLOWED', 'Redeem all takes no amount');
      }
      if (input.units !== undefined) {
        throw invalid('units', 'NOT_ALLOWED', 'Redeem all takes no units');
      }
      return { mode: 'ALL' };
  }
}

/** "Redeem all" as the quote shows it and the draft sends it: part 1's decision, or F6's units plan. */
export function allPlanOf(
  availability: RedemptionAvailability,
  unitsEnabled: boolean,
): RedeemAllPlan {
  return unitsEnabled ? redeemAllByUnits(availability) : availability.all;
}

/** D-MONEY-051 at draft, under the advisory lock, on the recomputed availability. */
export function planRedemption(
  request: RedemptionRequest,
  pricing: RedemptionPricing,
  unitsEnabled: boolean,
): RedemptionPlan {
  const a = pricing.availability;
  switch (request.mode) {
    case 'AMOUNT': {
      const refusal = checkRedemptionAmount(request.amount, a);
      if (refusal !== null) throw new AppError(refusal);
      return {
        kind: 'AMOUNT',
        amount: request.amount,
        units: reservationUnits(request.amount, pricing.nav, pricing.buffer),
      };
    }
    case 'UNITS': {
      if (!unitsEnabled) throw invalid('mode', 'NOT_ALLOWED', 'Redeem by units is not available');
      const refusal = checkRedemptionUnits(request.units, a);
      if (refusal !== null) throw new AppError(refusal);
      return { kind: 'UNITS', units: request.units };
    }
    case 'ALL': {
      const all = allPlanOf(a, unitsEnabled);
      switch (all.kind) {
        case 'REFUSED':
          throw new AppError(all.code);
        case 'FULL':
          return { kind: 'FULL', units: all.units };
        case 'UNITS':
          return { kind: 'UNITS', units: all.units };
        case 'AMOUNT_WITH_RESIDUAL':
          return {
            kind: 'AMOUNT',
            amount: all.amount,
            units: reservationUnits(all.amount, pricing.nav, pricing.buffer),
          };
      }
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Reads back what an order sends. `orders.units` is E20's numeric(20,4), so PostgreSQL returns
 * "25.5000"; `Units.platform` accepts it (trailing zeros) and refuses a real 4th decimal.
 */
export function sendOf(order: { amount: string | null; units: string | null }): RedemptionSend {
  if (order.units !== null) return { kind: 'UNITS', units: Units.platform(order.units) };
  if (order.amount !== null) return { kind: 'AMOUNT', amount: Money.parse(order.amount) };
  return { kind: 'FULL' };
}

/**
 * The amount-or-units part of `POST /v2/mf_redemptions` (research fp-api §3.4): an amount, units
 * (P-09 must prove FP accepts them on the ONDC gateway), or neither for the whole holding.
 */
export function fpSendFields(send: RedemptionSend): { amount?: string; units?: string } {
  switch (send.kind) {
    case 'AMOUNT':
      return { amount: send.amount.toWire() };
    case 'UNITS':
      return { units: send.units.toWire() };
    case 'FULL':
      return {};
  }
}

/**
 * R-09 live re-check in the submit job against the order as drafted, with FP's live redeemable units
 * and the order's own reservation excluded:
 * - FULL still needs ALL to be FULL (F5);
 * - an amount must still fit under the buffered maximum (F5);
 * - units need the flag still on (a flag switched off after approval stops the order before any FP
 *   write), ALL's refusals when the order is an ALL, and the units within what is available.
 */
export function liveRefusal(
  mode: RedemptionMode,
  send: RedemptionSend,
  availability: RedemptionAvailability,
  unitsEnabled: boolean,
): LiveRefusal | null {
  switch (send.kind) {
    case 'FULL': {
      const all = availability.all;
      if (all.kind === 'FULL') return null;
      return all.kind === 'REFUSED' ? all.code : 'FOLIO_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED';
    }
    case 'AMOUNT':
      return checkRedemptionAmount(send.amount, availability);
    case 'UNITS': {
      if (!unitsEnabled) return 'UNITS_MODE_DISABLED';
      if (mode === 'ALL') {
        const all = redeemAllByUnits(availability);
        if (all.kind === 'REFUSED') return all.code;
      }
      return checkRedemptionUnits(send.units, availability);
    }
  }
}

/**
 * R-10 SMS fields for the REDEMPTION challenge: an amount renders SANCHAY_CONSENT_OTP_V1 ("redeem Rs X");
 * units render SANCHAY_CONSENT_UNITS_OTP_V1 with the exact units; FULL renders it with "all". E3's
 * `consentSmsFor` picks the units template whenever `units` is set.
 */
export function consentSmsFields(plan: RedemptionPlan, schemeName: string): Record<string, string> {
  const schemeShort = schemeName.slice(0, 30);
  switch (plan.kind) {
    case 'AMOUNT':
      return { action: 'redeem', amount: plan.amount.toWire(), schemeShort };
    case 'UNITS':
      return { action: 'redeem', units: plan.units.toWire(), schemeShort };
    case 'FULL':
      return { action: 'redeem', units: 'all', schemeShort };
  }
}
```

**3e. The PO-2 escalation record.**

`docs/probes/redeem-by-units-p09.md`:
```markdown
# Probe P-09 (units): redeem by units on the ONDC gateway

**Status: escalated under PO-2, probe not yet run.** `features.redeemByUnits=false` (the D1 default) until this probe passes and the owner signs the flip below.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Capability | Redeem by units (decision 4; D-MONEY-051 UNITS; trim T5) |
| Flag | `features.redeemByUnits` (`app_config`; read at quote, at draft and in `orders.redemption.submit`) |
| Code | F6: UNITS mode and "Redeem all" as explicit units, both behind the flag |
| Evidence needed | A sandbox run that meets every item in "What P-09 must show" |
| Decision owner | PO (PO-2: wait, amend decision 4 in writing, or change rail) |
| Gate | G9: proven on sandbox or prod evidence, or a PO-signed amendment |

## Why this is escalated, not assumed

FP's sources disagree (research `docs/research/fp-api.md` §3.4 and conflict 4):

- The API reference rejects `units` with "Redemption by units only allowed for rta gateway".
- The POA capability page lists ONDC folios as supporting redemption "by units, amount, redeem all".
- v1 sent `units` with `gateway: "ondc"`, but no evidence of a settled v1 units redemption has been found.

Sanchay sends every order through `gateway: "ondc"` (cybrillapoa). The RTA route is no longer offered. The spec does not allow quietly hiding the capability, so it is recorded here.

## What P-09 must show (FP sandbox, cybrillapoa tenant)

1. `POST /v2/mf_redemptions {mf_investment_account, scheme, folio_number, units: "<3 dp>", user_ip, source_ref_id, gateway: "ondc"}` with **no** `amount` is accepted, not rejected with a 4xx.
2. The single `PATCH {id, state: "confirmed", consent}` takes it to `submitted`, the same as an amount redemption.
3. At `successful`, `redeemed_units` equals the requested units to 3 dp. FP must not substitute a whole-holding redemption. Production catches that case as the WARNING break `REDEMPTION_UNITS_DIFFER`, but only after the fact.
4. The same holds for a folio with locked ELSS units when the requested units equal the unlocked units ("Redeem all" as explicit units, MED-8).
5. Whether FP enforces a withdrawal minimum or `units_multiple`. Sanchay does not check either (`schemes.thresholds` carries no withdrawal fields), so FP's 4xx is the only check.

Record the run ids, request and response bodies (redact PII), and the date in this file.

## Until then

- A UNITS draft is refused with `VALIDATION_FAILED`. "Redeem all" with locked units sends the floor2 amount, with the residual note and **Redeem remaining** (D-MONEY-051 fallback).
- The apps read `meta.appConfig.flags.redeemByUnits`. They show that redeem by units is not available yet rather than hiding it (F17).
- GO-1 does not depend on this: AMOUNT and ALL carry the redemption gate (F20 canary).

## Flipping the flag (only after the evidence above and the PO's sign-off)

1. Append the evidence and the PO's written approval to this file.
2. Only an audited, two-founder command may write `features.redeemByUnits`. F7's CLI has none for this key: `ops:kill-switch` writes only `orders.enabled`, `ops:sip-switch` only `plans.sip.enabled`, and `sanchay_readonly` cannot write. Un-skipping F6 therefore includes adding a units switch that mirrors `ops:sip-switch` exactly: `--on --approver1 <a> --approver2 <b> --reason <text>` and `--off --by <handle> --reason <text>`, its own audit action, registered in `OPS_COMMANDS` the way F7 registers its commands and run through F7's documented run-task override form. With that command in place, turning the flag on needs no deploy: it is read on every quote, draft and submit.
3. To stop units orders (FP withdraws support, or a `REDEMPTION_UNITS_DIFFER` break appears), one founder turns it off with that command's `--off`. Approved units orders not yet sent are refused before any FP write (`UNITS_MODE_DISABLED`, units released). Orders already at FP finish on FP's outcome.

## Re-check

P-09 is due with the S1 probes (business checklist PB-12, by Fri 10-16; Cybrilla's written answer PB-13, OX-10). If the probe has not passed by the feature freeze (Fri 11-20), the flag stays `false` for the pilot. In that case, update the status line to say so and have the PO choose a PO-2 option before the S22 go/no-go.
```

- **Rules pinned here** (spec §1 recon row, §2 DB roles, §4.1, §4.4, §4.6, §5; D-MONEY-040, D-MONEY-053, D-MONEY-066, D-MONEY-071; R-16, R-17, R-20; BRIEF D1, D5, D6):
  - **Invariants (hourly, read-only SQL, every violation CRITICAL).** The MVP spec names "M1, M3, M4" and D-MONEY-071 defines them, so the numbering follows the register; the outline's own two ledger checks run too:
    - **M1:** every one-time order, plan and mandate with an FP id has a `consent_subjects` row (CONSENTED) whose challenge is CONSUMED, belongs to the same investor, has `consumed_at`, and whose `consent_records.first_attempt_at` is set and not before `consumed_at`. SIP instalments are FP-raised under the plan's consent and are checked through the plan. A CONSUMED_UNUSED challenge does not count: under RV-03-1 it means no P/M write followed it.
    - **M2 (lot conservation; the outline's "ledger units = Σ lots"):** for every lot, `units − units_remaining = Σ lot_consumptions.units`; a REVERSED lot has no consumption.
    - **M3:** at most one SUCCESS payment attempt per order (the defence behind E21's `payment_attempts_success_uq`).
    - **M4:** every SETTLED purchase has exactly one live (non-REVERSED) lot holding the allotted units, and no lot exists for a purchase that is not SETTLED or REVERSED.
    - **Reservations (the outline's "M4"):** Σ ACTIVE `redemption_reservations.units_reserved` per (folio, scheme) never exceeds Σ OPEN `lots.units_remaining`. Every OPEN lot counts, locked or not (lock-in is F5's draft-time rule and only ever unlocks), and a stale draft's reservation counts until F5 releases it.
    - A break whose violation is gone is RESOLVED on the next run, so the open CRITICAL count is what is wrong now; no person resolves an `INVARIANT_*` break.
  - **recon.fp.daily (02:00, read-only):** per investor with an FP account, FP's purchases, plans, redemptions and folios are listed (outside any transaction) and compared with our rows. An FP object is ours when its id is on one of our rows, its `source_ref_id` is one of our row ids (LOOKUP-ADOPT pending), or it is an instalment of one of our plans; anything else is a CRITICAL `RECON_FP_OBJECT_UNKNOWN`. Lag the sweeps close on their own is quiet; an outcome disagreement (money in at FP, failed with us, or the reverse, or a reversal of a SETTLED order) is CRITICAL `RECON_ORDER_OUTCOME_DIFFERS`; other odd pairs are F4's WARNING `FP_ORDER_STATE_UNEXPECTED`. Units are not compared: F4's `folio.sync` (05:00) owns that, so this job adds only "FP holds a folio we have no row for" (`RECON_FOLIO_UNKNOWN`). A failing FP read opens `RECON_FP_DAILY_FAILED` for that investor and the sweep moves on.
  - **Redemption saga backstop (every 5 minutes).** F5's jobs re-enqueue themselves, but D2's `Jobs.enqueue` retries a failed job 3 times with no delay, so a holdings read that fails a little longer, or a lost `orders.redemption.advance` chain, would leave the redemption (and its ACTIVE reservation) where it stopped; RV-03-1's sweep touches only the challenge. The backstop re-enqueues F5's own jobs with their own singleton keys (the advance job for UNDER_REVIEW/CONFIRMING; the submit job with approve's data for an approved redemption), so a job still queued dedupes it. For an approved redemption it applies `useConsumed`'s deadline (`execute_before` until the first attempt is stamped, `saga_expires_at` after it): inside it, resubmit once approve is 2 minutes old; within 2 minutes after it, wait (an attempt that passed the check may still reach SUBMITTING); later, or with a CONSUMED_UNUSED challenge, F5's own CONSENT_EXPIRED path under a row lock. It never calls FP and never touches a submitted order: PROCESSING and UNITS_PENDING belong to F4's `orders.units.reconcile`.
  - **Ops CLIs (spec §4.6, D-MONEY-066):** run as `SANCHAY_APP_ROLE=ops`; the session role is pinned to `sanchay_app` with the libpq startup option `-c role=sanchay_app` and the process refuses to start if that role could run DDL (superuser, `rds_superuser`, or CREATE on the database, `app` or `public`). They never call FP and never write an order, plan or mandate status (a unit test scans every registered command's source). `ops:sync` writes a re-fetch request and enqueues the webhook job (`fp.event.process`), or `fp.reconcile.nonfinal` for a RECONCILING order. A freeze (`ops:kill-switch --off`, `ops:sip-switch --off`) is one actor and never waits for a second person; anything that turns money flow back on or records money evidence (`--on`, `ops:refund-utr`, `ops:payout-ref`, `ops:nav-release`, `ops:resolve-break`) needs two different founders; `ops:invite` is one founder (D7). Every command writes one `audit_events` row (R-20), and `ops:invite` writes one per invited mobile (D7's `PilotInvites.add`); operator ids are handles, never names or emails; a mobile is printed only as its last 4 digits and never passed on a command line (FR-21): a RunTask's `containerOverrides.command` stays in CloudTrail and on the stopped task, so a deployed `ops:invite` reads an SSM SecureString under `/sanchay/{env}/invites/` that the operator deletes after the run, and a local one reads a file.
  - **Ops views:** every column is listed by name; none is `*_enc`, `*_bidx`, an IP, a user agent, a contact, a bank field or a bank reference, and `sanchay_readonly` gets SELECT on these six views and on no base table. `v_reconciling_orders.reconciling_since` is F1's gauge rule: the latest move into RECONCILING whose `from_status` differs, so the `fp.reconcile.nonfinal.miss` self-events never reset it.
  - **Alarms:** F1's `ops.gauges.emit` reads `recon_breaks` (`criticalBreaksOpen`, alarm `sanchay-prod-money-invariant-breach`) and `order_events` (`reconcilingOverSla`, alarm `sanchay-prod-reconciling-sla`) directly; F7 emits no metric. `ops:resolve-break` is how a handled non-invariant CRITICAL break leaves the open count, so the alarm returns to OK and pages on the next one.
- **Deviations from the outline:**
  1. **M-numbering.** The outline calls "ledger units = Σ lots" M3 and "reservations ≤ available" M4; D-MONEY-071 (which the spec's "M1, M3, M4" refers to) makes M3 "≤ 1 SUCCESS payment per order" and M4 "exactly one lot per SETTLED purchase". All five checks run; the kinds carry the register's numbers and the reservation check has its own name. See the open question for the owner.
  2. **`ops:payout-ref`.** Spec §4.4 credits a redemption payout "on evidence (FP payout reference, or ops-recorded bank credit reference via CLI with two-founder approval)", and F5's `payout.watch` reads `orders.payout_ref` for it. The CLI writes only the reference; `payout.watch` moves the payout to CREDITED.
  3. **`payment_attempts.refund_ref` and `refund_recorded_at`** are added (spec §2.3 lists `refund_ref`; E21 did not create it), so `ops:refund-utr` has somewhere to record the UTR.
  4. **Files beyond the outline's list:** `ops-common.ts`, `ops-db.ts`, `ops-runner.ts`, `ops.ts` (shared CLI plumbing and the role guard), `ops-sip-switch.ts` and `ops-resolve-break.ts` (below), `recon-rules.ts`, `invariant-checks.ts` (pure or SQL-only modules, testable without Nest), `recon.module.ts`, and the edits listed under **Files** (E20's `fp.reconcile.nonfinal`, which the outline's Produces extends; FakeFp's `purchase.list`; D2's registry and schedules; D7's and D9's CLIs; one F5 test).
  5. **`ops:sync` reuses the webhook path.** The outline's test says "enqueues fp.event.process only". E1's job takes `{eventRowId}`, so `ops:sync` records the request as an `inbound_webhook_events` row (`event_type = 'ops.sync'`, signature mode NONE, no payload) in the same transaction as the enqueue; the worker then re-fetches and applies it through the same handler as a webhook. Such a row is not a signed FP webhook, so any count of signature-verified webhooks (F20's canary evidence) must exclude `event_type = 'ops.sync'`.
  6. **The redemption branch of LOOKUP-ADOPT lists by investment account** and matches `source_ref_id` here, instead of adding a `sourceRefId` parameter to D3's `FpRead.redemptions` (F5's note suggested either; this keeps D3 unchanged and works with F5's FakeFp route, which filters on both).
  7. **D7's `ops:invite` and D9's `ops:nav-release` run through the ops runner (BRIEF D5).** As standalone scripts they skipped the `sanchay_app` pin and the DDL guard (R-16), and `node dist/main.js ops:invite` printed the usage. F7 rewrites both files as `OpsCommand`s with D7's and D9's logic (D7's `PilotInvites.add` and 30-day lifetime; D9's quarantine release with two founders), masks the mobile to its last 4 digits, and repoints both `pnpm` scripts at the runner. `ops:invite` takes a list rather than D7's single `--mobile`: one mobile per line, read from an SSM SecureString in a deployed run or from a file locally, never from argv (FR-21). It writes every invite and its audit row in one transaction, all or none.
  8. **`ops:sip-switch` (BRIEF D5)** flips `plans.sip.enabled` exactly as `ops:kill-switch` flips `orders.enabled` (one shared `appConfigSwitch`), with its own audit action `OPS_SIP_SWITCH`: GO-2 and the canary's SIP leg (F20, F23) need an audited way to enable SIPs.
  9. **`ops:resolve-break` (two founders, audited).** Only invariant breaks resolve themselves; every other CRITICAL break (`LEDGER_UNITS_SHORTFALL`, `MANDATE_CREATE_AMBIGUOUS`, `REDEMPTION_EXIT_INVALID`, `PLAN_CANCEL_UNRESOLVED`, `RECON_FP_OBJECT_UNKNOWN`, …) had no way out, so F1's `criticalBreaksOpen > 0` alarm would stay in ALARM after the first one and stop paging on new ones.

**Review fixes (assembly, 2026-10-01; BRIEF D1, D5, D6, D8, defects-F7):**
1. **Metrics (major).** `ops-metrics.ts`, its test, both `emitOpsMetrics` calls and the `readOpsMetrics` assertions are gone, with the F1-draft names (`ReconBreaksOpenCritical`, `OrdersReconcilingOverTwoHours`, namespace `Sanchay`). F1's `ops.gauges.emit` feeds every alarm. The runbook uses F1's alarm names (`sanchay-prod-money-invariant-breach`, `sanchay-prod-reconciling-sla`) and service (`sanchay-app`), and `v_reconciling_orders.reconciling_since` now follows F1's rule (a miss self-event does not reset it; a test pins it).
2. **F5's RECONCILING test (major).** With F7's LOOKUP-ADOPT, F5's "nothing released while RECONCILING" case now expects UNDER_REVIEW after the first `fp.reconcile.nonfinal` run (FP id set, reservation still ACTIVE, `orders.redemption.advance` enqueued, the quote still `REDEMPTION_CONFLICT_PENDING`). F7 edits it and stages the file.
3. **Redemption saga backstop (major).** `fp.reconcile.nonfinal` re-drives UNDER_REVIEW/CONFIRMING and approved redemptions through F5's own jobs and expires approved ones whose consent can no longer be used, releasing their units (`redemptionResumeAction`, 9 unit cases, 4 integration cases).
4. **`ops:resolve-break` (minor)**, deviation 9.
5. **Views (minor).** `v_units_pending` drops the purchase-only filter and shows `type` (F5's UNITS_PENDING redemptions); `v_reconciling_orders` shows `mode` and `units` on the orders arm (NULL on the plan and mandate arms); `v_payouts_due` shows `payout_expected_on`, `payout_due_by` and `payout_ref_recorded` (the F24 runbooks read them).
6. **BRIEF D5.** `ops:invite`, `ops:nav-release` and `ops:sip-switch` join `OPS_COMMANDS`; the migration adds `v_ops_audit` and `v_pilot_invites_count`; the registration pattern and the deployed run form are published above for F20, F23 and F24–F27.
7. **BRIEF D1.** `runOpsCli` builds its context with `{ ...NEST_APP_OPTIONS, bufferLogs: true }` and the nestjs-pino logger.
8. **BRIEF D6.** Deployed ops runs use F1's ops task definition (`sanchay_app_login`), never the migrate task definition (`sanchay_master`); the E25 master-user erratum F7 raised is resolved by D6.
9. **BRIEF D8.** Test filters are passed without `--`.
10. **Boundary test.** It now checks that every `OPS_COMMANDS` entry's module is scanned, and its status pattern targets `orders`, `plans` and `mandates` only (`ops:resolve-break` legitimately writes `recon_breaks.status`), with a self-test that the patterns catch what they guard against.
11. **Contexts in tests** come from `opsContextOf(t.app)`, the same function `runOpsCli` uses, instead of a hand-built object.

**Round 2 fixes (2026-10-01; ROUND2 "Agent B"):**
1. **FR-14 (minor).** The open-CRITICAL-break alarm is now named `sanchay-prod-money-invariant-breach` everywhere, the name F1 pins for `criticalBreaksOpen > 0`. That covers Consumes, the Alarms rule, review note 1, two code comments and the two runbook rows; F7's draft name is gone.
2. **FR-21 (minor; "FR-20" in ROUND2).** A deployed `ops:invite` no longer carries a mobile in RunTask's `containerOverrides.command`, which CloudTrail keeps and the ECS console shows on stopped tasks.
   - It reads the list from an SSM SecureString (`--mobiles-param /sanchay/{env}/invites/<name>`) with the ops task role. F1 grants that role `ssm:GetParameter` on that prefix only. The runbook has the operator put the parameter, run the task and then delete it.
   - Locally and in tests the list comes from `--mobiles-file <path>`. `--mobile` is gone.
   - The repo has no SSM client, and the catalog is closed (Plan 01's A1 rule: nobody edits `catalog:`). So `ops-inputs.ts` signs the single `GetParameter` call with SigV4 over `node:crypto` and `fetch`. Its test pins the signer to AWS's published vectors.
   - The list is invited all or none, with one `PILOT_INVITE_ADDED` row per invite.
3. **Deployed run form.** It runs on F1's ops task definition by family, `--task-definition sanchay-{env}-ops` (the stack output `OpsTaskDefinitionArn` is its latest revision), container `ops`. The `SANCHAY_APP_ROLE` override is dropped because F1's container already sets it. It never runs on `sanchay-{env}-migrate`, which logs in as the master.
4. **`opsContextOf(app)`** is named in Produces as the one builder later tasks' tests use (F20, F23, F27). `OpsContext` gains `inputs`.
5. **FR-10.** Plan 02 D7 relaxes Plan 01's `audit.int.test.ts` pins to `arrayContaining`, so F7's three `AUDIT_DATA_ALLOWLIST` keys need no test edit.
6. **Stale dist (FR-6/FR-7).** F7 changes nothing under `packages/`, so the rule's build line is not required here. Steps 4 and 5 still start with it, at no cost when it is a cache hit, because the API typecheck and tests read `@sanchay/domain` and `@sanchay/contract` from `dist`.

```ts
describe('ops CLI boundary (R-16, spec §4.6)', () => {
  // Every OPS_COMMANDS module, the runner and any helper they import from cli/ (paths relative to this
  // folder). A task that registers a command appends its files here; the registry check fails until it does.
  const sources = [
    'ops-runner.ts',
    'ops-sync.ts',
    'ops-kill-switch.ts',
    'ops-sip-switch.ts',
    'ops-refund-utr.ts',
    'ops-payout-ref.ts',
    'ops-invite.ts',
    'ops-inputs.ts',
    'ops-nav-release.ts',
    'ops-resolve-break.ts',
  ].map((file) => [file, readFileSync(new URL(`./${file}`, import.meta.url), 'utf8')] as const);

  const FP_IMPORT = /integrations\/fp\//;
  const MOVE_CALL = /\bmove(?:Order|Plan|Mandate)\(/;
  /** A Drizzle `.update(orders|plans|mandates).set({…status…})`, payoutStatus and fpStatus included. */
  const STATUS_SET =
    /\.update\((?:orders|plans|mandates)\)\s*\.set\(\{[^}]*\b(?:status|[a-z]+Status)\s*:/;
  const STATUS_SQL = /UPDATE\s+(?:"?app"?\.)?"?(?:orders|plans|mandates)"?\s+SET\b[^;]*\bstatus\b/i;

  it('scans the module of every command registered in OPS_COMMANDS', () => {
    const runner = sources.find(([file]) => file === 'ops-runner.ts')?.[1] ?? '';
    const registered = [...runner.matchAll(/^\s*'(ops:[a-z0-9-]+)':/gm)].map((m) => m[1] ?? '');
    expect(registered).toContain('ops:sync');
    const files = sources.map(([file]) => file);
    for (const name of registered) expect(files).toContain(`${name.replace(':', '-')}.ts`);
  });

  it('the scan patterns catch what they guard against', () => {
    expect("await tx.update(orders)\n  .set({ status: 'FAILED' })").toMatch(STATUS_SET);
    expect("db.update(mandates).set({ fpStatus: 'X', updatedAt })").toMatch(STATUS_SET);
    expect('tx.update(orders).set({ payoutRef: ref, payoutUpdatedAt: now })').not.toMatch(
      STATUS_SET,
    );
    expect("UPDATE app.orders SET status = 'FAILED'").toMatch(STATUS_SQL);
    expect("await moveOrder(tx, order, 'FAILED', 'x')").toMatch(MOVE_CALL);
    expect("import { FpRead } from '../integrations/fp/fp-read.js'").toMatch(FP_IMPORT);
  });

  it.each(sources)('%s never imports an FP client', (_file, source) => {
    expect(source).not.toMatch(FP_IMPORT);
  });

  it.each(sources)('%s never writes an order, plan or mandate status', (_file, source) => {
    expect(source).not.toMatch(MOVE_CALL);
    expect(source).not.toMatch(STATUS_SET);
    expect(source).not.toMatch(STATUS_SQL);
  });
});
```

`apps/api/src/cli/ops-inputs.test.ts` (FR-21: where ops:invite's mobiles come from; SigV4 pinned to AWS's published vectors):
```ts
import { mkdtempSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { OpsCliError } from './ops-common.js';
import {
  type OpsInputsDeps,
  opsInputsFor,
  sigV4Authorization,
  sigV4SigningKey,
} from './ops-inputs.js';

// AWS's own published SigV4 examples (the IAM "derive a signing key" example and the
// aws-sig-v4-test-suite get-vanilla, post-vanilla and post-x-www-form-urlencoded cases). Their
// credentials are AWS's documented fakes; the second half is joined at runtime so no secret scanner
// mistakes the fixture for a live key.
const SUITE_ID = 'AKIDEXAMPLE';
const SUITE_SIGNER = ['wJalrXUtnFEMI', 'K7MDENG+bPxRfiCYEXAMPLEKEY'].join('/');
const suite = { accessKeyId: SUITE_ID, secretAccessKey: SUITE_SIGNER };
const suiteRequest = (method: string, headers: Record<string, string>, body: string) =>
  sigV4Authorization(
    {
      method,
      host: 'example.amazonaws.com',
      path: '/',
      headers: { 'x-amz-date': '20150830T123600Z', ...headers },
      body,
      region: 'us-east-1',
      service: 'service',
      amzDate: '20150830T123600Z',
    },
    suite,
  );

describe('SigV4 (AWS published vectors)', () => {
  it('derives the documented signing key', () => {
    expect(sigV4SigningKey(SUITE_SIGNER, '20120215', 'us-east-1', 'iam').toString('hex')).toBe(
      'f4780e2d9f65fa895f9c67b32ce1baf0b0d8a43505a000a1a9e090d414db404d',
    );
  });

  it.each([
    [
      'get-vanilla',
      'GET',
      {},
      '',
      'host;x-amz-date',
      '5fa00fa31553b73ebf1942676e86291e8372ff2a2260956d9b8aae1d763fbf31',
    ],
    [
      'post-vanilla',
      'POST',
      {},
      '',
      'host;x-amz-date',
      '5da7c1a2acd57cee7505fc6676e4e544621c30862966e37dddb68e92efbe5d6b',
    ],
    [
      'post-x-www-form-urlencoded',
      'POST',
      { 'content-type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
      'Param1=value1',
      'content-type;host;x-amz-date',
      'ff11897932ad3f4e8b18135d722051e5ac45fc38421b1da7b9d196a0fe09473a',
    ],
  ])('%s', (_name, method, headers, body, signed, signature) => {
    expect(suiteRequest(method, headers, body)).toBe(
      `AWS4-HMAC-SHA256 Credential=${SUITE_ID}/20150830/us-east-1/service/aws4_request, SignedHeaders=${signed}, Signature=${signature}`,
    );
  });
});

const NAME = '/sanchay/prod/invites/pilot-2026-11';
const LIST = '9876500101\n9876500102\n';

interface Call {
  url: string;
  init: RequestInit | undefined;
}

/** A fake of the ECS credential endpoint and SSM; `reply` answers the SSM call. */
function harness(
  reply: { status: number; body: unknown },
  processEnv: OpsInputsDeps['processEnv'] = {
    AWS_REGION: 'ap-south-1',
    AWS_CONTAINER_CREDENTIALS_RELATIVE_URI: '/v2/credentials/ops-task',
  },
) {
  const calls: Call[] = [];
  const fake = (async (input: string | URL | Request, init?: RequestInit) => {
    const url = String(input);
    calls.push({ url, init });
    if (url.startsWith('http://169.254.170.2/')) {
      return Response.json({
        AccessKeyId: 'ASIATESTONLY',
        SecretAccessKey: 'sanchay_test_only',
        Token: 'sanchay_test_only',
      });
    }
    return Response.json(reply.body, { status: reply.status });
  }) as typeof fetch;
  const inputs = opsInputsFor({
    appEnv: 'prod',
    processEnv,
    fetch: fake,
    now: () => new Date('2026-10-01T12:00:00.000Z'),
  });
  return { inputs, calls };
}

const refusalOf = async (run: () => Promise<unknown>): Promise<OpsCliError> => {
  const err = await run().then(
    () => undefined,
    (e: unknown) => e,
  );
  expect(err).toBeInstanceOf(OpsCliError);
  return err as OpsCliError;
};

describe('opsInputsFor: --mobiles-param (an SSM SecureString read with the ops task role)', () => {
  it('reads the task-role credentials, then POSTs a signed GetParameter with decryption', async () => {
    const { inputs, calls } = harness({
      status: 200,
      body: { Parameter: { Name: NAME, Type: 'SecureString', Value: LIST, Version: 1 } },
    });
    await expect(inputs.ssmSecureString(NAME)).resolves.toBe(LIST);
    expect(calls.map((c) => c.url)).toEqual([
      'http://169.254.170.2/v2/credentials/ops-task',
      'https://ssm.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/',
    ]);
    const init = calls[1]?.init;
    expect(init?.method).toBe('POST');
    expect(JSON.parse(String(init?.body))).toEqual({ Name: NAME, WithDecryption: true });
    const headers = (init?.headers ?? {}) as Record<string, string>;
    expect(headers).toMatchObject({
      'content-type': 'application/x-amz-json-1.1',
      'x-amz-target': 'AmazonSSM.GetParameter',
      'x-amz-date': '20261001T120000Z',
      'x-amz-security-token': 'sanchay_test_only',
    });
    expect(headers.authorization).toMatch(
      /^AWS4-HMAC-SHA256 Credential=ASIATESTONLY\/20261001\/ap-south-1\/ssm\/aws4_request, SignedHeaders=content-type;host;x-amz-date;x-amz-security-token;x-amz-target, Signature=[0-9a-f]{64}$/,
    );
  });

  it.each([
    [
      'another environment',
      '/sanchay/dev/invites/pilot-2026-11',
      /must be \/sanchay\/prod\/invites\/<name>/,
    ],
    ['a name outside invites/', '/sanchay/prod/db-app', /must be \/sanchay\/prod\/invites\/<name>/],
    [
      'an upper-case or spaced leaf',
      '/sanchay/prod/invites/Pilot 1',
      /must be \/sanchay\/prod\/invites\/<name>/,
    ],
  ])('refuses %s before any call', async (_case, name, message) => {
    const { inputs, calls } = harness({ status: 200, body: {} });
    expect((await refusalOf(() => inputs.ssmSecureString(name))).message).toMatch(message);
    expect(calls).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('refuses outside an ECS task (no credential endpoint) and without a region', async () => {
    const local = harness({ status: 200, body: {} }, { AWS_REGION: 'ap-south-1' });
    expect((await refusalOf(() => local.inputs.ssmSecureString(NAME))).message).toMatch(
      /needs the ops task role/,
    );
    const noRegion = harness(
      { status: 200, body: {} },
      { AWS_CONTAINER_CREDENTIALS_RELATIVE_URI: '/v2/credentials/ops-task' },
    );
    expect((await refusalOf(() => noRegion.inputs.ssmSecureString(NAME))).message).toMatch(
      /needs AWS_REGION/,
    );
    expect([...local.calls, ...noRegion.calls]).toEqual([]);
  });

  it.each([
    [
      400,
      { __type: 'ParameterNotFound', message: 'x' },
      /no SSM parameter \/sanchay\/prod\/invites\/pilot-2026-11: put it first/,
    ],
    [
      400,
      { __type: 'AccessDeniedException', Message: 'x' },
      /SSM refused to read .* \(AccessDeniedException\)/,
    ],
    [500, null, /SSM refused to read .* \(HTTP 500\)/],
  ])('maps SSM error %i %j to a refusal', async (status, body, message) => {
    const { inputs } = harness({ status, body });
    expect((await refusalOf(() => inputs.ssmSecureString(NAME))).message).toMatch(message);
  });

  it('refuses a plain String parameter without ever printing its value', async () => {
    const { inputs } = harness({
      status: 200,
      body: { Parameter: { Name: NAME, Type: 'String', Value: LIST } },
    });
    const err = await refusalOf(() => inputs.ssmSecureString(NAME));
    expect(err.message).toMatch(/must be a SecureString/);
    expect(err.message).not.toContain('98765');
  });

  it('turns a network failure into a refusal', async () => {
    const inputs = opsInputsFor({
      appEnv: 'prod',
      processEnv: { AWS_REGION: 'ap-south-1', AWS_CONTAINER_CREDENTIALS_RELATIVE_URI: '/v2/c' },
      fetch: (async () => {
        throw new TypeError('fetch failed');
      }) as typeof fetch,
      now: () => new Date(),
    });
    expect((await refusalOf(() => inputs.ssmSecureString(NAME))).message).toBe(
      'could not reach the ECS credential endpoint (TypeError)',
    );
  });
});

describe('opsInputsFor: --mobiles-file (local and test only)', () => {
  const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'ops-inputs-'));
  const path = join(dir, 'invites.txt');
  writeFileSync(path, LIST, 'utf8');
  const inputsIn = (appEnv: OpsInputsDeps['appEnv']) =>
    opsInputsFor({ appEnv, processEnv: {}, fetch, now: () => new Date() });

  it.each(['local', 'test'] as const)('reads the file in %s', async (appEnv) => {
    await expect(inputsIn(appEnv).localFile(path)).resolves.toBe(LIST);
  });

  it.each(['dev', 'staging', 'prod'] as const)('refuses it in %s', async (appEnv) => {
    expect((await refusalOf(() => inputsIn(appEnv).localFile(path))).message).toMatch(
      /--mobiles-file is for SANCHAY_APP_ENV local and test/,
    );
  });

  it('refuses a file it cannot read', async () => {
    expect(
      (await refusalOf(() => inputsIn('local').localFile(join(dir, 'nope.txt')))).message,
    ).toMatch(/could not read --mobiles-file/);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { OpsCliError } from './ops-common.js';
import { INVITE_BATCH_MAX, inviteMobile, maskMobile, parseInviteList } from './ops-invite.js';

/** The byte-order mark Notepad-style editors may write at the start of a UTF-8 file. */
const BOM = String.fromCharCode(0xfeff);

describe('inviteMobile and maskMobile', () => {
  it.each(['+91 98765 00101', '919876500101', '98765-00101', ' 9876500101\r'])(
    'reads %j as 9876500101',
    (raw) => {
      expect(inviteMobile(raw)).toBe('9876500101');
    },
  );

  it.each(['98765001011', '1234567890', '98765-0010', 'Ravi 9876500101', ''])(
    'refuses %j',
    (raw) => {
      expect(inviteMobile(raw)).toBeNull();
    },
  );

  it('prints only the last 4 digits', () => {
    expect(maskMobile('9876500101')).toBe('******0101');
  });
});

describe('parseInviteList (one mobile per line; refusals name lines, never values)', () => {
  it('reads LF or CRLF lines, drops a leading BOM, blank lines and a +91 prefix', () => {
    expect(parseInviteList(`${BOM}+91 98765 00101\r\n\r\n9876500102\n  \n`)).toEqual([
      '9876500101',
      '9876500102',
    ]);
  });

  it.each([
    [
      '9876500101\n98765001011\nRavi 9876500103\n',
      /^lines 2, 3 of the invite list are not a 10-digit/,
    ],
    ['9876500101\n+91 98765 00101\n', /^line 2 of the invite list repeats an earlier mobile$/],
    ['\n \r\n', /^the invite list has no mobile number$/],
  ])('refuses %j', (text, message) => {
    let err: unknown;
    try {
      parseInviteList(text);
    } catch (e) {
      err = e;
    }
    expect(err).toBeInstanceOf(OpsCliError);
    expect((err as Error).message).toMatch(message);
    expect((err as Error).message).not.toMatch(/98765/);
  });

  it(`refuses more than ${INVITE_BATCH_MAX} mobiles`, () => {
    const list = Array.from({ length: INVITE_BATCH_MAX + 1 }, (_, i) => String(9_000_000_000 + i));
    expect(() => parseInviteList(list.join('\n'))).toThrow(/more than 300 mobiles; split it/);
    expect(parseInviteList(list.slice(0, INVITE_BATCH_MAX).join('\n'))).toHaveLength(
      INVITE_BATCH_MAX,
    );
  });
});
```

`apps/api/test/int/recon-seed.ts`:
```ts
import { randomBytes } from 'node:crypto';
import type { ConsentSubjectType, MandateStatus, PlanStatus } from '@sanchay/domain';
import { and, eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import {
  consentChallenges,
  consentRecords,
  consentSubjects,
} from '../../src/modules/legal-consent/legal-consent.schema.js';
import { mandates, plans } from '../../src/modules/plans/plans.schema.js';
import { newId } from '../../src/modules/platform/ids.js';
import { reconBreaks } from '../../src/modules/platform/kernel.schema.js';
import type { FpTestApp } from './fake-fp.js';
import type { Investor } from './ledger-seed.js';

export interface ConsumedConsentInput {
  investorId: string;
  subjectType: ConsentSubjectType;
  subjects: Array<{ table: 'orders' | 'plans' | 'mandates'; id: string }>;
  status?: 'CONSUMED' | 'CONSUMED_UNUSED';
  /** Each defaults to the app clock's now: approved, deadlines reached, first attempt stamped. */
  consumedAt?: Date;
  executeBefore?: Date;
  sagaExpiresAt?: Date;
  firstAttemptAt?: Date | null;
}

/**
 * The rows E4's approve + useConsumed leave behind for a subject FP has seen: a CONSUMED challenge, its
 * CHALLENGE consent_record with first_attempt_at stamped, and a CONSENTED consent_subjects row per subject.
 * Integrity tests build them directly so each M1 case controls exactly one fact; the redemption backstop
 * tests set the deadlines.
 */
export async function consumedConsentFor(
  t: FpTestApp,
  input: ConsumedConsentInput,
): Promise<{ challengeId: string; recordId: string }> {
  const now = t.clock.now();
  const consumedAt = input.consumedAt ?? now;
  const executeBefore = input.executeBefore ?? now;
  const sagaExpiresAt = input.sagaExpiresAt ?? now;
  const challengeId = newId('consent_challenges');
  const recordId = newId('consent_records');
  const sha = randomBytes(32);
  await t.db.db.insert(consentChallenges).values({
    id: challengeId,
    createdBy: input.investorId,
    updatedBy: input.investorId,
    investorId: input.investorId,
    subjectType: input.subjectType,
    templateKey: 'TPL_PURCHASE',
    snapshotEnc: randomBytes(64),
    snapshotSha256: sha,
    status: input.status ?? 'CONSUMED',
    requiredFactors: ['SMS'],
    moneyParamsVersion: 'v1',
    expiresAt: consumedAt,
    executeBefore,
    sagaExpiresAt,
    consumedAt,
  });
  await t.db.db.insert(consentRecords).values({
    id: recordId,
    createdBy: input.investorId,
    kind: 'CHALLENGE',
    investorId: input.investorId,
    challengeId,
    subjectType: input.subjectType,
    subjectIds: input.subjects,
    snapshotSha256: sha,
    consumedAt,
    executeBefore,
    sagaExpiresAt,
    firstAttemptAt: input.firstAttemptAt === undefined ? now : input.firstAttemptAt,
  });
  for (const subject of input.subjects) {
    await t.db.db.insert(consentSubjects).values({
      challengeId,
      subjectTable: subject.table,
      subjectId: subject.id,
      status: 'CONSENTED',
    });
  }
  return { challengeId, recordId };
}

/** An UPI Autopay mandate and a monthly SIP on it, at the given statuses and FP ids (F2's columns). */
export async function seedPlanRows(
  t: FpTestApp,
  investor: Investor,
  schemeId: string,
  input: {
    planStatus: PlanStatus;
    mandateStatus: MandateStatus;
    fpPlanId?: string | null;
    fpMandateId?: number | null;
    consentChallengeId?: string | null;
  },
): Promise<{ planId: string; mandateId: string }> {
  const mandateId = newId('mandates');
  const planId = newId('plans');
  await t.db.db.insert(mandates).values({
    id: mandateId,
    createdBy: investor.investorId,
    updatedBy: investor.investorId,
    investorId: investor.investorId,
    bankAccountId: investor.bankId,
    rail: 'UPI_AUTOPAY',
    limitAmount: '100000.00',
    status: input.mandateStatus,
    fpMandateId: input.fpMandateId ?? null,
    consentChallengeId: input.consentChallengeId ?? null,
  });
  await t.db.db.insert(plans).values({
    id: planId,
    createdBy: investor.investorId,
    updatedBy: investor.investorId,
    investorId: investor.investorId,
    schemeId,
    amount: '1000.00',
    installmentDay: 10,
    firstInstalmentDateShown: '2026-11-10',
    mandateId,
    status: input.planStatus,
    consentChallengeId: input.consentChallengeId ?? null,
    arn: t.env.SANCHAY_PLATFORM_ARN,
    initiatedVia: 'web',
    userIp: '203.0.113.10',
    fpPlanId: input.fpPlanId ?? null,
  });
  return { planId, mandateId };
}

/** [kind, severity] of every OPEN break on an entity, for terse assertions. */
export async function openBreaksOn(
  t: FpTestApp,
  entityId: string,
): Promise<Array<[string, string]>> {
  const rows = await t.db.db
    .select()
    .from(reconBreaks)
    .where(and(eq(reconBreaks.entityId, entityId), eq(reconBreaks.status, 'OPEN')));
  return rows.map((b) => [b.kind, b.severity]);
}
```

```ts
import { randomBytes } from 'node:crypto';
import { and, eq, sql } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { orders } from '../../src/modules/orders/orders.schema.js';
import { paymentAttempts } from '../../src/modules/payments/payments.schema.js';
import { newId } from '../../src/modules/platform/ids.js';
import { Jobs } from '../../src/modules/platform/jobs/jobs.service.js';
import { reconBreaks } from '../../src/modules/platform/kernel.schema.js';
import { IntegrityInvariantsJob } from '../../src/modules/platform/recon/integrity-invariants.job.js';
import { INVARIANT_KINDS } from '../../src/modules/platform/recon/invariant-checks.js';
import { Ledger } from '../../src/modules/portfolio/ledger.service.js';
import { lots, redemptionReservations } from '../../src/modules/portfolio/portfolio.schema.js';
import { bootFpTestApp, type FpTestApp } from './fake-fp.js';
import { jobOf } from './jobs.js';
import {
  type Investor,
  seedProcessingPurchase,
  seedRedemption,
  settledPurchase,
} from './ledger-seed.js';
import { seedInvestableInvestor, seedScheme } from './orders-seed.js';
import { consumedConsentFor, openBreaksOn, seedPlanRows } from './recon-seed.js';

let t: FpTestApp;
let investor: Investor;
let other: Investor;

const ALLOTMENT = {
  allottedUnits: '10.000',
  purchasedAmount: '4999.75',
  purchasedPrice: '499.9750',
  allottedNavDate: '2026-10-12',
};

beforeAll(async () => {
  t = await bootFpTestApp();
  vi.spyOn(t.app.get(Jobs), 'enqueue').mockResolvedValue('job-id'); // nothing races the pg-boss worker
  investor = await seedInvestableInvestor(t);
  other = await seedInvestableInvestor(t);
});
afterAll(async () => {
  await t.close();
});

const run = () => t.app.get(IntegrityInvariantsJob).handle(jobOf('integrity.invariants', {}));
const critical = (kind: string): [string, string] => [kind, 'CRITICAL'];

describe('M1: no provider id without a CONSUMED challenge (D-MONEY-071)', () => {
  it('fires on an injected orphan fp_order_id', async () => {
    const scheme = await seedScheme(t);
    const { orderId } = await seedProcessingPurchase(t, investor, scheme);
    await run();
    expect(await openBreaksOn(t, orderId)).toEqual([critical(INVARIANT_KINDS.M1)]);
    const [row] = await t.db.db
      .select()
      .from(reconBreaks)
      .where(and(eq(reconBreaks.entityId, orderId), eq(reconBreaks.kind, INVARIANT_KINDS.M1)));
    expect(row).toMatchObject({
      entityType: 'orders',
      detail: { investorId: investor.investorId },
    });
  });

  it('is quiet for a provider id written under the investor’s CONSUMED challenge, and resolves once it is', async () => {
    const scheme = await seedScheme(t);
    const { orderId } = await seedProcessingPurchase(t, investor, scheme);
    await run();
    expect(await openBreaksOn(t, orderId)).toEqual([critical(INVARIANT_KINDS.M1)]);
    await consumedConsentFor(t, {
      investorId: investor.investorId,
      subjectType: 'PURCHASE',
      subjects: [{ table: 'orders', id: orderId }],
    });
    await run();
    expect(await openBreaksOn(t, orderId)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it.each([
    ['another investor’s challenge', { owner: 'other' as const }],
    [
      'a CONSUMED_UNUSED challenge (no FP write may follow it)',
      { status: 'CONSUMED_UNUSED' as const },
    ],
    ['a challenge whose first FP attempt was never stamped', { firstAttemptAt: null }],
  ])('fires when the only consent is %s', async (_label, variant) => {
    const scheme = await seedScheme(t);
    const { orderId } = await seedProcessingPurchase(t, investor, scheme);
    await consumedConsentFor(t, {
      investorId: 'owner' in variant ? other.investorId : investor.investorId,
      subjectType: 'PURCHASE',
      subjects: [{ table: 'orders', id: orderId }],
      ...('status' in variant ? { status: variant.status } : {}),
      ...('firstAttemptAt' in variant ? { firstAttemptAt: variant.firstAttemptAt } : {}),
    });
    await run();
    expect(await openBreaksOn(t, orderId)).toEqual([critical(INVARIANT_KINDS.M1)]);
  });

  it('ignores SIP instalments (FP raises them under the plan’s consent) but checks plans and mandates', async () => {
    const scheme = await seedScheme(t);
    const { orderId } = await seedProcessingPurchase(t, investor, scheme);
    await t.db.db.update(orders).set({ origin: 'SIP_INSTALMENT' }).where(eq(orders.id, orderId));
    const { planId, mandateId } = await seedPlanRows(t, investor, scheme.id, {
      planStatus: 'ACTIVE',
      mandateStatus: 'APPROVED',
      fpPlanId: `mfpp_${newId('plans').slice(-8)}`,
      fpMandateId: 880_001,
    });
    await run();
    expect(await openBreaksOn(t, orderId)).toEqual([]);
    expect(await openBreaksOn(t, planId)).toEqual([critical(INVARIANT_KINDS.M1)]);
    expect(await openBreaksOn(t, mandateId)).toEqual([critical(INVARIANT_KINDS.M1)]);

    await consumedConsentFor(t, {
      investorId: investor.investorId,
      subjectType: 'MANDATE_REGISTRATION',
      subjects: [
        { table: 'plans', id: planId },
        { table: 'mandates', id: mandateId },
      ],
    });
    await run();
    expect(await openBreaksOn(t, planId)).toEqual([]);
    expect(await openBreaksOn(t, mandateId)).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe('M2: lot conservation', () => {
  it('is quiet after a real FIFO exit and fires when a lot loses units no consumption explains', async () => {
    const scheme = await seedScheme(t);
    const { folioId } = await settledPurchase(t, investor, scheme, {
      ...ALLOTMENT,
      folioNumber: 'F-M2-1',
    });
    const [lot] = await t.db.db.select().from(lots).where(eq(lots.folioId, folioId));
    if (lot === undefined) throw new Error('no lot');
    const exit = await seedRedemption(t, investor, scheme.id, folioId);
    await t.db.db.transaction((tx) =>
      t.app.get(Ledger).applyExit(tx, exit, {
        units: '4.000',
        amount: '2000.00',
        nav: null,
        navDate: '2026-11-02',
      }),
    );
    await run();
    expect(await openBreaksOn(t, lot.id)).toEqual([]);

    await t.db.db.execute(
      sql`UPDATE app.lots SET units_remaining = units_remaining - 1 WHERE id = ${lot.id}`,
    );
    await run();
    expect(await openBreaksOn(t, lot.id)).toEqual([critical(INVARIANT_KINDS.M2)]);
  });

  it('a reversed untouched lot conserves', async () => {
    const scheme = await seedScheme(t);
    const { orderId } = await settledPurchase(t, investor, scheme, {
      ...ALLOTMENT,
      folioNumber: 'F-M2-2',
    });
    const [order] = await t.db.db.select().from(orders).where(eq(orders.id, orderId));
    if (order === undefined) throw new Error('no order');
    await t.db.db.transaction((tx) => t.app.get(Ledger).reverseAllotment(tx, order));
    const [lot] = await t.db.db.select().from(lots).where(eq(lots.sourceOrderId, orderId));
    expect(lot?.status).toBe('REVERSED');
    await run();
    expect(await openBreaksOn(t, lot?.id ?? '')).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe('M3: at most one SUCCESS payment per order', () => {
  it('fires on a second SUCCESS attempt (simulating a lost payment_attempts_success_uq)', async () => {
    const scheme = await seedScheme(t);
    const { orderId } = await seedProcessingPurchase(t, investor, scheme);
    await t.db.db.execute(sql`DROP INDEX app.payment_attempts_success_uq`);
    for (let i = 0; i < 2; i += 1) {
      await t.db.db.insert(paymentAttempts).values({
        id: newId('payment_attempts'),
        orderId,
        investorId: investor.investorId,
        method: 'NETBANKING',
        status: 'SUCCESS',
        returnRefHash: randomBytes(32),
        returnRefExpiresAt: t.clock.now(),
      });
    }
    await run();
    expect(await openBreaksOn(t, orderId)).toContainEqual(critical(INVARIANT_KINDS.M3));
  });
});

describe('M4: exactly one lot per SETTLED purchase', () => {
  it('is quiet for a settled purchase and its lot', async () => {
    const scheme = await seedScheme(t);

describe('reservations never exceed the units held', () => {
  it('fires when ACTIVE reservations exceed the OPEN lots, and resolves when they fit', async () => {
    const scheme = await seedScheme(t);
    const { folioId } = await settledPurchase(t, investor, scheme, {
      ...ALLOTMENT,
      folioNumber: 'F-RES-1',
    });
    const exit = await seedRedemption(t, investor, scheme.id, folioId);
    const reservationId = newId('redemption_reservations');
    await t.db.db.insert(redemptionReservations).values({
      id: reservationId,
      orderId: exit.id,
      investorId: investor.investorId,
      folioId,
      schemeId: scheme.id,
      unitsReserved: '12.000',
    });
    const entityId = `${folioId}:${scheme.id}`;
    await run();
    expect(await openBreaksOn(t, entityId)).toEqual([critical(INVARIANT_KINDS.RESERVATIONS)]);

    await t.db.db
      .update(redemptionReservations)
      .set({ unitsReserved: '9.500' })
      .where(eq(redemptionReservations.id, reservationId));
    await run();
    expect(await openBreaksOn(t, entityId)).toEqual([]);
    const [resolved] = await t.db.db
      .select()
      .from(reconBreaks)
      .where(
        and(eq(reconBreaks.entityId, entityId), eq(reconBreaks.kind, INVARIANT_KINDS.RESERVATIONS)),
      );
    expect(resolved).toMatchObject({ status: 'RESOLVED' });
    expect(resolved?.resolvedAt).toEqual(t.clock.now());
  });
});
```

```ts
/** An FP purchase on the investor's account that no order of ours placed. */
function strayPurchase(mfia: string, fields: { plan?: string | null; sourceRefId?: string } = {}) {
  const id = t.fakeFp.state.nextId('mfp_');

    purchasedAmount: null,
    purchasedPrice: null,
    allottedNavDate: null,
  });
  t.fakeFp.state.purchasesByOldId.set(oldId, id);
  return id;
}

/** An mf_redemption in F5's FakeFp store, on the investor's account unless another is given. */
function fpRedemption(fields: { sourceRefId: string; state: string; mfia?: string }): string {
  const id = t.fakeFp.state.nextId('mfr_');
  t.fakeFp.state.redemptions.set(id, {

    bankCreditReference: null,

}

  it('an FP read that fails for one investor opens RECON_FP_DAILY_FAILED and the sweep carries on', async () => {
    t.fakeFp.script('purchase.list', {

describe('fp.reconcile.nonfinal, extended to redemptions, plans and mandates (F7)', () => {
  /** A redemption F5's submit left RECONCILING (ambiguous POST), its 2-unit reservation still ACTIVE. */
  async function reconcilingRedemption(): Promise<{ orderId: string; challengeId: string }> {
    const own = await seedScheme(t);
    const { folioId } = await settledPurchase(t, investor, own, {
      ...ALLOTMENT,
      folioNumber: `F-NF-${own.id.slice(-6)}`,
    });
    const exit = await seedRedemption(t, investor, own.id, folioId);
    const challengeId = newId('consent_challenges');
    await t.db.db
      .update(orders)
      .set({ status: 'RECONCILING', consentChallengeId: challengeId })
      .where(eq(orders.id, exit.id));
    await t.db.db.insert(redemptionReservations).values({
      orderId: exit.id,
      investorId: investor.investorId,
      folioId,
      schemeId: own.id,
      unitsReserved: '2.000',
    });
    return { orderId: exit.id, challengeId };
  }
  const reservationOf = async (orderId: string) =>
    (
      await t.db.db
        .select()
        .from(redemptionReservations)
        .where(eq(redemptionReservations.orderId, orderId))
    )[0];

  /**
   * A redemption at `status` whose consent E4's approve consumed (its rows built by consumedConsentFor with
   * the given deadlines) and whose 2-unit reservation is ACTIVE: F5's saga stopped here (retries ran out).
   */
  async function approvedRedemption(
    status: 'CONSENT_PENDING' | 'CONSENTED' | 'UNDER_REVIEW' | 'CONFIRMING',
    consent: Omit<ConsumedConsentInput, 'investorId' | 'subjectType' | 'subjects'> = {},
  ): Promise<{ orderId: string; challengeId: string; recordId: string }> {
    const own = await seedScheme(t);
    const { folioId } = await settledPurchase(t, investor, own, {
      ...ALLOTMENT,
      folioNumber: `F-AP-${own.id.slice(-6)}`,
    });
    const exit = await seedRedemption(t, investor, own.id, folioId);
    const { challengeId, recordId } = await consumedConsentFor(t, {
      investorId: investor.investorId,
      subjectType: 'REDEMPTION',
      subjects: [{ table: 'orders', id: exit.id }],
      ...consent,
    });
    const inReview = status === 'UNDER_REVIEW' || status === 'CONFIRMING';
    await t.db.db
      .update(orders)
      .set({
        status,
        consentChallengeId: challengeId,
        ...(inReview ? { fpOrderId: t.fakeFp.state.nextId('mfr_') } : {}),
      })
      .where(eq(orders.id, exit.id));
    await t.db.db.insert(redemptionReservations).values({
      orderId: exit.id,
      investorId: investor.investorId,
      folioId,
      schemeId: own.id,
      unitsReserved: '2.000',
    });
    return { orderId: exit.id, challengeId, recordId };
  }
  const submitsFor = (challengeId: string) =>
    enqueued.filter(
      (j) =>
        j.name === 'orders.redemption.submit' &&
        (j.data as { challengeId: string }).challengeId === challengeId,
    );

  it('hands a redemption in review or confirmation back to F5’s orders.redemption.advance (singletonKey = order id)', async () => {
    const review = await approvedRedemption('UNDER_REVIEW');
    const confirming = await approvedRedemption('CONFIRMING');
    await nonfinal();
    for (const r of [review, confirming]) {
      expect(enqueued).toContainEqual({
        name: 'orders.redemption.advance',
        data: { orderId: r.orderId, challengeId: r.challengeId },
        opts: { singletonKey: r.orderId },
      });
      expect(await reservationOf(r.orderId)).toMatchObject({ status: 'ACTIVE' });
    }
  });

  it('re-enqueues F5’s submit for an approved redemption while its consent is usable, but not in the first 2 minutes', async () => {
    const now = t.clock.now();
    const r = await approvedRedemption('CONSENTED', {
      consumedAt: now,
      firstAttemptAt: now,
      executeBefore: new Date(now.getTime() + 10 * MINUTE),
      sagaExpiresAt: new Date(now.getTime() + 60 * MINUTE),
    });
    await nonfinal();
    expect(submitsFor(r.challengeId)).toEqual([]);
    t.clock.advance(3 * MINUTE);
    await nonfinal();
    expect(submitsFor(r.challengeId)).toEqual([
      {
        name: 'orders.redemption.submit',
        data: {
          challengeId: r.challengeId,
          recordId: r.recordId,
          investorId: investor.investorId,
          subjectType: 'REDEMPTION',
          subjectIds: [r.orderId],
        },
        opts: { singletonKey: r.challengeId },
      },
    ]);
    expect(await orderOf(r.orderId)).toMatchObject({ status: 'CONSENTED' });
    expect(await reservationOf(r.orderId)).toMatchObject({ status: 'ACTIVE' });
  });

  it('ends an approved redemption 2 minutes past its saga deadline: CONSENT_EXPIRED, reservation released', async () => {
    const now = t.clock.now();
    const r = await approvedRedemption('CONSENTED', {
      consumedAt: new Date(now.getTime() - 70 * MINUTE),
      firstAttemptAt: new Date(now.getTime() - 69 * MINUTE),
      executeBefore: new Date(now.getTime() - 60 * MINUTE),
      sagaExpiresAt: new Date(now.getTime() - 10 * MINUTE),
    });
    await nonfinal();
    expect(await orderOf(r.orderId)).toMatchObject({ status: 'CONSENT_EXPIRED', finalAt: now });
    expect(await reservationOf(r.orderId)).toMatchObject({
      status: 'RELEASED',
      releaseEvidence: 'consent_expired',
    });
    expect(submitsFor(r.challengeId)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('a CONSUMED_UNUSED challenge ends a still CONSENT_PENDING redemption at once', async () => {
    const now = t.clock.now();
    const r = await approvedRedemption('CONSENT_PENDING', {
      status: 'CONSUMED_UNUSED',
      consumedAt: new Date(now.getTime() - 11 * MINUTE),
      executeBefore: new Date(now.getTime() - MINUTE),
      firstAttemptAt: null,
    });
    await nonfinal();
    expect(await orderOf(r.orderId)).toMatchObject({ status: 'CONSENT_EXPIRED' });
    expect(await reservationOf(r.orderId)).toMatchObject({
      status: 'RELEASED',
      releaseEvidence: 'consent_expired',
    });
    const events = await t.db.db
      .select()
      .from(orderEvents)
      .where(eq(orderEvents.orderId, r.orderId))
      .orderBy(asc(orderEvents.occurredAt), asc(orderEvents.id));
    expect(events.map((e) => [e.fromStatus, e.toStatus, e.trigger])).toEqual([
      ['CONSENT_PENDING', 'CONSENTED', 'approve'],
      ['CONSENTED', 'CONSENT_EXPIRED', 'execute_before_missed'],
    ]);
  });

  it('adopts a RECONCILING purchase FP holds and hands it back to E20’s orders.purchase.advance (RV-04-F7-4)', async () => {
    const seeded = await seedProcessingPurchase(t, investor, scheme);
    const challengeId = newId('consent_challenges');
    await t.db.db
      .update(orders)
      .set({
        status: 'RECONCILING',
        fpOrderId: null,
        fpOldId: null,
        fpState: null,
        consentChallengeId: challengeId,
      })
      .where(eq(orders.id, seeded.orderId));
    t.fakeFp.advance(seeded.fpOrderId, 'under_review');
    await nonfinal();
    expect(await orderOf(seeded.orderId)).toMatchObject({
      status: 'UNDER_REVIEW',
      fpOrderId: seeded.fpOrderId,
      fpState: 'under_review',
    });
    expect(enqueued).toContainEqual({
      name: 'orders.purchase.advance',
      data: { orderId: seeded.orderId, challengeId },
      opts: { singletonKey: seeded.orderId },
    });
  });

  it('adopts a RECONCILING redemption FP holds in review and hands it back to F5’s advance job', async () => {
    const { orderId, challengeId } = await reconcilingRedemption();
    const fpId = fpRedemption({ sourceRefId: orderId, state: 'under_review' });
    await nonfinal();
    expect(await orderOf(orderId)).toMatchObject({
      status: 'UNDER_REVIEW',
      fpOrderId: fpId,
      fpState: 'under_review',
    });
    expect(enqueued).toContainEqual({
      name: 'orders.redemption.advance',
      data: { orderId, challengeId },
      opts: { singletonKey: orderId },
    });
    expect(await reservationOf(orderId)).toMatchObject({ status: 'ACTIVE' });
  });

  it('a RECONCILING redemption FP has failed ends FAILED and releases its reservation on that evidence', async () => {
    const { orderId } = await reconcilingRedemption();
    const fpId = fpRedemption({ sourceRefId: orderId, state: 'failed' });
    await nonfinal();
    expect(await orderOf(orderId)).toMatchObject({ status: 'FAILED', fpOrderId: fpId });
    expect(await reservationOf(orderId)).toMatchObject({
      status: 'RELEASED',
      releaseEvidence: `fp_failed:${fpId}`,
    });
  });

  it('a redemption FP never received fails after two misses 10 minutes apart and releases its reservation', async () => {
    const { orderId } = await reconcilingRedemption();
    await nonfinal();
    expect((await orderOf(orderId)).status).toBe('RECONCILING');
    t.clock.advance(11 * MINUTE);
    await nonfinal();
    expect(await orderOf(orderId)).toMatchObject({
      status: 'FAILED',
      failureCode: 'PROVIDER_OBJECT_ABSENT',
    });
    expect(await reservationOf(orderId)).toMatchObject({
      status: 'RELEASED',
      releaseEvidence: 'provider_object_absent',
    });
  });

  it('re-enqueues plans.sip.advance for a plan in review (singletonKey = plan id)', async () => {
    const challengeId = newId('consent_challenges');
    const { planId } = await seedPlanRows(t, investor, scheme.id, {
      planStatus: 'UNDER_REVIEW',
      mandateStatus: 'APPROVED',
      fpPlanId: t.fakeFp.state.nextId('mfpp_'),
      consentChallengeId: challengeId,
    });
    await nonfinal();
    expect(enqueued).toContainEqual({
      name: 'plans.sip.advance',
      data: { planId, challengeId },
      opts: { singletonKey: planId },
    });
  });

  it('keeps MANDATE_CREATE_AMBIGUOUS open for a RECONCILING mandate, even after someone resolved it', async () => {
    const { mandateId } = await seedPlanRows(t, investor, scheme.id, {
      planStatus: 'MANDATE_SETUP',
      mandateStatus: 'RECONCILING',
    });
    await nonfinal();
    expect(await openBreaksOn(t, mandateId)).toEqual([['MANDATE_CREATE_AMBIGUOUS', 'CRITICAL']]);
    await t.db.db
      .update(reconBreaks)
      .set({ status: 'RESOLVED', resolvedAt: t.clock.now() })
      .where(eq(reconBreaks.entityId, mandateId));
    await nonfinal();
    expect(await openBreaksOn(t, mandateId)).toEqual([['MANDATE_CREATE_AMBIGUOUS', 'CRITICAL']]);
  });

  it('v_reconciling_orders.reconciling_since is the real move into RECONCILING: a miss self-event does not reset it (F1’s gauge rule)', async () => {
    const seeded = await seedProcessingPurchase(t, investor, scheme);
    const entered = new Date(t.clock.now().getTime() - 3 * HOUR);
    await t.db.db
      .update(orders)
      .set({ status: 'RECONCILING', fpOrderId: null })
      .where(eq(orders.id, seeded.orderId));
    await t.db.db.insert(orderEvents).values([
      {
        orderId: seeded.orderId,
        fromStatus: 'PROCESSING',
        toStatus: 'RECONCILING',
        trigger: 'ambiguous',
        occurredAt: entered,
      },
      {
        orderId: seeded.orderId,
        fromStatus: 'RECONCILING',
        toStatus: 'RECONCILING',
        trigger: 'fp.reconcile.nonfinal.miss',
        occurredAt: t.clock.now(),
      },
    ]);
    const { rows } = await t.db.db.execute<{
      subject_kind: string;
      mode: string;
      reconciling_since: Date;
    }>(
      sql`SELECT subject_kind, mode, reconciling_since FROM app.v_reconciling_orders WHERE id = ${seeded.orderId}`,
    );
    expect(rows).toEqual([
      { subject_kind: 'PURCHASE', mode: 'AMOUNT', reconciling_since: entered },
    ]);
  });
});
```
