`packages/domain/src/rules/holding-valuation.ts`:
```ts
import { Money, marketValue, type Nav, Rounding, type Units } from '@sanchay/money';
import type { NavGrade } from '../catalogue.js';
import type { IsoDate } from '../ids.js';

/** The latest NAV for a scheme as D9's `NavService.latest` grades it (null: no row at all). */
export interface NavQuote {
  readonly nav: Nav;
  readonly navDate: IsoDate;
  readonly grade: NavGrade;
}

export interface HoldingValuationInput {
  /** Σ `units_remaining` over the holding's OPEN lots (scale 3, > 0). */
  readonly units: Units;
  /** Σ `cost_remaining` over the same lots: gross paid, stamp duty included (D-MONEY-068). */
  readonly invested: Money;
  readonly quote: NavQuote | null;
  /** Today's IST calendar date: a NAV dated after it is never used (D-MONEY-067). */
  readonly today: IsoDate;
}

export interface HoldingValuation {
  readonly units: Units;
  readonly invested: Money;
  /** invested ÷ units at 6 dp HALF_UP (the cost basis of the units still held). */
  readonly avgCostNav: string;
  /** The NAV the value used; null when the holding is not valued. */
  readonly nav: Nav | null;
  readonly navDate: IsoDate | null;
  /** OK / STALE (valued, flagged) / UNAVAILABLE (not valued). */
  readonly navGrade: NavGrade;
  /** units × NAV, 2 dp HALF_UP. Null when unpriced: never the cost, never 0 (B-12 fixed). */
  readonly currentValue: Money | null;
  readonly absoluteReturn: Money | null;
  /** (value − invested) ÷ invested × 100 at 2 dp HALF_UP; null if unvalued or invested is 0. */
  readonly percentReturn: string | null;
  readonly valued: boolean;
}

/** Percent of `base` at 2 dp HALF_UP, as v1 HLD-08 rounds it (scale 6 first, then 2). */
function percentOf(part: Money, base: Money): string | null {
  if (base.isZero()) return null;
  return part
    .toDecimal()
    .div(base.toDecimal())
    .toDecimalPlaces(6, Rounding.HALF_UP)
    .times(100)
    .toDecimalPlaces(2, Rounding.HALF_UP)
    .toFixed(2);
}

/**
 * D-MONEY-067: value = units × NAV only when the NAV is not quarantined (grade UNAVAILABLE),
 * is > 0 (Nav guarantees it) and is not dated after today IST. A STALE NAV still values the
 * holding and is flagged. Anything else leaves value, gains and % null.
 */
export function valueHolding(input: HoldingValuationInput): HoldingValuation {
  if (!input.units.isPositive() || input.units.scale !== 3) {
    throw new RangeError('valueHolding: units must be positive platform (3 dp) units');
  }
  const avgCostNav = input.invested
    .toDecimal()
    .div(input.units.toDecimal())
    .toDecimalPlaces(6, Rounding.HALF_UP)
    .toFixed(6);
  const quote = input.quote;
  const usable = quote !== null && quote.grade !== 'UNAVAILABLE' && quote.navDate <= input.today;
  if (!usable) {
    return {
      units: input.units,
      invested: input.invested,
      avgCostNav,
      nav: null,
      navDate: null,
      navGrade: 'UNAVAILABLE',
      currentValue: null,
      absoluteReturn: null,
      percentReturn: null,
      valued: false,
    };
  }
  const currentValue = marketValue(input.units, quote.nav, Rounding.HALF_UP);
  const absoluteReturn = currentValue.subtract(input.invested);
  return {
    units: input.units,
    invested: input.invested,
    avgCostNav,
    nav: quote.nav,
    navDate: quote.navDate,
    navGrade: quote.grade,
    currentValue,
    absoluteReturn,
    percentReturn: percentOf(absoluteReturn, input.invested),
    valued: true,
  };
}

export type PortfolioCoverage = 'OK' | 'PARTIAL' | 'UNAVAILABLE';

export interface PortfolioTotals {
  readonly holdingCount: number;
  readonly valuedCount: number;
  readonly coverage: PortfolioCoverage;
  /** Σ invested over every holding. */
  readonly invested: Money;
  /** Σ invested over valued holdings only (the base for gains, D-MONEY-068). */
  readonly investedValued: Money;
  readonly unvaluedInvested: Money;
  /** Σ value, only when every holding is valued (outline F11: null if any holding is unpriced). */
  readonly currentValue: Money | null;
  /** Σ value over valued holdings; null when none is valued. */
  readonly valuedValue: Money | null;
  /** valuedValue − investedValued, and its % of investedValued. */
  readonly absoluteReturn: Money | null;
  readonly percentReturn: string | null;
}

/** HLD-12/13 with the v2 rules: totals over every holding, gains only over valued ones. */
export function summariseHoldings(holdings: readonly HoldingValuation[]): PortfolioTotals {
  let invested = Money.ZERO;
  let investedValued = Money.ZERO;
  let valuedValue = Money.ZERO;
  let valuedCount = 0;
  for (const h of holdings) {
    invested = invested.add(h.invested);
    if (h.currentValue !== null) {
      investedValued = investedValued.add(h.invested);
      valuedValue = valuedValue.add(h.currentValue);
      valuedCount += 1;
    }
  }
  const coverage: PortfolioCoverage =
    valuedCount === 0 ? 'UNAVAILABLE' : valuedCount === holdings.length ? 'OK' : 'PARTIAL';
  const anyValued = valuedCount > 0;
  const absoluteReturn = anyValued ? valuedValue.subtract(investedValued) : null;
  return {
    holdingCount: holdings.length,
    valuedCount,
    coverage,
    invested,
    investedValued,
    unvaluedInvested: invested.subtract(investedValued),
    currentValue: coverage === 'OK' ? valuedValue : null,
    valuedValue: anyValued ? valuedValue : null,
    absoluteReturn,
    percentReturn: absoluteReturn === null ? null : percentOf(absoluteReturn, investedValued),
  };
}
```

```ts
import { oc } from '@orpc/contract';
import { ASSET_CLASSES, ISIN_REGEX, NAV_GRADES } from '@sanchay/domain';
import {
  moneyWireSchema,
  navWireSchema,
  nullableMoneyWireSchema,
  unitsWireSchema,
} from '@sanchay/validation';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { COMMON_ERRORS, errorMap, SESSION_ERRORS } from './errors.js';

const route = (path: `/${string}`, summary: string) =>
  oc.route({ method: 'GET', path, tags: ['portfolio'], summary });

/** Percent with 2 dp ("-5.00", "100.00"); allocation shares use 1 dp. */
const percent2 = z.string().regex(/^-?\d+\.\d{2}$/);
const percent1 = z.string().regex(/^\d{1,3}\.\d$/);

/** PO-5 (A7 `formatXirr`): `rate` is withheld (null) under 30 days, so no client can show it. */
export const XirrSchema = z.object({
  rate: z
    .string()
    .regex(/^-?\d+\.\d{6}$/)
    .nullable(),
  horizonDays: z.number().int().min(0),
  text: z.string(),
  caveat: z.enum(['TOO_EARLY', 'SHORT_HORIZON']).nullable(),
  caveatText: z.string().nullable(),
  showAbsoluteReturn: z.boolean(),
});

const CoverageSchema = z.enum(['OK', 'PARTIAL', 'UNAVAILABLE']);

export const HoldingRowSchema = z.object({
  folioId: z.uuid(),
  folioNumber: z.string().nullable(),
  /** MISMATCH: ALL is refused and this holding's XIRR is suppressed (D-MONEY-065). */
  reconciliationStatus: z.enum(['UNRECONCILED', 'MATCHED', 'MISMATCH', 'FEED_UNAVAILABLE']),
  schemeId: z.uuid(),
  isin: z.string().regex(ISIN_REGEX),
  schemeName: z.string(),
  categoryCode: z.string(),
  categoryName: z.string(),
  assetClass: z.enum(ASSET_CLASSES),
  units: unitsWireSchema,
  invested: moneyWireSchema,
  avgCostNav: navWireSchema,
  /** Null when not valued: never the cost, never 0 (D-MONEY-067). */
  currentValue: nullableMoneyWireSchema,
  nav: navWireSchema.nullable(),
  navDate: z.iso.date().nullable(),
  navGrade: z.enum(NAV_GRADES),
  absoluteReturn: nullableMoneyWireSchema,
  percentReturn: percent2.nullable(),
  xirr: XirrSchema,
});
export type HoldingRow = z.infer<typeof HoldingRowSchema>;

export const LotSchema = z.object({
  lotId: z.uuid(),
  lotType: z.enum(['PURCHASE', 'SIP_INSTALMENT']),
  allotmentDate: z.iso.date(),
  nav: navWireSchema,
  units: unitsWireSchema,
  unitsRemaining: unitsWireSchema,
  costAmount: moneyWireSchema,
  costRemaining: moneyWireSchema,
  lockInUntil: z.iso.date().nullable(),
  locked: z.boolean(),
});

export const HoldingDetailSchema = HoldingRowSchema.extend({
  lots: z.array(LotSchema),
  units: z.object({
    total: unitsWireSchema,
    available: unitsWireSchema,
    locked: unitsWireSchema,
    inProcess: unitsWireSchema,
  }),
  pending: z.object({ amount: moneyWireSchema, count: z.number().int().min(0) }),
});
export type HoldingDetail = z.infer<typeof HoldingDetailSchema>;

export const ThingToDoSchema = z.object({
  kind: z.enum(['PAYMENT_PENDING', 'MANDATE_AUTH_PENDING', 'SIP_INSTALMENT_MISSED']),
  entityId: z.uuid(),
  amount: nullableMoneyWireSchema,
  at: z.iso.datetime(),
});

export const PortfolioSummarySchema = z.object({
  asOf: z.iso.date(),
  holdingCount: z.number().int().min(0),
  valuedCount: z.number().int().min(0),
  coverage: CoverageSchema,
  invested: moneyWireSchema,
  investedValued: moneyWireSchema,
  unvaluedInvested: moneyWireSchema,
  /** Null unless every holding is valued (HOME-01 then shows "Value pending"). */
  currentValue: nullableMoneyWireSchema,
  /** Gains are over valued holdings only (D-MONEY-068). */
  valuedValue: nullableMoneyWireSchema,
  absoluteReturn: nullableMoneyWireSchema,
  percentReturn: percent2.nullable(),
  navAsOf: z.iso.date().nullable(),
  xirr: XirrSchema,
  /** "₹X being invested": paid, not yet allotted; never in value or XIRR. */
  pending: z.object({ amount: moneyWireSchema, count: z.number().int().min(0) }),
  activeSips: z.number().int().min(0),
  thingsToDo: z.array(ThingToDoSchema),
});
export type PortfolioSummary = z.infer<typeof PortfolioSummarySchema>;

export const AllocationSchema = z.object({
  assetClasses: z.array(
    z.object({
      assetClass: z.enum(ASSET_CLASSES),
      value: moneyWireSchema,
      percent: percent1,
      categories: z.array(
        z.object({ code: z.string(), name: z.string(), value: moneyWireSchema, percent: percent1 }),
      ),
    }),
  ),
  valuePending: moneyWireSchema,
});
export type Allocation = z.infer<typeof AllocationSchema>;

export const HoldingKeySchema = z.strictObject({
  folioId: z.uuid(),
  isin: z.string().regex(ISIN_REGEX),
});

export const portfolioContract = {
  summary: route('/portfolio/summary', 'My dashboard totals, XIRR, pending money and to-dos')
    .errors(errorMap(...COMMON_ERRORS, ...SESSION_ERRORS))
    .output(PortfolioSummarySchema),
  holdings: route('/portfolio/holdings', 'My holdings, valued at the latest NAV')
    .errors(errorMap(...COMMON_ERRORS, ...SESSION_ERRORS))
    .output(z.array(HoldingRowSchema)),
  holding: route('/portfolio/holdings/{folioId}/{isin}', 'One of my holdings with its lots')
    .errors(errorMap(...COMMON_ERRORS, ...SESSION_ERRORS, 'NOT_FOUND'))
    .input(HoldingKeySchema)
    .output(HoldingDetailSchema),
  allocation: route('/portfolio/allocation', 'My valued holdings by asset class and category')
    .errors(errorMap(...COMMON_ERRORS, ...SESSION_ERRORS))
    .output(AllocationSchema),
};
```

```ts
import { Inject, Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import {
  type AssetClass,
  type HoldingValuation,
  type IsoDate,
  isLotUnlocked,
  istIsoDate,
  type NavQuote,
  type PortfolioTotals,
  sipCounts,
  summariseHoldings,
  toIsin,
  toIsoDate,
  valueHolding,
  type XirrCashflow,
  xirr,
  xirrHorizonDays,
} from '@sanchay/domain';
import {
  allocatePercentages,
  Dec,
  formatXirr,
  Money,
  Nav,
  Units,
  type XirrDisplay,
} from '@sanchay/money';
import { and, asc, eq, gte, inArray, ne } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { DB, type DbExecutor, type DbHandle } from '../../db/client.js';
import { schemes, sebiCategories } from '../catalogue/catalogue.schema.js';
import { NavService } from '../catalogue/nav/nav.service.js';
import { orders } from '../orders/orders.schema.js';
import { reservedUnits } from '../orders/redemption-evaluation.js';
import { mandates, plans } from '../plans/plans.schema.js';
import { CLOCK, type Clock, DAY } from '../platform/clock.js';
import { AppError } from '../platform/errors.js';
import { type FolioReconciliationStatus, folios } from './folios.schema.js';
import { lotConsumptions, lots } from './portfolio.schema.js';

/** D-MONEY-068: "paid but not allotted" purchases, shown as "₹X being invested". */
const PENDING_PURCHASE_STATUSES = ['PROCESSING', 'UNITS_PENDING'] as const;
/** HOME-02: orders the investor still has to pay for. */
const PAYMENT_DUE_STATUSES = ['AWAITING_PAYMENT', 'PAYMENT_PENDING'] as const;
const MISSED_INSTALMENT_STATUSES = ['FAILED', 'EXPIRED'] as const;
const MISSED_INSTALMENT_WINDOW_MS = 30 * DAY;

export interface XirrView {
  /** The fraction at 6 dp, or null when undefined or when PO-5 says "Too early". */
  readonly rate: string | null;
  readonly horizonDays: number;
  readonly display: XirrDisplay;
}

export interface HoldingRow {
  readonly folioId: string;
  readonly folioNumber: string | null;
  readonly reconciliationStatus: FolioReconciliationStatus;
  readonly schemeId: string;
  readonly isin: string;
  readonly schemeName: string;
  readonly categoryCode: string;
  readonly categoryName: string;
  readonly assetClass: AssetClass;
  readonly valuation: HoldingValuation;
  readonly xirr: XirrView;
}

export interface LotView {
  readonly lotId: string;
  readonly lotType: 'PURCHASE' | 'SIP_INSTALMENT';
  readonly allotmentDate: IsoDate;
  readonly nav: Nav;
  readonly units: Units;
  readonly unitsRemaining: Units;
  readonly costAmount: Money;
  readonly costRemaining: Money;
  readonly lockInUntil: IsoDate | null;
  readonly locked: boolean;
}

export interface HoldingDetail extends HoldingRow {
  readonly lots: readonly LotView[];
  /**
   * PORT-02: total = Σ units remaining; locked = still in lock-in today; inProcess = F5's
   * `reservedUnits` (live exits and open drafts, the figure RED-01's quote subtracts).
   */
  readonly units: { total: Units; available: Units; locked: Units; inProcess: Units };
  readonly pending: { amount: Money; count: number };
}

export type ThingToDoKind = 'PAYMENT_PENDING' | 'MANDATE_AUTH_PENDING' | 'SIP_INSTALMENT_MISSED';

export interface ThingToDo {
  readonly kind: ThingToDoKind;
  readonly entityId: string;
  readonly amount: Money | null;
  readonly at: Date;
}

export interface PortfolioSummary {
  readonly asOf: IsoDate;
  readonly totals: PortfolioTotals;
  /** The oldest NAV date any valued holding used ("NAV as of"). */
  readonly navAsOf: IsoDate | null;
  readonly xirr: XirrView;
  readonly pending: { amount: Money; count: number };
  readonly activeSips: number;
  readonly thingsToDo: readonly ThingToDo[];
}

export interface AllocationView {
  readonly assetClasses: ReadonlyArray<{
    assetClass: AssetClass;
    value: Money;
    percent: string;
    categories: ReadonlyArray<{ code: string; name: string; value: Money; percent: string }>;
  }>;
  /** H.2: invested money in holdings that could not be valued, never added to the bars. */
  readonly valuePending: Money;
}

interface LoadedHolding extends HoldingRow {
  readonly lots: readonly LotView[];
  /** Every lot cost, sale and the current value; null when a sale's proceeds are unknown. */
  readonly flows: readonly XirrCashflow[] | null;
}

const keyOf = (folioId: string, schemeId: string): string => `${folioId}:${schemeId}`;

/**
 * Compute-on-read portfolio (design §H, MED-1): lots + lot_consumptions + latest NAVs, valued by the
 * `@sanchay/domain` rules. Reads only; never calls a provider. Every method is scoped to one investor,
 * so a foreign folio is indistinguishable from a missing one (BOLA → NOT_FOUND).
 */
@Injectable()
export class PortfolioQueries {
  private readonly navs: NavService;

  constructor(
    @Inject(DB) private readonly dbh: DbHandle,
    @Inject(CLOCK) private readonly clock: Clock,
  ) {
    this.navs = new NavService(clock);
  }

  async summary(investorId: string): Promise<PortfolioSummary> {
    const db = this.dbh.db;
    const today = istIsoDate(this.clock.now());
    const holdings = await this.load(db, investorId, today);
    const totals = summariseHoldings(holdings.map((h) => h.valuation));
    const mismatch = holdings.some((h) => h.reconciliationStatus === 'MISMATCH');
    const flows = holdings.flatMap((h) => h.flows ?? []);
    const complete = holdings.every((h) => h.flows !== null);
    // D-MONEY-069: the portfolio rate needs every holding valued and no folio in MISMATCH.
    const rate = totals.coverage === 'OK' && !mismatch && complete ? xirr(flows) : null;
    const navDates = holdings.flatMap((h) =>
      h.valuation.navDate === null ? [] : [h.valuation.navDate],
    );
    const planRows = await db
      .select({ status: plans.status, amount: plans.amount })
      .from(plans)
      .where(eq(plans.investorId, investorId));
    return {
      asOf: today,
      totals,
      navAsOf: navDates.sort()[0] ?? null,
      xirr: xirrView(rate, xirrHorizonDays(flows)),
      pending: await this.pendingPurchases(db, investorId),
      // F10's single definition (D-MONEY-049): ACTIVE plans only. The rows already have its input shape.
      activeSips: sipCounts(planRows).active,
      thingsToDo: await this.thingsToDo(db, investorId),
    };
  }

  /** PORT-01: open holdings by value, unvalued last, then by scheme name (v1 HLD-11). */
  async holdings(investorId: string): Promise<HoldingRow[]> {
    const today = istIsoDate(this.clock.now());
    const loaded = await this.load(this.dbh.db, investorId, today);
    return loaded.map(({ lots: _lots, flows: _flows, ...row }) => row).sort(byValueThenName);
  }

  /** PORT-02. NOT_FOUND unless the folio is the investor's and holds this ISIN. */
  async holding(investorId: string, folioId: string, isin: string): Promise<HoldingDetail> {
    const db = this.dbh.db;
    const today = istIsoDate(this.clock.now());
    const [scheme] = await db
      .select({ id: schemes.id })
      .from(schemes)
      .where(eq(schemes.isin, isin));
    if (scheme === undefined) throw new AppError('NOT_FOUND');
    const [found] = await this.load(db, investorId, today, { folioId, schemeId: scheme.id });
    if (found === undefined) throw new AppError('NOT_FOUND');
    // F5's definition, so PORT-02 and RED-01 agree: ACTIVE reservations, minus CONSENT_PENDING drafts
    // whose challenge lapsed (EXPIRED, CANCELLED, SUPERSEDED, or PENDING past expires_at).
    const inProcess = await reservedUnits(db, {
      folioId,
      schemeId: scheme.id,
      now: this.clock.now(),
      excludeOrderId: null,
    });
    const zero = Units.zero(3);
    const open = found.lots.filter((l) => l.unitsRemaining.isPositive());
    const total = open.reduce((sum, l) => sum.add(l.unitsRemaining), zero);
    const locked = open.filter((l) => l.locked).reduce((sum, l) => sum.add(l.unitsRemaining), zero);
    const free = total.subtract(locked).subtract(inProcess);
    const { flows: _flows, ...row } = found;
    return {
      ...row,
      units: { total, locked, inProcess, available: free.isNegative() ? zero : free },
      pending: await this.pendingPurchases(db, investorId, { folioId, schemeId: scheme.id }),
    };
  }

  /** H.2: valued holdings by asset class, then SEBI category; shares sum to exactly 100.0. */
  async allocation(investorId: string): Promise<AllocationView> {
    const today = istIsoDate(this.clock.now());
    const holdings = await this.load(this.dbh.db, investorId, today);
    const valued = holdings.flatMap((h) =>
      h.valuation.currentValue === null ? [] : [{ h, value: h.valuation.currentValue }],
    );
    const unvalued = holdings.filter((h) => h.valuation.currentValue === null);
    const valuePending = unvalued.reduce((sum, h) => sum.add(h.valuation.invested), Money.ZERO);

    const categories = new Map<
      string,
      { assetClass: AssetClass; code: string; name: string; value: Money }
    >();
    for (const { h, value } of valued) {
      const prior = categories.get(h.categoryCode);
      categories.set(h.categoryCode, {
        assetClass: h.assetClass,
        code: h.categoryCode,
        name: h.categoryName,
        value: prior === undefined ? value : prior.value.add(value),
      });
    }
    const flat = [...categories.values()].sort(
      (a, b) => b.value.compare(a.value) || a.code.localeCompare(b.code),
    );
    const flatShares = allocatePercentages(flat.map((c) => c.value)) ?? [];
    const classes = new Map<AssetClass, Money>();
    for (const c of flat)
      classes.set(c.assetClass, (classes.get(c.assetClass) ?? Money.ZERO).add(c.value));
    const classList = [...classes.entries()]
      .map(([assetClass, value]) => ({ assetClass, value }))
      .sort((a, b) => b.value.compare(a.value) || a.assetClass.localeCompare(b.assetClass));
    const classShares = allocatePercentages(classList.map((c) => c.value)) ?? [];
    return {
      assetClasses: classList.map((c, i) => ({
        assetClass: c.assetClass,
        value: c.value,
        percent: classShares[i] ?? '0.0',
        categories: flat.flatMap((cat, j) =>
          cat.assetClass === c.assetClass
            ? [
                {
                  code: cat.code,
                  name: cat.name,
                  value: cat.value,
                  percent: flatShares[j] ?? '0.0',
                },
              ]
            : [],
        ),
      })),
      valuePending,
    };
  }

  /** Lots (REVERSED excluded) grouped per (folio, scheme); only groups with units left are holdings. */
  private async load(
    db: DbExecutor,
    investorId: string,
    today: IsoDate,
    only?: { folioId: string; schemeId: string },
  ): Promise<LoadedHolding[]> {
    const scope = and(
      eq(lots.investorId, investorId),
      ne(lots.status, 'REVERSED'),
      ...(only === undefined
        ? []
        : [eq(lots.folioId, only.folioId), eq(lots.schemeId, only.schemeId)]),
    );
    const rows = await db
      .select({
        lot: lots,
        folioNumber: folios.folioNumber,
        folioInvestorId: folios.investorId,
        reconciliationStatus: folios.reconciliationStatus,
        isin: schemes.isin,
        schemeName: schemes.name,
        categoryCode: schemes.categoryCode,
        categoryName: sebiCategories.name,
        assetClass: sebiCategories.assetClass,
      })
      .from(lots)
      .innerJoin(folios, eq(folios.id, lots.folioId))
      .innerJoin(schemes, eq(schemes.id, lots.schemeId))
      .innerJoin(sebiCategories, eq(sebiCategories.code, schemes.categoryCode))
      .where(scope)
      .orderBy(asc(lots.allotmentDate), asc(lots.id));
    const sales = await db
      .select({
        folioId: lots.folioId,
        schemeId: lots.schemeId,
        saleDate: lotConsumptions.saleDate,
        saleAmount: lotConsumptions.saleAmount,
      })
      .from(lotConsumptions)
      .innerJoin(lots, eq(lots.id, lotConsumptions.lotId))
      .where(scope);

    const groups = new Map<string, typeof rows>();
    for (const row of rows) {
      // Defence in depth: a lot whose folio belongs to someone else is never shown.
      if (row.folioInvestorId !== investorId) continue;
      const key = keyOf(row.lot.folioId, row.lot.schemeId);
      groups.set(key, [...(groups.get(key) ?? []), row]);
    }
    const out: LoadedHolding[] = [];
    for (const [key, group] of groups) {
      const head = group[0];
      if (head === undefined) continue;
      const lotViews = group.map(({ lot }): LotView => {
        const lockInUntil = lot.lockInUntil === null ? null : toIsoDate(lot.lockInUntil);
        return {
          lotId: lot.id,
          lotType: lot.lotType,
          allotmentDate: toIsoDate(lot.allotmentDate),
          nav: Nav.parse(lot.nav),
          units: Units.platform(lot.units),
          unitsRemaining: Units.platform(lot.unitsRemaining),
          costAmount: Money.parse(lot.costAmount),
          costRemaining: Money.parse(lot.costRemaining),
          lockInUntil,
          // Display only: RED-01 (F5) decides redeemability against the exit's NAV date.
          locked: !isLotUnlocked(lockInUntil, today),
        };
      });
      const open = lotViews.filter((l) => l.unitsRemaining.isPositive());
      if (open.length === 0) continue; // a closed position is not a holding (v1 HLD-05)
      const units = open.reduce((sum, l) => sum.add(l.unitsRemaining), Units.zero(3));
      const invested = open.reduce((sum, l) => sum.add(l.costRemaining), Money.ZERO);
      const valuation = valueHolding({
        units,
        invested,
        quote: await this.quoteOf(db, head.isin),
        today,
      });
      const groupSales = sales.filter((s) => keyOf(s.folioId, s.schemeId) === key);
      const flows = holdingFlows(lotViews, groupSales, valuation);
      const mismatch = head.reconciliationStatus === 'MISMATCH';
      // D-MONEY-065: a MISMATCH folio's XIRR is suppressed.
      const rate = valuation.valued && flows !== null && !mismatch ? xirr(flows) : null;
      out.push({
        folioId: head.lot.folioId,
        folioNumber: head.folioNumber,
        reconciliationStatus: head.reconciliationStatus,
        schemeId: head.lot.schemeId,
        isin: head.isin,
        schemeName: head.schemeName,
        categoryCode: head.categoryCode,
        categoryName: head.categoryName,
        assetClass: head.assetClass as AssetClass,
        valuation,
        xirr: xirrView(rate, xirrHorizonDays(flows ?? [])),
        lots: lotViews,
        flows,
      });
    }
    return out;
  }

  private async quoteOf(db: DbExecutor, isin: string): Promise<NavQuote | null> {
    const latest = await this.navs.latest(db, toIsin(isin));
    if (latest === null) return null;
    return { nav: Nav.parse(latest.nav), navDate: toIsoDate(latest.navDate), grade: latest.grade };
  }

  private async pendingPurchases(
    db: DbExecutor,
    investorId: string,
    only?: { folioId: string; schemeId: string },
  ): Promise<{ amount: Money; count: number }> {
    const rows = await db
      .select({ amount: orders.amount, folioId: orders.folioId })
      .from(orders)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(orders.investorId, investorId),
          eq(orders.type, 'PURCHASE'),
          inArray(orders.status, [...PENDING_PURCHASE_STATUSES]),
          ...(only === undefined ? [] : [eq(orders.schemeId, only.schemeId)]),
        ),
      );
    // A first purchase has no folio until FP names one, so it counts toward any folio of the scheme.
    const scoped = rows.filter(
      (r) => only === undefined || r.folioId === null || r.folioId === only.folioId,
    );
    return {
      amount: scoped.reduce(
        (sum, r) => (r.amount === null ? sum : sum.add(Money.parse(r.amount))),
        Money.ZERO,
      ),
      count: scoped.length,
    };
  }

  /** HOME-02 items the API can know today, newest first. */
  private async thingsToDo(db: DbExecutor, investorId: string): Promise<ThingToDo[]> {
    const since = new Date(this.clock.now().getTime() - MISSED_INSTALMENT_WINDOW_MS);
    const due = await db
      .select({ id: orders.id, amount: orders.amount, at: orders.createdAt })
      .from(orders)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(orders.investorId, investorId),
          eq(orders.type, 'PURCHASE'),
          inArray(orders.status, [...PAYMENT_DUE_STATUSES]),
        ),
      );
    const mandatesDue = await db
      .select({ id: mandates.id, at: mandates.createdAt })
      .from(mandates)
      .where(and(eq(mandates.investorId, investorId), eq(mandates.status, 'AUTH_PENDING')));
    // updated_at, not final_at: it is set by every status move, whichever job made it (F2/F4).
    const missed = await db
      .select({ id: orders.id, amount: orders.amount, at: orders.updatedAt })
      .from(orders)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(orders.investorId, investorId),
          eq(orders.origin, 'SIP_INSTALMENT'),
          inArray(orders.status, [...MISSED_INSTALMENT_STATUSES]),
          gte(orders.updatedAt, since),
        ),
      );
    const items: ThingToDo[] = [
      ...due.map((o) => ({
        kind: 'PAYMENT_PENDING' as const,
        entityId: o.id,
        amount: Money.parseNullable(o.amount),
        at: o.at,
      })),
      ...mandatesDue.map((m) => ({
        kind: 'MANDATE_AUTH_PENDING' as const,
        entityId: m.id,
        amount: null,
        at: m.at,
      })),
      ...missed.map((o) => ({
        kind: 'SIP_INSTALMENT_MISSED' as const,
        entityId: o.id,
        amount: Money.parseNullable(o.amount),
        at: o.at,
      })),
    ];
    return items.sort((a, b) => b.at.getTime() - a.at.getTime());
  }
}

/**
 * D-MONEY-069 flows: -cost on each lot's allotment date, +proceeds on each sale date, +value on the
 * NAV date. Null when any sale's proceeds are unknown (the rate would be wrong, not just rough).
 */
function holdingFlows(
  lotViews: readonly LotView[],
  sales: ReadonlyArray<{ saleDate: string; saleAmount: string | null }>,
  valuation: HoldingValuation,
): XirrCashflow[] | null {
  if (sales.some((s) => s.saleAmount === null)) return null;
  const flows: XirrCashflow[] = [
    ...lotViews.map((l) => ({ date: l.allotmentDate, amount: l.costAmount.negate() })),
    ...sales.map((s) => ({
      date: toIsoDate(s.saleDate),
      amount: Money.parse(s.saleAmount ?? '0.00'),
    })),
  ];
  if (valuation.currentValue !== null && valuation.navDate !== null) {
    flows.push({ date: valuation.navDate, amount: valuation.currentValue });
  }
  return flows;
}

/** PO-5 display; under 30 days the rate itself is withheld so no client can show it. */
export function xirrView(rate: number | null, horizonDays: number): XirrView {
  const display = formatXirr(rate === null ? null : new Dec(rate), horizonDays);
  return {
    rate: rate === null || display.caveat === 'TOO_EARLY' ? null : new Dec(rate).toFixed(6),
    horizonDays,
    display,
  };
}

function byValueThenName(a: HoldingRow, b: HoldingRow): number {
  const av = a.valuation.currentValue;
  const bv = b.valuation.currentValue;
  if (av !== null && bv !== null && !av.equals(bv)) return bv.compare(av);
  if (av !== null && bv === null) return -1;
  if (av === null && bv !== null) return 1;
  return a.schemeName.localeCompare(b.schemeName);
}
```

```ts
import { Controller, Inject } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Implement, implement } from '@orpc/nest';
import { contract } from '@sanchay/contract';
import { ClsService } from 'nestjs-cls';
import { requireAuth } from '../identity/request-auth.js';
import type { SanchayClsStore } from '../platform/request-context.js';
import {
  type HoldingDetail,
  type HoldingRow,
  PortfolioQueries,
  type XirrView,
} from './portfolio.queries.js';

const xirrWire = (x: XirrView) => ({
  rate: x.rate,
  horizonDays: x.horizonDays,
  text: x.display.text,
  caveat: x.display.caveat,
  caveatText: x.display.caveatText,
  showAbsoluteReturn: x.display.showAbsoluteReturn,
});

const rowWire = (h: HoldingRow) => ({
  folioId: h.folioId,
  folioNumber: h.folioNumber,
  reconciliationStatus: h.reconciliationStatus,
  schemeId: h.schemeId,
  isin: h.isin,
  schemeName: h.schemeName,
  categoryCode: h.categoryCode,
  categoryName: h.categoryName,
  assetClass: h.assetClass,
  units: h.valuation.units.toWire(),
  invested: h.valuation.invested.toWire(),
  avgCostNav: h.valuation.avgCostNav,
  currentValue: h.valuation.currentValue?.toWire() ?? null,
  nav: h.valuation.nav?.toWire() ?? null,
  navDate: h.valuation.navDate,
  navGrade: h.valuation.navGrade,
  absoluteReturn: h.valuation.absoluteReturn?.toWire() ?? null,
  percentReturn: h.valuation.percentReturn,
  xirr: xirrWire(h.xirr),
});

const detailWire = (h: HoldingDetail) => ({
  ...rowWire(h),
  lots: h.lots.map((l) => ({
    lotId: l.lotId,
    lotType: l.lotType,
    allotmentDate: l.allotmentDate,
    nav: l.nav.toWire(),
    units: l.units.toWire(),
    unitsRemaining: l.unitsRemaining.toWire(),
    costAmount: l.costAmount.toWire(),
    costRemaining: l.costRemaining.toWire(),
    lockInUntil: l.lockInUntil,
    locked: l.locked,
  })),
  units: {
    total: h.units.total.toWire(),
    available: h.units.available.toWire(),
    locked: h.units.locked.toWire(),
    inProcess: h.units.inProcess.toWire(),
  },
  pending: { amount: h.pending.amount.toWire(), count: h.pending.count },
});

/** Session-scoped reads (no Idempotency-Key: nothing is written). */
@Controller()
export class PortfolioRouter {
  constructor(
    @Inject(PortfolioQueries) private readonly queries: PortfolioQueries,
    @Inject(ClsService) private readonly cls: ClsService<SanchayClsStore>,
  ) {}

  @Implement(contract.portfolio.summary)
  summary() {
    return implement(contract.portfolio.summary).handler(async () => {
      const s = await this.queries.summary(requireAuth(this.cls).investorId);
      const t = s.totals;
      return {
        asOf: s.asOf,
        holdingCount: t.holdingCount,
        valuedCount: t.valuedCount,
        coverage: t.coverage,
        invested: t.invested.toWire(),
        investedValued: t.investedValued.toWire(),
        unvaluedInvested: t.unvaluedInvested.toWire(),
        currentValue: t.currentValue?.toWire() ?? null,
        valuedValue: t.valuedValue?.toWire() ?? null,
        absoluteReturn: t.absoluteReturn?.toWire() ?? null,
        percentReturn: t.percentReturn,
        navAsOf: s.navAsOf,
        xirr: xirrWire(s.xirr),
        pending: { amount: s.pending.amount.toWire(), count: s.pending.count },
        activeSips: s.activeSips,
        thingsToDo: s.thingsToDo.map((item) => ({
          kind: item.kind,
          entityId: item.entityId,
          amount: item.amount?.toWire() ?? null,
          at: item.at.toISOString(),
        })),
      };
    });
  }

  @Implement(contract.portfolio.holdings)
  holdings() {
    return implement(contract.portfolio.holdings).handler(async () =>
      (await this.queries.holdings(requireAuth(this.cls).investorId)).map(rowWire),
    );
  }

  @Implement(contract.portfolio.holding)
  holding() {
    return implement(contract.portfolio.holding).handler(async ({ input }) =>
      detailWire(
        await this.queries.holding(requireAuth(this.cls).investorId, input.folioId, input.isin),
      ),
    );
  }

  @Implement(contract.portfolio.allocation)
  allocation() {
    return implement(contract.portfolio.allocation).handler(async () => {
      const a = await this.queries.allocation(requireAuth(this.cls).investorId);
      return {
        assetClasses: a.assetClasses.map((c) => ({
          assetClass: c.assetClass,
          value: c.value.toWire(),
          percent: c.percent,
          categories: c.categories.map((cat) => ({
            code: cat.code,
            name: cat.name,
            value: cat.value.toWire(),
            percent: cat.percent,
          })),
        })),
        valuePending: a.valuePending.toWire(),
      };
    });
  }
}
```

`docs/specs/money/xirr.md`:
```md
# XIRR (money spec)

Owner: Plan 04 Task F11. Code: `packages/domain/src/rules/xirr.ts`. Golden vectors:
`packages/test-fixtures/src/golden/xirr.json` (V1–V11). Rulings: D-MONEY-069, PO-5, outline §0.4 item 6.

## What it computes

The annual money-weighted rate `r` that solves `Σ cf / (1 + r)^(days / 365) = 0`, where `days`
counts calendar days from the earliest flow. The result is a fraction (`0.1` = 10%) or `null`.
`null` means "unavailable" and is never shown as 0%.

It is a line-for-line port of v1 `XirrCalculator.java`
(`platiziowealthtech-Back_end/src/main/java/com/platizio/wealthtech/service/XirrCalculator.java`).
Money becomes an IEEE-754 double only inside this function (research rules-money §1: XIRR is the one
exception to "never a JavaScript number for money").

## Constants (`XIRR_PARAMS`)

| Constant | Value | v1 line |
|---|---|---|
| NPV tolerance | 1e-7 | `:30` |
| Newton iterations | 100, seed 0.1 | `:31`, `:84` |
| Flat derivative | abs < 1e-12 hands off to bisection | `:94` |
| Newton step stop | abs(step) < 1e-12 | `:101` |
| Newton post-loop accept | abs(NPV) < 1e-4 | `:108` |
| Bisection | low = -0.999999999, high = 1.0 doubled up to 100 times, 200 halvings, width stop 1e-12 | `:118-155` |
| Days per year | 365 | `:33` |

## Null cases

No list, fewer than two non-zero flows, all non-zero flows one sign, every non-zero flow on one day,
or no root found (Newton hands off and bisection cannot bracket a sign change).

## Deviation from v1 (B-01, fixed)

v1 counts a zero-amount flow toward the date span. For V11 (−1000 and +1000 on 2024-01-01, plus
0.00 on 2024-12-31) the NPV is identically zero, so v1 returns its Newton seed: **0.1 (10%)**.
v2 drops zero-amount flows before the guards, so V11 has a zero horizon and returns **null**.
`xirr.json` records both (`expected: null`, `v1Expected: 0.1`). No other input changes value:
a zero flow inside the span contributes nothing to the NPV in either version.

## Not ported (dead code)

v1's `if (base <= 0) return NaN` in `npv` and `npvDerivative`. Newton never evaluates a rate at or
below MIN_RATE (it refuses that step) and bisection starts at MIN_RATE > −1, so the guard is never
reached; a non-positive base would give a non-finite sum, which every caller already treats as
"no rate".

## Unbounded results (Q-1)

The engine does not clamp. V10 (−100 then +1000 thirty days later) returns about 1.4678e12.
PO-5 governs what is shown (`formatXirr`, Plan 01 A7): under 30 days of horizon the text is
"Too early" and the API withholds the rate (`rate: null`); from 30 to 364 days it carries the
"Annualised; can swing widely for holdings under 1 year" caveat with the absolute return beside it.

## Flows the portfolio feeds it (D-MONEY-069)

- −`cost_amount` of every non-reversed lot on its `allotment_date` (gross, stamp duty included);
- +`sale_amount` of every `lot_consumptions` row on its `sale_date`;
- +current value on the valuation NAV date, only when the holding is valued.

A holding's rate is null when it is not valued, when any of its sales has unknown proceeds, or when
its folio is `MISMATCH` (D-MONEY-065). The portfolio rate is null unless every holding is valued,
no folio is `MISMATCH` and every holding's flows are complete. The horizon passed to `formatXirr` is
the whole number of calendar days from the earliest to the latest flow (`xirrHorizonDays`).
```

HOME-02's `MANDATE_AUTH_PENDING` thing-to-do (F11, `entityId` = mandate id) links to `/portfolio/sips/mandates/{entityId}` (F14 wires it).

The two keys are the ones F18's `SECURE_ROUTES` lists. The two `invest/[schemeId]/sip/*` routes are registered inside the root layout's signed-in `Stack.Protected`, as F16 does for its redeem route. The three `portfolio/sips/*` files stay at the app root until F14 turns the Portfolio tab into a stack and moves them under `(tabs)/portfolio/sips/` (F14's fix), which also puts them inside the signed-in group; so they are not registered here, and that move needs no layout edit.

- **Deviations from the outline (recorded):**
  1. **Screen order is SIP-01 → SIP-03 → CNF-01 → SIP-02/MND-03**, not journeys §4.8's "sip → mandate → review". F2 chooses or creates the mandate inside `plans.createSip` (one consent covers plan and mandate), so the mandate step can only be the authorisation after consent. There is no investor mandate picker in the MVP (spec §1.3: reuse with headroom is a server rule).
  2. **The Android `openAuthSessionAsync(…, '/app/r/mandate')` return moves to F13.** A UPI Autopay mandate is approved inside the UPI app from a `upi://mandate` intent, which `Linking.openURL` opens; there is no bank web page to return from. The sandbox confirms it: the UPI authorise returns `upi.uri` and no `token_url` (probe P-09). Only eNACH's `token_url` is a web page, so the auth session, `expo-web-browser` and the `/app/r/mandate` return URL are F13's. If T6 is taken, nothing in the MVP needs them.
  3. **`schemeName` is added to F2's `PlanSchema` and F10's `SipQuoteSchema`.** Neither carried a fund name, so SIP-01, SIPM-01 and SIPM-02 could not name the fund. The join is in `SipService.get/list` (the router only shapes the wire).
  4. **Desktop web has no UPI QR.** MND-03 says "intent or QR as in PAY-01", but no QR library is in the `catalog:` (nobody edits it) and FP returns the intent as a `upi://` URI only. The screen tells a desktop investor to open Sanchay on their phone. Owner decision recorded in the open questions.
  5. **Instalment history is a link to Orders.** SIPM-02's instalment list needs a `plans.instalments` read that is not in the MVP spec; instalments are already `orders(origin=SIP_INSTALMENT)` and appear in ORD-01 (E24).
  6. **Web pages render through `client/routes.tsx`** (the Plan 01 pattern: server `page.tsx` → `'use client'` wrapper), not by importing `@sanchay/features` into a server component as E23/E24's pages do.
  7. **No "Start SIP" button in this task (assembly decision D4).** SIP-01 is keyed by the catalogue's scheme uuid (`SchemeDetailSchema.id`, RV-03-8). F19's FUND-01 adds "Start SIP" beside E17's "Invest", and F14's PORT-02 may add one too; both run after F12 in the execution order. Until F19 lands, only a typed URL reaches SIP-01. That is why the smoke reads the id from `GET /catalogue/schemes/{slug}`, the same id FUND-01 will push.
  8. **The smoke stops at MND-03 showing "Open UPI app".** FakeFp has no env-wired auto-advance (Plan 02 D4's FakeFp declares `autoAdvance = false` and nothing reads it), and in the sandbox a UPI mandate is approved in a UPI app. So the APPROVED → plan ACTIVE path is covered by `MandateScreen.test.tsx` (MSW) and F2's `sip-mandate.int.test.ts` (FakeFp `advanceMandate`/`advancePlan`), not by Playwright. The draft's second test (`SANCHAY_E2E_FP_AUTOADVANCE`) is dropped.

```tsx
import { screen, within } from '@testing-library/react';
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
import { HttpResponse, http } from 'msw';
import { setupServer } from 'msw/node';
import { afterAll, afterEach, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { renderWithProviders, TEST_API } from '../test-utils';
import { SipSetupScreen } from './SipSetupScreen';

const schemeId = '0192f0e0-0000-7000-8000-0000000000b1';
const FIRST_BY_DAY: Record<number, string> = {
  5: '2026-11-05',
  10: '2026-10-12',
  20: '2026-10-20',
};

function quote(body: { installmentDay?: number | null; amount?: string | null }) {
  const day = body.installmentDay ?? null;
  return {
    schemeName: 'Sanchay Flexicap Fund - Regular Growth',
    availableDays: [5, 10, 20],
    minimumAmount: '500.00',
    maximumAmount: '100000.00',
    multiple: '100.00',
    amount: body.amount ?? null,
    installmentDay: day,
    firstInstalmentDate: day === null ? null : (FIRST_BY_DAY[day] ?? null),
    numberOfInstalments: null,
    duration: 'UNTIL_CANCELLED',
  };
}

const quoteBodies: Array<Record<string, unknown>> = [];
const server = setupServer(
  http.post(`${TEST_API}/plans/sips/quote`, async ({ request }) => {
    const body = (await request.json()) as { installmentDay?: number | null };
    quoteBodies.push(body);
    return HttpResponse.json(quote(body));
  }),
);
beforeAll(() => server.listen({ onUnhandledRequest: 'error' }));
afterEach(() => {
  quoteBodies.length = 0;
});
afterAll(() => server.close());

describe('SipSetupScreen (SIP-01)', () => {
  it('day picker only offers scheme sip_dates, none preselected', async () => {
    renderWithProviders(<SipSetupScreen schemeId={schemeId} />);
    const chips = within(await screen.findByTestId('sip-day-chips')).getAllByRole('button');
    expect(chips.map((chip) => chip.getAttribute('aria-label'))).toEqual(['5th', '10th', '20th']);
    expect(chips.every((chip) => chip.getAttribute('aria-pressed') === 'false')).toBe(true);
    expect(screen.queryByTestId('sip-first-instalment')).toBeNull();
    // The first quote asks for limits only: no day was sent, so none was chosen for the investor.
    expect(quoteBodies[0]).toEqual({ schemeId });
  });

  it('first instalment date shown and re-shown when the day changes', async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    renderWithProviders(<SipSetupScreen schemeId={schemeId} />);
    await user.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: '10th' }));
    expect(await screen.findByText('First instalment on 12 Oct 2026')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '10th' }).getAttribute('aria-pressed')).toBe('true');
    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '20th' }));
    expect(await screen.findByText('First instalment on 20 Oct 2026')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.queryByText('First instalment on 12 Oct 2026')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('blocks an amount below the minimum or a missing day, then hands a valid draft to review', async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    const { nav } = renderWithProviders(<SipSetupScreen schemeId={schemeId} />);
    const amount = await screen.findByLabelText('Monthly amount');
    await user.type(amount, '400');
    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Continue' }));
    expect(await screen.findByText('Minimum amount is ₹500.00.')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('Choose a SIP date.')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(nav.push).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

    await user.clear(amount);
    await user.type(amount, '5000');
    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '20th' }));
    await screen.findByText('First instalment on 20 Oct 2026');
    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Continue' }));
    expect(nav.push).toHaveBeenCalledWith(`/invest/${schemeId}/sip/review`);
  });

  it('needs 1 to 360 instalments when the duration is a fixed number', async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    const { nav } = renderWithProviders(<SipSetupScreen schemeId={schemeId} />);
    await user.type(await screen.findByLabelText('Monthly amount'), '1000');
    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '5th' }));
    await screen.findByText('First instalment on 05 Nov 2026');
    await user.click(screen.getByRole('radio', { name: 'Fixed number' }));
    await user.type(screen.getByLabelText('Number of instalments'), '400');
    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Continue' }));
    expect(await screen.findByText('Enter between 1 and 360 instalments.')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(nav.push).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});
```

```tsx
import { screen, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';

import { setupServer } from 'msw/node';
import { afterAll, afterEach, beforeAll, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { renderWithProviders, TEST_API } from '../test-utils';
import { SipReviewScreen } from './SipReviewScreen';
import { type SipDraft, useSipDraft } from './useSipDraft';

// CNF-01 is E13's sheet; here it is a stand-in whose button plays "the investor approved".
vi.mock('../consent/ConsentOtpSheet', () => ({
  ConsentOtpSheet: ({
    challengeId,
    onApproved,
  }: {
    challengeId: string;
    onApproved: () => void;
  }) => <button type="button" onClick={onApproved}>{`Approve ${challengeId}`}</button>,
}));

const schemeId = '0192f0e0-0000-7000-8000-0000000000b1';
const planId = '0192f0e0-0000-7000-8000-0000000000c1';
const mandateId = '0192f0e0-0000-7000-8000-0000000000d1';
const challengeId = '0192f0e0-0000-7000-8000-0000000000e1';
const draft: SipDraft = {
  amount: '5000.00',
  installmentDay: 10,
  numberOfInstalments: null,
  quotedFirstInstalmentDate: '2026-10-12',
};

const quoteReply = () =>
  HttpResponse.json({
    schemeName: 'Sanchay Flexicap Fund - Regular Growth',
    availableDays: [5, 10, 20],
    minimumAmount: '500.00',
    maximumAmount: '100000.00',
    multiple: '100.00',
    amount: '5000.00',
    installmentDay: 10,
    firstInstalmentDate: '2026-10-12',
    numberOfInstalments: null,
    duration: 'UNTIL_CANCELLED',
  });

const created = (overrides: { newMandate: boolean; firstInstalmentDate?: string }) => ({
  planId,
  mandateId,
  challengeId,
  expiresAt: '2026-10-08T05:10:00.000Z',
  firstInstalmentDate: '2026-10-12',
  ...overrides,
});

function WithDraft({ value }: { value: SipDraft | null }) {
  const draftStore = useSipDraft(schemeId);
  if (value !== null) draftStore.save(value);
  return <SipReviewScreen schemeId={schemeId} />;
}

const keys: Array<string | null> = [];
const server = setupServer();
beforeAll(() => server.listen({ onUnhandledRequest: 'error' }));
afterEach(() => {
  server.resetHandlers();
  keys.length = 0;
});
afterAll(() => server.close());

function useHandlers(reply: ReturnType<typeof created>) {
  server.use(
    http.post(`${TEST_API}/plans/sips/quote`, () => quoteReply()),
    http.post(`${TEST_API}/plans/sips`, ({ request }) => {
      keys.push(request.headers.get('idempotency-key'));
      return HttpResponse.json(reply);
    }),
  );
}

      ),
    ).toBeTruthy();
    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: `Approve ${challengeId}` }));
    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(nav.replace).toHaveBeenCalledWith(`/portfolio/sips/mandates/${mandateId}`),
    );
  });

  it('retries a network failure with the same idempotency key', async () => {
    server.use(
      http.post(`${TEST_API}/plans/sips/quote`, () => quoteReply()),
      http.post(`${TEST_API}/plans/sips`, ({ request }) => {
        keys.push(request.headers.get('idempotency-key'));
        return keys.length === 1
          ? HttpResponse.error()
          : HttpResponse.json(created({ newMandate: false }));
      }),
    );
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    renderWithProviders(<WithDraft value={draft} />);
    await user.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Confirm & get OTP' }));
    expect(
      await screen.findByText('You seem to be offline. Check your connection and try again.'),
    ).toBeTruthy();
    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Confirm & get OTP' }));
    await screen.findByRole('button', { name: `Approve ${challengeId}` });
    expect(keys).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(keys[0]).toMatch(/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/);
    expect(keys[1]).toBe(keys[0]);
  });

  it('shows the copy of a final refusal; the next tap is a new intent with a new key', async () => {
    // A refusal ends the intent (D1 releases its key): the next tap mints a new key.
    server.use(
      http.post(`${TEST_API}/plans/sips/quote`, () => quoteReply()),
      http.post(`${TEST_API}/plans/sips`, ({ request }) => {
        keys.push(request.headers.get('idempotency-key'));
        if (keys.length === 1) {
          return HttpResponse.json(
            {
              defined: true,
              code: 'FEATURE_DISABLED',
              status: 403,
              message: 'FEATURE_DISABLED',
              data: { retryable: false, requestId: '0192f0e0-0000-7000-8000-0000000000ff' },
            },
            { status: 403 },
          );
        }
        return HttpResponse.json(created({ newMandate: false }));
      }),
    );
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    renderWithProviders(<WithDraft value={draft} />);
    await user.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Confirm & get OTP' }));
    expect(await screen.findByText('This feature is not available right now.')).toBeTruthy();
    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Confirm & get OTP' }));
    await screen.findByRole('button', { name: `Approve ${challengeId}` });
    expect(keys).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(keys[1]).toMatch(/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/);
    expect(keys[1]).not.toBe(keys[0]);
  });

  it('goes back to SIP-01 when there is no draft', async () => {
    const { nav } = renderWithProviders(<WithDraft value={null} />);
    await waitFor(() => expect(nav.replace).toHaveBeenCalledWith(`/invest/${schemeId}/sip`));
  });
});
```

```tsx
import { screen, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
import { HttpResponse, http } from 'msw';
import { setupServer } from 'msw/node';
import { Linking } from 'react-native';
import { afterAll, afterEach, beforeAll, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { renderWithProviders, TEST_API } from '../test-utils';
import { MandateScreen } from './MandateScreen';

const mandateId = '0192f0e0-0000-7000-8000-0000000000d1';
const UPI_URI = 'upi://mandate?pa=cybrilla@upi&mn=Sanchay&am=100000.00';

const mandate = (status: string, overrides: Record<string, unknown> = {}) => ({
  id: mandateId,
  rail: 'UPI_AUTOPAY',
  limitAmount: '100000.00',
  status,
  upiUri: status === 'AUTH_PENDING' ? UPI_URI : null,
  authUrl: null,
  approvedAt: status === 'APPROVED' ? '2026-10-08T06:00:00.000Z' : null,
  createdAt: '2026-10-08T05:00:00.000Z',
  ...overrides,
});

const server = setupServer();
beforeAll(() => server.listen({ onUnhandledRequest: 'error' }));
afterEach(() => {
  server.resetHandlers();
  vi.restoreAllMocks();
});
afterAll(() => server.close());

describe('MandateScreen (SIP-02/MND-03)', () => {
  it('opens the UPI intent for a pending UPI Autopay mandate and polls until APPROVED', async () => {
    // FP approves only after the investor has been sent to the UPI app.
    let opened = false;
    let readsAfterOpen = 0;
    server.use(
      http.get(`${TEST_API}/mandates/${mandateId}`, () => {
        if (opened) readsAfterOpen += 1;
        return HttpResponse.json(mandate(readsAfterOpen >= 2 ? 'APPROVED' : 'AUTH_PENDING'));
      }),
    );
    const open = vi.spyOn(Linking, 'openURL').mockImplementation(async () => {
      opened = true;
      return true;
    });
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    const { nav } = renderWithProviders(<MandateScreen mandateId={mandateId} pollMs={20} />);
    expect(
      await screen.findByText(
        'Approve the ₹1,00,000.00 autopay request in your UPI app with your UPI PIN.',
      ),
    ).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('Up to ₹1,00,000.00 per debit · UPI Autopay')).toBeTruthy();
    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Open UPI app' }));
    expect(open).toHaveBeenCalledWith(UPI_URI);
    expect(
      await screen.findByText(
        'Mandate approved. Your SIP is being registered with the fund house.',
      ),
    ).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Open UPI app' })).toBeNull();
    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'View my SIPs' }));
    expect(nav.replace).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/portfolio/sips');
  });

  it('re-mints the UPI request with an Idempotency-Key', async () => {
    const keys: Array<string | null> = [];
    server.use(
      http.get(`${TEST_API}/mandates/${mandateId}`, () =>
        HttpResponse.json(mandate('AUTH_PENDING')),
      ),
      http.post(`${TEST_API}/mandates/${mandateId}/authorize`, ({ request }) => {
        keys.push(request.headers.get('idempotency-key'));
        return HttpResponse.json({ ok: true });
      }),
    );
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    renderWithProviders(<MandateScreen mandateId={mandateId} pollMs={60_000} />);
    await user.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Send a new request' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(keys).toHaveLength(1));
    expect(keys[0]).toMatch(/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/);
  });

  it('re-sends the key after a network error and mints a new one after a refusal', async () => {
    const keys: Array<string | null> = [];
    server.use(
      http.get(`${TEST_API}/mandates/${mandateId}`, () =>
        HttpResponse.json(mandate('AUTH_PENDING')),
      ),
      http.post(`${TEST_API}/mandates/${mandateId}/authorize`, ({ request }) => {
        keys.push(request.headers.get('idempotency-key'));
        if (keys.length === 1) return HttpResponse.error();
        return HttpResponse.json(
          {
            defined: true,
            code: 'MANDATE_STATE_INVALID',
            status: 409,
            message: 'MANDATE_STATE_INVALID',
            data: { retryable: false, requestId: '0192f0e0-0000-7000-8000-0000000000ff' },
          },
          { status: 409 },
        );
      }),
    );
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    renderWithProviders(<MandateScreen mandateId={mandateId} pollMs={60_000} />);
    await user.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Send a new request' }));
    expect(
      await screen.findByText('You seem to be offline. Check your connection and try again.'),
    ).toBeTruthy();
    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Send a new request' }));
    expect(
      await screen.findByText('This mandate is not waiting for your approval right now.'),
    ).toBeTruthy();
    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Send a new request' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(keys).toHaveLength(3));
    expect(keys[0]).toMatch(/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/);
    expect(keys[1]).toBe(keys[0]);
    expect(keys[2]).not.toBe(keys[1]);
  });

  it('says nothing was debited when the mandate is rejected, and stops polling', async () => {
    let reads = 0;
    server.use(
      http.get(`${TEST_API}/mandates/${mandateId}`, () => {
        reads += 1;
        return HttpResponse.json(mandate('REJECTED'));
      }),
    );
    renderWithProviders(<MandateScreen mandateId={mandateId} pollMs={20} />);
    expect(
      await screen.findByText('This mandate could not be set up. Nothing was debited.'),
    ).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Back to my SIPs' })).toBeTruthy();
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 120));
    expect(reads).toBe(1);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { schemes } from '../../src/modules/catalogue/catalogue.schema.js';
import { SipService } from '../../src/modules/plans/sip.service.js';
import { Jobs } from '../../src/modules/platform/jobs/jobs.service.js';
import { bootTestApp, type TestApp } from './app.js';
import { webHeaders } from './http.js';
import { seedSipInvestor, seedSipScheme, setSipEnabled } from './sip-seed.js';

let t: TestApp;
let investor: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof seedSipInvestor>>;

beforeAll(async () => {
  t = await bootTestApp();
  vi.spyOn(t.app.get(Jobs), 'enqueue').mockResolvedValue('job-id');
  await setSipEnabled(t, true);
  investor = await seedSipInvestor(t);
});
afterAll(async () => {
  await t.close();
});

const call = (method: 'GET' | 'POST', url: string, payload?: Record<string, unknown>) =>
  t.app.inject({
    method,
    url: `/api/v1${url}`,
    headers: webHeaders({ cookies: investor.cookies }),
    ...(payload === undefined ? {} : { payload }),
  });

describe('SIP wire shapes carry the fund name (F12)', () => {
  it('plans.quoteSip, plans.get and plans.list return schemeName', async () => {
    const scheme = await seedSipScheme(t);
    const [row] = await t.db.db
      .select({ name: schemes.name })
      .from(schemes)
      .where(eq(schemes.id, scheme.id));
    expect(row).toBeDefined();

    const quote = await call('POST', '/plans/sips/quote', { schemeId: scheme.id });
    expect(quote.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(quote.json()).toMatchObject({ schemeName: row?.name });

    const created = await t.app.get(SipService).createSip({
      investorId: investor.investorId,
      schemeId: scheme.id,
      amount: '5000.00',
      installmentDay: 10,
      numberOfInstalments: null,
      rail: 'UPI_AUTOPAY', // F3; drop this line if T6 removed F3
      userIp: '203.0.113.10',
      initiatedVia: 'web',
    });

    const one = await call('GET', `/plans/${created.planId}`);
    expect(one.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(one.json()).toMatchObject({ id: created.planId, schemeName: row?.name });

    const all = await call('GET', '/plans');
    expect(all.statusCode).toBe(200);
    const listed = all.json<Array<{ id: string; schemeName: string }>>();
    expect(listed.find((p) => p.id === created.planId)?.schemeName).toBe(row?.name);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { formatInr, Money } from '@sanchay/money';

/** "1st", "2nd", "3rd", "4th" … "21st", "22nd", "23rd", "28th" (SIP days are 1–28). */
export function ordinalDay(day: number): string {
  const tens = day % 100;
  if (tens >= 11 && tens <= 13) return `${day}th`;
  const suffix = day % 10 === 1 ? 'st' : day % 10 === 2 ? 'nd' : day % 10 === 3 ? 'rd' : 'th';
  return `${day}${suffix}`;
}

export function sipDayLabel(day: number): string {
  return `${ordinalDay(day)} of every month`;
}

export function durationLabel(numberOfInstalments: number | null): string {
  if (numberOfInstalments === null) return 'Until you cancel';
  return numberOfInstalments === 1 ? '1 instalment' : `${numberOfInstalments} instalments`;
}

/** SIPM-01/02 status pill copy, keyed by D5's PLAN statuses (the wire carries a plain string). */
export const PLAN_STATUS_LABEL: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = {
  CONSENT_PENDING: 'Waiting for your confirmation',
  CONSENTED: 'Setting up',
  MANDATE_SETUP: 'Mandate pending',
  SUBMITTING: 'Setting up',
  UNDER_REVIEW: 'With the fund house for review',
  CONFIRMING: 'Setting up',
  ACTIVE: 'Active',
  RECONCILING: 'Checking status',
  CANCEL_PENDING: 'Cancelling',
  CANCELLED: 'Cancelled',
  FAILED: "Couldn't start",
  REJECTED: 'Rejected by the fund house',
  CONSENT_EXPIRED: 'Expired',
  MANDATE_REVOKED: 'Mandate cancelled',
  COMPLETED: 'Completed',
};

export function planStatusLabel(status: string): string {
  return PLAN_STATUS_LABEL[status] ?? 'In progress';
}

export const MANDATE_RAIL_LABEL: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = {
  UPI_AUTOPAY: 'UPI Autopay',
  ENACH: 'Bank mandate (eNACH)',
};

/** "Up to ₹1,00,000.00 per debit · UPI Autopay". */
export function mandateLimitLine(rail: string, limitAmount: string): string {
  return `Up to ${formatInr(Money.parse(limitAmount))} per debit · ${MANDATE_RAIL_LABEL[rail] ?? rail}`;
}

/** The UPI Autopay mandate is fixed at ₹1,00,000 (spec §1.3); F2 creates every UPI mandate at this limit. */
export const UPI_AUTOPAY_LIMIT_WIRE = '100000.00';
```

`packages/features/src/sip/useSipDraft.ts`:
```ts
import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';

/** What SIP-01 hands to SIP-03. It stays in memory (React Query cache), never in the URL. */
export interface SipDraft {
  amount: string;
  installmentDay: number;
  numberOfInstalments: number | null;
  /** The quote's expected first instalment, so SIP-03 can say when registration moved it. */
  quotedFirstInstalmentDate: string;
}

export function useSipDraft(schemeId: string) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const key = ['sipDraft', schemeId] as const;
  return {
    read: (): SipDraft | null => queryClient.getQueryData<SipDraft>(key) ?? null,
    save: (draft: SipDraft): void => {
      queryClient.setQueryData<SipDraft>(key, draft);
    },
    clear: (): void => {
      queryClient.removeQueries({ queryKey: key });
    },
  };
}
```
