`apps/api/test/int/catalogue-publish-gate.int.test.ts` (D8's placeholder data; the clock is `bootTestApp`'s default, Mon 2026-10-12 10:00 IST, so the CSV riskometers dated 2026-09-01 are 41 days old):
```ts
import { cpSync, mkdtempSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import {
  CuratedListInvalidError,
  DEFAULT_DATA_DIR,
  runCatalogueSeed,
  seedCatalogue,
} from '../../src/cli/ops-catalogue-seed.js';
import { fundFacts, schemeNavs, schemes } from '../../src/db/schema.js';
import { runCatalogueFpSync } from '../../src/modules/catalogue/fp-sync.job.js';
import { FundFactsProvider } from '../../src/modules/catalogue/fund-facts.provider.js';
import { applyPublishGate } from '../../src/modules/catalogue/publish-gate.apply.js';
import { bootTestApp, type TestApp } from './app.js';

const FLEXI = 'INF000P05055'; // D8 placeholder: Parag Parikh Flexi Cap, EXACT commission line
let t: TestApp;

const fpRead = {
  schemePlans: async () => ({ items: [], raw: {} }),
  fundScheme: async () => ({
    purchase_allowed: true,
    redemption_allowed: true,
    sip_allowed: true,
    lock_in: false,
    lock_in_period: null,
  }),
};

async function statusOf(isin: string) {
  const [row] = await t.db.db.select().from(schemes).where(eq(schemes.isin, isin));
  return row;
}

function dataDirWith(edit: (file: string, text: string) => string): string {
  const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'sanchay-catalogue-'));
  cpSync(DEFAULT_DATA_DIR, dir, { recursive: true });
  for (const file of ['curated-schemes.csv', 'fund-facts.csv']) {
    writeFileSync(join(dir, file), edit(file, readFileSync(join(dir, file), 'utf8')));
  }
  return dir;
}

beforeAll(async () => {
  t = await bootTestApp();
});

afterAll(async () => {
  await t.close();
});

describe('ops:catalogue:seed and the publish gate (F19)', () => {
  it('prints the gate report: the seed alone publishes nothing (no FP flags, no NAV: R3, R7)', async () => {
    const report = await runCatalogueSeed(t.db.db, t.clock, DEFAULT_DATA_DIR, { pilotList: false });
    expect(report.split('\n')[0]).toBe('Publish gate 2026-10-12: 0/10 curated schemes PUBLISHED');
    expect(report).toContain(`DRAFT      ${FLEXI}`);
    expect(report).toContain('R3 FP inactive or purchase not allowed');
    expect((await statusOf(FLEXI))?.status).toBe('DRAFT');
  });

  it('FP sync never publishes by itself; the gate publishes what passes R1-R7 and nothing else', async () => {
    await runCatalogueFpSync(t.db.db, fpRead as never);
    expect((await statusOf(FLEXI))?.status).toBe('DRAFT');
    await t.db.db.insert(schemeNavs).values({ isin: FLEXI, nav: '80.123400', navDate: '2026-10-09' });
    const rows = await applyPublishGate(t.db.db, t.clock);
    expect(rows.find((r) => r.isin === FLEXI)).toMatchObject({ to: 'PUBLISHED', failures: [] });
    const published = rows.filter((r) => r.to === 'PUBLISHED');
    expect(published.map((r) => r.isin)).toEqual([FLEXI]);
    for (const row of published) expect(row.failures).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('suspends a live scheme whose NAV is more than 5 business days old, and republishes it when fresh', async () => {
    t.clock.set('2026-10-21T04:30:00.000Z'); // Wed: 10-09 is 7 business days back (10-20 is a holiday)
    await applyPublishGate(t.db.db, t.clock);
    expect((await statusOf(FLEXI))?.status).toBe('SUSPENDED');
    await t.db.db.update(schemeNavs).set({ navDate: '2026-10-19' }).where(eq(schemeNavs.isin, FLEXI));
    await applyPublishGate(t.db.db, t.clock);
    expect((await statusOf(FLEXI))?.status).toBe('PUBLISHED');
    t.clock.set('2026-10-12T04:30:00.000Z');
  });

  it('an ISIN dropped from the list is un-curated and, if live, suspended', async () => {
    t.clock.set('2026-10-21T04:30:00.000Z');
    const dir = dataDirWith((_file, text) =>
      text
        .split('\n')
        .filter((line) => !line.startsWith(FLEXI))
        .join('\n'),
    );
    const report = await runCatalogueSeed(t.db.db, t.clock, dir, { pilotList: false });
    expect(await statusOf(FLEXI)).toMatchObject({ curated: false, status: 'SUSPENDED' });
    expect(report).toContain(`SUSPENDED  ${FLEXI}`);
    expect(report).toContain('not in the curated list');
    await runCatalogueSeed(t.db.db, t.clock, DEFAULT_DATA_DIR, { pilotList: false });
    expect(await statusOf(FLEXI)).toMatchObject({ curated: true, status: 'PUBLISHED' });
    t.clock.set('2026-10-12T04:30:00.000Z');
  });

  it('an invalid list writes nothing and names every bad line', async () => {
    const before = await t.db.db.select().from(schemes);
    const dir = dataDirWith((file, text) =>
      file === 'curated-schemes.csv'
        ? `${text.trimEnd()}\nINF000P11011,no-such-amc,Some Fund - Direct - Growth,EQ_LARGE_CAP,\n`
        : text,
    );
    const error = await seedCatalogue(t.db.db, dir).catch((e: unknown) => e);
    expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(CuratedListInvalidError);
    expect((error as CuratedListInvalidError).errors).toEqual([
      'curated-schemes.csv:12: unknown amc_slug "no-such-amc"',
      'curated-schemes.csv:12: "Some Fund - Direct - Growth" is not a Regular - Growth share class (R1, R2)',
    ]);
    expect(await t.db.db.select().from(schemes)).toEqual(before);
  });

  it('the placeholder list is refused on staging/prod (pilotList)', async () => {
    await expect(
      seedCatalogue(t.db.db, DEFAULT_DATA_DIR, { pilotList: true }),
    ).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(CuratedListInvalidError);
  });

  it('the seed fact revision survives FundFactsProvider.resolve (camelCase payload)', async () => {
    const scheme = await statusOf(FLEXI);
    await new FundFactsProvider(t.db.db).resolve(scheme?.id ?? '');
    const [facts] = await t.db.db.select().from(fundFacts).where(eq(fundFacts.schemeId, scheme?.id ?? ''));
    expect(facts).toMatchObject({
      riskometer: 'VERY_HIGH',
      riskometerAsOf: '2026-09-01',
      expenseRatioPct: '1.55',
```

`apps/api/src/modules/catalogue/curated-csv.ts`:
```ts
import { ISIN_REGEX } from '@sanchay/domain';
import { RISKOMETER_LEVELS } from './catalogue.schema.js';

/** The G-B10 curated list (data/curated-schemes.csv), header as D8 ships it. */
export const CURATED_HEADER = [
  'isin',
  'amc_slug',
  'name',
  'category_code',
  'lock_in_months',
] as const;
/** data/fund-facts.csv, the header D8 ships and E15's ops:facts:import reads. */
export const FUND_FACTS_HEADER = [
  'isin',
  'expense_ratio_pct',
  'expense_ratio_as_of',
  'riskometer',
  'riskometer_as_of',
  'benchmark_name',
  'benchmark_riskometer',
  'exit_load_text',
  'sid_url',
  'kim_url',
] as const;

/** G-B10: v1 is 40-60 Regular-Growth ISINs. */
export const PILOT_LIST_MIN = 40;
export const PILOT_LIST_MAX = 60;
/** D8's synthetic ISINs (INF000P01011..). Never valid on staging or prod. */
const PLACEHOLDER_ISIN = /^INF000P/;
const ISO_DATE = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/;
const PCT_2DP = /^\d{1,2}(?:\.\d{1,2})?$/;

export interface CsvTable {
  header: string[];
  /** Each row with its 1-based line number in the file (the header is line 1). */
  rows: { line: number; cells: string[]; record: Record<string, string> }[];
}

/** D8's CSV dialect: comma separated, no quoting. A comma inside a value shows up as an extra cell. */
export function parseCsvTable(text: string): CsvTable {
  const lines = text.split(/\r\n|\r|\n/);
  const header = (lines[0] ?? '').split(',').map((cell) => cell.trim());
  const rows: CsvTable['rows'] = [];
  lines.forEach((raw, index) => {
    if (index === 0 || raw.trim() === '') return;
    const cells = raw.split(',').map((cell) => cell.trim());
    const record: Record<string, string> = {};
    header.forEach((key, i) => {
      record[key] = cells[i] ?? '';
    });
    rows.push({ line: index + 1, cells, record });
  });
  return { header, rows };
}

export interface CuratedListContext {
  /** Slugs from data/amcs.csv. */
  amcSlugs: ReadonlySet<string>;
  /** Codes from data/sebi-categories.csv. */
  categoryCodes: ReadonlySet<string>;
  /** staging/prod: the real v1 list (40-60 rows, no placeholder ISINs, facts for every ISIN). */
  pilotList: boolean;
}

function headerErrors(file: string, table: CsvTable, expected: readonly string[]): string[] {
  return table.header.join(',') === expected.join(',')
    ? []
    : [`${file}: header must be "${expected.join(',')}"`];
}

function cellCountErrors(file: string, table: CsvTable): string[] {
  return table.rows
    .filter((row) => row.cells.length !== table.header.length)
    .map(
      (row) =>
        `${file}:${row.line}: ${row.cells.length} cells, expected ${table.header.length} (a comma inside a value is not supported; use ";")`,
    );
}

/** Every problem in the curated list and the fund facts, before anything is written (F19, G-B10 import). */
export function curatedListErrors(
  curated: CsvTable,
  facts: CsvTable,
  ctx: CuratedListContext,
): string[] {
  const C = 'curated-schemes.csv';
  const F = 'fund-facts.csv';
  const errors = [
    ...headerErrors(C, curated, CURATED_HEADER),
    ...headerErrors(F, facts, FUND_FACTS_HEADER),
    ...cellCountErrors(C, curated),
    ...cellCountErrors(F, facts),
  ];
  if (errors.length > 0) return errors;

  const listed = new Set<string>();
  for (const { line, record } of curated.rows) {
    const at = `${C}:${line}`;
    const isin = record.isin ?? '';
    if (!ISIN_REGEX.test(isin)) errors.push(`${at}: ISIN "${isin}" is not INF + 9 characters`);
    if (listed.has(isin)) errors.push(`${at}: duplicate ISIN ${isin}`);
    listed.add(isin);
    if (ctx.pilotList && PLACEHOLDER_ISIN.test(isin))
      errors.push(`${at}: placeholder ISIN ${isin}`);
    if (!ctx.amcSlugs.has(record.amc_slug ?? ''))
      errors.push(`${at}: unknown amc_slug "${record.amc_slug}"`);
    const category = record.category_code ?? '';
    if (!ctx.categoryCodes.has(category)) errors.push(`${at}: unknown category_code "${category}"`);
    const name = record.name ?? '';
    if (
      !/\bregular\b/i.test(name) ||
      !/\bgrowth\b/i.test(name) ||
      /\b(direct|idcw|dividend)\b/i.test(name)
    ) {
      errors.push(`${at}: "${name}" is not a Regular - Growth share class (R1, R2)`);
    }
    const lockIn = record.lock_in_months ?? '';
    if (lockIn !== '' && !/^[1-9]\d{0,2}$/.test(lockIn))
      errors.push(`${at}: lock_in_months "${lockIn}" is not 1-999`);
    if (category === 'EQ_ELSS' && (lockIn === '' || Number(lockIn) < 36)) {
      errors.push(`${at}: an ELSS scheme needs lock_in_months of at least 36`);
    }
  }
  if (
    ctx.pilotList &&
    (curated.rows.length < PILOT_LIST_MIN || curated.rows.length > PILOT_LIST_MAX)
  ) {
    errors.push(
      `${C}: ${curated.rows.length} schemes; the v1 list has ${PILOT_LIST_MIN}-${PILOT_LIST_MAX}`,
    );
  }

  const withFacts = new Set<string>();
  for (const { line, record } of facts.rows) {
    const at = `${F}:${line}`;
    const isin = record.isin ?? '';
    if (!listed.has(isin)) errors.push(`${at}: ISIN ${isin} is not in ${C}`);
    if (withFacts.has(isin)) errors.push(`${at}: duplicate ISIN ${isin}`);
    withFacts.add(isin);
    for (const key of ['expense_ratio_as_of', 'riskometer_as_of'] as const) {
      const value = record[key] ?? '';
      if (value !== '' && !ISO_DATE.test(value))
        errors.push(`${at}: ${key} "${value}" is not YYYY-MM-DD`);
    }
    const ter = record.expense_ratio_pct ?? '';
    if (ter !== '' && !PCT_2DP.test(ter))
      errors.push(`${at}: expense_ratio_pct "${ter}" is not a percentage with 2 dp`);
    for (const key of ['riskometer', 'benchmark_riskometer'] as const) {
      const value = record[key] ?? '';
      if (value !== '' && !(RISKOMETER_LEVELS as readonly string[]).includes(value)) {
        errors.push(`${at}: ${key} "${value}" is not one of ${RISKOMETER_LEVELS.join('|')}`);
      }
    }
    for (const key of ['sid_url', 'kim_url'] as const) {
      const value = record[key] ?? '';
      if (value !== '' && !value.startsWith('https://'))
        errors.push(`${at}: ${key} must be an https link`);
    }
  }
  if (ctx.pilotList) {
    for (const isin of listed) if (!withFacts.has(isin)) errors.push(`${F}: no row for ${isin}`);
  }
  return errors;
}

/** The camelCase payload E15's FundFactsProvider folds; only non-empty cells, so a blank never erases a value. */
export function fundFactsPayloadOf(record: Record<string, string>): Record<string, string> {
  const map: Record<(typeof FUND_FACTS_HEADER)[number], string | null> = {
    isin: null,
    expense_ratio_pct: 'expenseRatioPct',
    expense_ratio_as_of: 'expenseRatioAsOf',
    riskometer: 'riskometer',
    riskometer_as_of: 'riskometerAsOf',
    benchmark_name: 'benchmarkName',
    benchmark_riskometer: 'benchmarkRiskometer',
    exit_load_text: 'exitLoadText',
    sid_url: 'sidUrl',
    kim_url: 'kimUrl',
  };
  const payload: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const column of FUND_FACTS_HEADER) {
    const key = map[column];
    const value = record[column] ?? '';
    if (key !== null && value !== '') payload[key] = value;
  }
  return payload;
}
```

```ts
};

export interface PublishGateReportRow {
  isin: string;
  name: string;
  curated: boolean;
  from: SchemeStatus;
  to: SchemeStatus;
  failures: PublishGateRule[];
}

/**
 * Only the gate publishes. A curated scheme that passes R1-R7 is PUBLISHED. One that fails stays DRAFT if it
 * was never live, and is SUSPENDED if it was (an investor may hold it; getScheme then 404s). A scheme
 * dropped from the curated list is SUSPENDED if it was live and otherwise left alone.
 */
export function nextSchemeStatus(
  current: SchemeStatus,
  curated: boolean,
  publishable: boolean,
): SchemeStatus {
  if (!curated) return current === 'PUBLISHED' ? 'SUSPENDED' : current;
  if (publishable) return 'PUBLISHED';
  return current === 'DRAFT' ? 'DRAFT' : 'SUSPENDED';
}

/** Re-evaluates every curated or live scheme and writes the status the gate allows (seed and FP sync, spec §1.4). */
export async function applyPublishGate(
  db: Database,
  clock: Clock,
): Promise<PublishGateReportRow[]> {
  const today = istIsoDate(clock.now());
  const holidayRows = await db.select({ date: marketHolidays.holidayDate }).from(marketHolidays);
  const holidays = new Set(holidayRows.map((row) => row.date));
  const navs = new NavService(clock);
  const rows = await db
    .select({
      id: schemes.id,
      isin: schemes.isin,
      name: schemes.name,
      amcId: schemes.amcId,
      status: schemes.status,
      curated: schemes.curated,
      planType: schemes.planType,
      option: schemes.option,
      fpActive: schemes.fpActive,
      purchaseAllowed: schemes.purchaseAllowed,
      assetClass: sebiCategories.assetClass,
      riskometer: fundFacts.riskometer,
      riskometerAsOf: fundFacts.riskometerAsOf,
      expenseRatioPct: fundFacts.expenseRatioPct,
      exitLoadText: fundFacts.exitLoadText,
      sidUrl: fundFacts.sidUrl,
      kimUrl: fundFacts.kimUrl,
    })
    .from(schemes)
    .innerJoin(sebiCategories, eq(sebiCategories.code, schemes.categoryCode))
    .leftJoin(fundFacts, eq(fundFacts.schemeId, schemes.id))
    .where(or(eq(schemes.curated, true), eq(schemes.status, 'PUBLISHED')))
    .orderBy(asc(schemes.name), asc(schemes.id));

  const report: PublishGateReportRow[] = [];
  for (const row of rows) {
    const nav = await navs.latest(db, toIsin(row.isin));
    const commission = await resolveCommissionLine(db, row.id, row.amcId, today);
    const result = evaluatePublishGate({
      planType: row.planType,
      option: row.option,
      fpActive: row.fpActive,
      purchaseAllowed: row.purchaseAllowed,
      categoryAssetClass: row.assetClass,
      riskometer: row.riskometer ?? null,
      riskometerAgeCalendarDays:
        row.riskometerAsOf === null
          ? null
          : calendarDaysBetween(toIsoDate(row.riskometerAsOf), today),
      expenseRatioPct: row.expenseRatioPct ?? null,
      exitLoadText: row.exitLoadText ?? null,
      sidUrl: row.sidUrl ?? null,
      kimUrl: row.kimUrl ?? null,
      commissionResolved: commission !== null,
      navGrade: nav?.grade ?? null,
      navAgeBusinessDays: nav === null ? null : businessDaysAge(nav.navDate, today, holidays),
    });
    const to = nextSchemeStatus(row.status, row.curated, result.publishable);
    if (to !== row.status)
      await db.update(schemes).set({ status: to }).where(eq(schemes.id, row.id));
    report.push({
      isin: row.isin,
      name: row.name,
      curated: row.curated,
      from: row.status,
      to,
      failures: result.failures,
    });
  }
  return report;
}

export function formatPublishGateReport(
  rows: readonly PublishGateReportRow[],
  today: string,
): string {
  const curated = rows.filter((row) => row.curated);
  const published = curated.filter((row) => row.to === 'PUBLISHED').length;
  const lines = rows.map((row) => {
    const why = !row.curated
      ? 'not in the curated list'
      : row.failures.map((rule) => `${rule} ${PUBLISH_GATE_RULE_TEXT[rule]}`).join('; ');
    const change = row.from === row.to ? '' : ` (was ${row.from})`;
    return `  ${row.to.padEnd(9)}  ${row.isin}  ${row.name}${change}${why === '' ? '' : `  [${why}]`}`;
  });
  return [
    `Publish gate ${today}: ${published}/${curated.length} curated schemes PUBLISHED`,
    ...lines,
  ].join('\n');
}
```

```ts
/** `pnpm ops:catalogue:seed`: validate and seed, then re-run the publish gate and return its report. */
export async function runCatalogueSeed(
  db: Database,
  clock: Clock,
  dataDir: string,
  options: SeedOptions,
): Promise<string> {
  await seedCatalogue(db, dataDir, options);
  const rows = await applyPublishGate(db, clock);
  return formatPublishGateReport(rows, istIsoDate(clock.now()));
}
```

```ts
import { Inject, Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import { istIsoDate } from '@sanchay/domain';
import { CLOCK, type Clock } from '../platform/clock.js';
import { applyPublishGate, formatPublishGateReport } from './publish-gate.apply.js';
// …
@Injectable()
@JobHandler('catalogue.fp.sync')
export class CatalogueFpSyncJob {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(CatalogueFpSyncJob.name);

  constructor(
    @Inject(DB) private readonly dbh: DbHandle,
    @Inject(FpRead) private readonly fpRead: FpRead,
    @Inject(CLOCK) private readonly clock: Clock,
  ) {}

  async handle(_job: Job<'catalogue.fp.sync'>): Promise<void> {
    await runCatalogueFpSync(this.dbh.db, this.fpRead);
    const rows = await applyPublishGate(this.dbh.db, this.clock);
    // The summary line only (scheme names and ISINs are public; one line keeps the log small).
    const report = formatPublishGateReport(rows, istIsoDate(this.clock.now()));
    this.logger.log(report.split('\n')[0] ?? '');
  }
}
```

```tsx
import { messageForError } from '@sanchay/app-core';
import { AppText, Banner, Button } from '@sanchay/ui';
import { View } from 'react-native';

/** Investor copy for the catalogue's loading, empty and error states (F19). No PII, no return claims. */
export const CATALOGUE_COPY = {
  loadingFunds: 'Loading funds…',
  loadingFund: 'Loading fund details…',
  searching: 'Searching…',
  emptyCatalogueTitle: 'No funds to show yet',
  emptyCatalogueHint: 'We are adding funds to Sanchay. Please check again soon.',
  emptyCategoryTitle: 'No funds in this category yet',
  emptyCategoryHint: 'Try another category, or search for a fund by name.',
  noResultsTitle: 'No funds match your search',
  noResultsHint: 'Check the spelling, or try a fund house or a category such as "Flexi Cap".',
  fundUnavailable: 'This fund is not available on Sanchay right now.',
  retry: 'Try again',
  backToExplore: 'Back to Explore',
  searchFunds: 'Search funds',
} as const;

interface Action {
  label: string;
  onPress: () => void;
}

export type CatalogueStatusProps =
  | { kind: 'loading'; label: string; testID: string }
  | { kind: 'empty'; title: string; hint: string; testID: string; action?: Action | undefined }
  | {
      kind: 'error';
      /** toApiError(query.error).code */
      errorCode: string;
      onRetry: () => void;
      testID: string;
      /** Replaces the retry when the server says NOT_FOUND (a fund that is not, or no longer, published). */
      onBack?: (() => void) | undefined;
    };

/**
 * The loading, empty and error states of Explore, Search and the Fund page (EXP-01..05, FUND-01/03). Every
 * state is announced: loading and empty are polite status regions, an error is an alert (Banner). The
 * caller places it (inside its own Screen), so Search can show it under the search box.
 */
export function CatalogueStatus(props: CatalogueStatusProps) {
  if (props.kind === 'loading') {
    return (
      <View testID={props.testID} role="status" aria-live="polite">
        <AppText tone="muted">{props.label}</AppText>
      </View>
    );
  }
  if (props.kind === 'empty') {
    return (
      <View testID={props.testID} role="status" aria-live="polite" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
        <AppText variant="heading">{props.title}</AppText>
        <AppText tone="muted">{props.hint}</AppText>
        {props.action ? (
          <Button label={props.action.label} variant="secondary" onPress={props.action.onPress} />
        ) : null}
      </View>
    );
  }
  if (props.errorCode === 'NOT_FOUND' && props.onBack) {
    return (
      <View testID={props.testID} style={{ gap: 8 }}>
        <Banner tone="error" message={CATALOGUE_COPY.fundUnavailable} />
        <Button label={CATALOGUE_COPY.backToExplore} variant="secondary" onPress={props.onBack} />
      </View>
    );
  }
  return (
    <View testID={props.testID} style={{ gap: 8 }}>
      <Banner tone="error" message={messageForError(props.errorCode)} />
      <Button label={CATALOGUE_COPY.retry} onPress={props.onRetry} />
    </View>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { toApiError } from '@sanchay/api-client';
import { AppText, Button, Chip, ListRow, Screen } from '@sanchay/ui';
import { useInfiniteQuery, useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { ScrollView, View } from 'react-native';
import { useApi } from '../api/ApiContext';
import { useNav } from '../nav/NavContext';
import { CATALOGUE_COPY, CatalogueStatus } from './CatalogueStatus';
import { Disclosures } from './Disclosures';

export interface ExploreScreenProps {
  /** The SEBI category slug from /explore/category/[slug]; listSchemes filters by the category code. */
  category?: string | undefined;
}

/** EXP-01 (curated list), EXP-03 (category tiles) and the EXP-02 search entry point. */
export function ExploreScreen({ category }: ExploreScreenProps) {
  const { utils } = useApi();
  const nav = useNav();
  const categories = useQuery(utils.catalogue.categories.queryOptions({ input: {} }));
  const selected = category === undefined ? undefined : categories.data?.find((c) => c.slug === category);
  const unknownCategory = category !== undefined && categories.isSuccess && selected === undefined;
  const list = useInfiniteQuery(
    utils.catalogue.listSchemes.infiniteOptions({
      input: (cursor: string | undefined) => ({
        category: selected?.code,
        sort: 'name' as const,
        ...(cursor === undefined ? {} : { cursor }),
      }),
      initialPageParam: undefined as string | undefined,
      getNextPageParam: (page) => page.nextCursor ?? undefined,
      enabled: category === undefined || selected !== undefined,
    }),
  );

  if (categories.isError || list.isError) {
    return (
      <Screen testID="explore-screen">
        <CatalogueStatus
          kind="error"
          errorCode={toApiError(categories.error ?? list.error).code}
          onRetry={() => {
            void categories.refetch();
            void list.refetch();
          }}
          testID="explore-error"
        />
      </Screen>
    );
  }
  if (categories.isPending || (list.isPending && !unknownCategory)) {
    return (
      <Screen testID="explore-screen">
        <CatalogueStatus kind="loading" label={CATALOGUE_COPY.loadingFunds} testID="explore-loading" />
      </Screen>
    );
  }

  const items = unknownCategory ? [] : (list.data?.pages.flatMap((page) => page.items) ?? []);
  return (
    <Screen testID="explore-screen">
      <AppText variant="title">{selected?.name ?? 'Explore funds'}</AppText>
      <Button
        label={CATALOGUE_COPY.searchFunds}
        variant="secondary"
        onPress={() => nav.push('/explore/search')}
      />
      {category === undefined ? (
        <ScrollView horizontal showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}>
          <View role="group" aria-label="Categories" style={{ flexDirection: 'row', gap: 8 }}>
            {categories.data.map((c) => (
              <Chip
                key={c.code}
                label={c.name}
                selected={false}
                onPress={() => nav.push(`/explore/category/${c.slug}`)}
              />
            ))}
          </View>
        </ScrollView>
      ) : null}
      {items.length === 0 ? (
        <CatalogueStatus
          kind="empty"
          title={category === undefined ? CATALOGUE_COPY.emptyCatalogueTitle : CATALOGUE_COPY.emptyCategoryTitle}
          hint={category === undefined ? CATALOGUE_COPY.emptyCatalogueHint : CATALOGUE_COPY.emptyCategoryHint}
          action={category === undefined ? undefined : { label: 'All funds', onPress: () => nav.push('/explore') }}
          testID="explore-empty"
        />
      ) : (
        <View>
          {items.map((scheme) => (
            <ListRow
              key={scheme.isin}
              label={scheme.name}
              onPress={() => nav.push(`/funds/${scheme.slug}`)}
              testID={`scheme-row-${scheme.isin}`}
            />
          ))}
          {list.hasNextPage ? (
            <Button
              label="Show more funds"
              variant="secondary"
              loading={list.isFetchingNextPage}
              onPress={() => void list.fetchNextPage()}
            />
          ) : null}
        </View>
      )}
      <Disclosures />
    </Screen>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { toApiError } from '@sanchay/api-client';
import { AppText, ListRow, Screen, TextField } from '@sanchay/ui';
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { View } from 'react-native';
import { useApi } from '../api/ApiContext';
import { useNav } from '../nav/NavContext';
import { CATALOGUE_COPY, CatalogueStatus } from './CatalogueStatus';

/** EXP-04 (search box) / EXP-05 (results). Queries only once at least one character is typed. */
export function SearchScreen() {
  const { utils } = useApi();
  const nav = useNav();
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const trimmed = query.trim();
  const results = useQuery({
    ...utils.catalogue.listSchemes.queryOptions({ input: { q: trimmed || undefined, sort: 'name' } }),
    enabled: trimmed.length > 0,
  });
  const items = results.data?.items ?? [];

  return (
    <Screen testID="search-screen">
      <AppText variant="title">{CATALOGUE_COPY.searchFunds}</AppText>
      <TextField
        label={CATALOGUE_COPY.searchFunds}
        value={query}
        onChangeText={setQuery}
        placeholder="e.g. Flexi Cap, Axis, Liquid"
      />
      {trimmed.length === 0 ? null : results.isError ? (
        <CatalogueStatus
          kind="error"
          errorCode={toApiError(results.error).code}
          onRetry={() => void results.refetch()}
          testID="search-error"
        />
      ) : results.isPending ? (
        <CatalogueStatus kind="loading" label={CATALOGUE_COPY.searching} testID="search-loading" />
      ) : items.length === 0 ? (
        <CatalogueStatus
          kind="empty"
          title={CATALOGUE_COPY.noResultsTitle}
          hint={CATALOGUE_COPY.noResultsHint}
          testID="search-empty"
        />
      ) : (
        <View>
          <View role="status" aria-live="polite">
            <AppText tone="muted">
              {items.length === 1 ? '1 fund found' : `${items.length} funds found`}
            </AppText>
          </View>
          {items.map((scheme) => (
            <ListRow
              key={scheme.isin}
              label={scheme.name}
              onPress={() => nav.push(`/funds/${scheme.slug}`)}
              testID={`scheme-row-${scheme.isin}`}
            />
          ))}
        </View>
      )}
    </Screen>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { toApiError } from '@sanchay/api-client';
import { DASH, formatInr, formatPct, Money } from '@sanchay/money';
import { color, fontWeight, minTouchTarget, radius, space } from '@sanchay/tokens';
import { AppText, Card, ListRow, Screen } from '@sanchay/ui';
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { Linking, Pressable, StyleSheet, View } from 'react-native';
import { useApi } from '../api/ApiContext';
import { useNav } from '../nav/NavContext';
import { CATALOGUE_COPY, CatalogueStatus } from './CatalogueStatus';
import { Disclosures, ReturnCaveat, RiskometerBadge } from './Disclosures';

export interface FundScreenProps {
  schemeSlug: string;
}

/** A stored percentage (12.3400, 1.55) shown as 12.34%; never signed, a dash when unknown. */
const pct = (value: string | null): string =>
  value === null ? DASH : formatPct(value, { signed: false });

/**
 * FUND-01's calls to action (journeys §4.6). They move to another screen, so they are links (role
 * "link"): screen readers announce them as such, and E24's smoke clicks getByRole('link', { name: 'Invest' }).
 */
function FundAction({ label, href, primary }: { label: string; href: string; primary: boolean }) {
  const nav = useNav();
  return (
    <Pressable
      role="link"
      aria-label={label}
      onPress={() => nav.push(href)}
      style={({ pressed }) => [
        styles.action,
        primary ? styles.primary : styles.secondary,
        pressed ? styles.pressed : null,
      ]}
    >
      <AppText style={primary ? styles.primaryLabel : styles.secondaryLabel}>{label}</AppText>
    </Pressable>
  );
}

/** FUND-01 (facts, minimums, exit load, lock-in, riskometer, TER, SID/KIM) and FUND-03 (returns). */
export function FundScreen({ schemeSlug }: FundScreenProps) {
  const { utils } = useApi();
  const nav = useNav();
  const detail = useQuery(utils.catalogue.getScheme.queryOptions({ input: { slug: schemeSlug } }));

  if (detail.isPending) {
    return (
      <Screen testID="fund-screen">
        <CatalogueStatus kind="loading" label={CATALOGUE_COPY.loadingFund} testID="fund-loading" />
      </Screen>
    );
  }
  if (detail.isError) {
    return (
      <Screen testID="fund-screen">
        <CatalogueStatus
          kind="error"
          errorCode={toApiError(detail.error).code}
          onRetry={() => void detail.refetch()}
          onBack={() => nav.push('/explore')}
          testID="fund-error"
        />
      </Screen>
    );
  }

  const scheme = detail.data;
  const t = scheme.thresholds;
  const { sidUrl, kimUrl } = scheme;
  return (
    <Screen testID="fund-screen">
      <AppText variant="title">{scheme.name}</AppText>
      <AppText tone="muted">{`${scheme.amcName} · ${scheme.categoryName}`}</AppText>

      {/* BRIEF D4: both go by the scheme uuid. Start SIP needs `sipAllowed`, Plan 02 D10's fail-closed flag
          (FP's sip_allowed and its monthly SIP row, RV-04-F19-1); without it the CTA is hidden with the
          reason (journeys §4.6). */}
      <View style={styles.actions} testID="fund-actions">
        <FundAction label="Invest" href={`/invest/${scheme.id}/lumpsum`} primary />
        {scheme.sipAllowed ? (
          <FundAction label="Start SIP" href={`/invest/${scheme.id}/sip`} primary={false} />
        ) : null}
      </View>
      {scheme.sipAllowed ? null : (
        <AppText variant="caption" tone="muted">
          SIP not available for this fund
        </AppText>
      )}

      <Card>
        <AppText variant="heading">Returns (annualised)</AppText>
        <ListRow label="1 year" value={pct(scheme.returns.cagr1y)} />
        <ListRow label="3 years" value={pct(scheme.returns.cagr3y)} />
        <ListRow label="5 years" value={pct(scheme.returns.cagr5y)} />
        {scheme.returns.asOf ? (
          <AppText variant="caption" tone="muted">{`As of ${scheme.returns.asOf}`}</AppText>
        ) : null}
        <ReturnCaveat />
      </Card>

      <Card>
        <AppText variant="heading">Minimums</AppText>
        <ListRow label="Minimum lumpsum" value={t ? formatInr(Money.parse(t.purchaseMin)) : DASH} />
        <ListRow
          label="Minimum SIP"
          value={scheme.sipAllowed && t?.sipMin ? formatInr(Money.parse(t.sipMin)) : DASH}
        />
        <ListRow label="Exit load" value={scheme.exitLoadText ?? DASH} />
        <ListRow
          label="Lock-in"
          value={scheme.lockInMonths ? `${scheme.lockInMonths} months` : 'None'}
        />
        <ListRow label="Total expense ratio" value={pct(scheme.expenseRatioPct)} />
      </Card>

      <Card>
        <AppText variant="heading">Riskometer</AppText>
        <RiskometerBadge level={scheme.riskometer} benchmarkLevel={scheme.benchmarkRiskometer} />
      </Card>

      <Card>
        <AppText variant="heading">Documents</AppText>
        {sidUrl ? (
          <ListRow
            label="Scheme Information Document"
            value="Open"
            onPress={() => void Linking.openURL(sidUrl)}
          />
        ) : null}
        {kimUrl ? (
          <ListRow
            label="Key Information Memorandum"
            value="Open"
            onPress={() => void Linking.openURL(kimUrl)}
          />
        ) : null}
        {sidUrl || kimUrl ? null : <AppText tone="muted">Not available yet</AppText>}
      </Card>

      {scheme.commissionLine ? (
        <AppText variant="caption" tone="muted">
          {`Sanchay receives a commission from ${scheme.amcName} for this scheme (${scheme.commissionLine.kind === 'EXACT' ? `${scheme.commissionLine.trailMinBps / 100}% p.a. trail` : `${scheme.commissionLine.trailMinBps / 100}\u2013${scheme.commissionLine.trailMaxBps / 100}% p.a. trail`}).`}
        </AppText>
      ) : null}

      <Disclosures />
    </Screen>
  );
}

});
```

### Task F20: Founders' canary evidence: partial redemption (c) and the G-E7 reconciliation report (Dev A 8 h, Dev B 4 h)

**Why.** G-E7 needs three real-money legs reconciled against FP, the RTA/AMC statement and the bank, plus one signature-verified prod webhook, written up in `docs/probes/canary-2026-11.md` by **Thu 11-26** (spec §7; R-06 splits it into GO-1 for legs a and c and GO-2 for leg b). G-B8 (prod) needs the platform ARN on the canary folio's statement (P-05). It also needs the EUIN evidenced: FP stamps a tenant-default EUIN on every order type although we never send one (probe P-04 FAIL), so the EUIN FP returns is recorded and compared with Cybrilla's written Q12 answer and with the statement, and never asserted blank (BRIEF D7). The founders place the legs (a business action). This task makes the reconciliation mechanical: a read-only prod snapshot of our tables, a hand-transcribed evidence file, and a local report that evaluates both and rewrites the report's generated section. Dev A builds and runs it (8 h). Dev B places leg (c) on the Play-internal build, collects the Android evidence and cross-checks the statement figures (4 h).

Design decisions:
- **Two halves, because prod data never leaves the VPC except as a log line.** `ops:canary-snapshot` is a command on F7's ops runner. It runs as a one-off prod task on F1's ops task definition (container `ops`, login `sanchay_app_login`) in F7's deployed run form, with F7's `sanchay_app` role pinning and DDL guard (R-16), and prints one tagged JSON line to CloudWatch. `ops-canary-report` runs on a laptop with no database. The snapshot, the evidence file and the report are all committed, so both JSON shapes are **strict zod schemas with no PII**: ids, statuses, units, amounts, dates, the platform ARN, the last four characters of a folio number, a UTR or an EUIN, and the path of a file under `docs/probes/`. An unknown key is refused.
- **"FP" means our FP mirror plus a hand check.** The ops role never calls FP. The snapshot reads `orders.fp_state`, `payment_attempts`, `plans.fp_state` and the mandate as the worker last recorded them, plus any open `recon_breaks` on those ids and on the plan's mandate. F7's `recon.fp.daily`, `fp.reconcile.nonfinal` and `integrity.invariants` key their breaks on exactly these ids. The report's FP checklist is ticked by hand from the FP dashboard, and the EUIN on each FP object is transcribed from it (our tables have no `euin` column, H-11).
- **"Ledger" means F4's tables.** A lumpsum's units are its `lots.units`; a redemption's are `Σ lot_consumptions.units`, which must also equal the units F5 applied (`orders.redeemed_units`, FP's figure rounded HALF_UP to 3 dp); the closing balance is `Σ lots.units_remaining` on the folio and scheme. All three are compared with the statement at 0.001 inclusive, through `@sanchay/money` `Units` (never JavaScript numbers). FP's own 4-dp figure (`orders.redeemed_units_reported`, probe P-09) is carried in the snapshot and printed in the report as evidence (BRIEF D7).
- **EUIN (BRIEF D7).** For every leg the evidence file records the EUIN on the FP object, and for legs A and C the EUIN printed on the statement (last four characters, or null when none is shown). It also records Cybrilla's written Q12 answer (the file under `docs/probes/` and the EUIN it says FP stamps, or null). A leg fails on `EUIN_Q12_MISSING` (no written answer yet), `EUIN_NOT_AS_Q12` (FP's EUIN differs from the answer) or `STATEMENT_EUIN_DIFFERS` (the statement prints another EUIN than FP returned). A blank EUIN passes only when Q12 says FP stamps none.
- **Signed webhooks.** GO-1 needs one signature-verified prod FP webhook. F7's `ops:sync` writes its re-fetch requests into `inbound_webhook_events` as `event_type = 'ops.sync'` rows with signature mode NONE and `signature_valid = true`, and `fp.event.process` marks them PROCESSED (F7 deviation 5). Every webhook count therefore requires provider FP, signature mode `HMAC` or `SHARED_SECRET` (E1) and `event_type <> 'ops.sync'`; otherwise one `ops:sync` would satisfy GO-1 with no signed FP webhook.
- **Switches (BRIEF D5).** `orders.enabled` and `plans.sip.enabled` are global `app_config` flags, not per-account settings. The canary turns one on with two founders only while a leg is placed, and off again with one operator straight after (`ops:kill-switch`, `ops:sip-switch`). The invite list keeps the canary to the founders: prod is invite-only, and until F27 seeds the PO's list after the GO-1 decision (R-31; RV-04-F20-1) it holds only the founders' mobiles.
- **Leg (a) is two orders**, UPI and netbanking (spec G-E7 a), and each must have paid by its own rail.

**Review fixes (assembly, 2026-10-01; BRIEF D5, D7, D8, D9; defects-F20F23):**
1. **`ops:sync` rows counted as signed webhooks (major).** The three webhook counts also require a signed mode (`HMAC`, `SHARED_SECRET`) and `event_type <> 'ops.sync'`. A new integration case inserts `ops:sync`-shaped rows on a canary object and sees no change. Against PostgreSQL 18.6, the old query counted 5 "signed" events where the fixed one counts 2.
2. **Leg B had no executable step; "per-account" switches (major).** The runbook uses F7's `ops:kill-switch` and `ops:sip-switch` (BRIEF D5) for every on/off, describes both flags as global and checks the invite list before any switch is turned on.
3. **Ops runs on the migrate task definition.** Steps 6-8 use F7's deployed run form on F1's ops task definition (`OpsTaskDefinitionArn`, container `ops`) and read the result from stream `prod/ops/<task-id>`. They never use the migrate task definition, which logs in as `sanchay_master` (D6). `decodeSavedJson` finds the tagged line in the whole stream, because the AWS CLI joins a stream's messages with tabs.
4. **EUIN (BRIEF D7).** The blank-EUIN check (`EUIN_PRESENT`) is replaced by the Q12 comparison above.
5. **F5's raw units (BRIEF D7).** The snapshot carries `fpReportedUnits` (`orders.redeemed_units_reported`) next to the applied 3-dp `fpRedeemedUnits`.
6. **F7's context and registration.** Tests build the context with `opsContextOf(t.app)` (F7's `OpsContext` is `{db, jobs, audit, clock, crypto, invites}`). The command is appended as the last `OPS_COMMANDS` entry and the last `USAGE` line.
7. **BRIEF D9.** `@sanchay/money` is already an `apps/api` dependency (Plan 03 RV-03-6), so this task no longer adds it or touches `pnpm-lock.yaml`.
8. **Assembly round 2 (2026-10-01).**
   - FR-15: Step 6's switch check reads `app/config` on the app host, `https://app.sanchay.in/api/v1/app/config`. F8's HostGuard answers the web client 404 on the api host.
   - FR-20/FR-21: the founders' prod invites (Step 6, before Tue 11-17) use F7's SSM SecureString form, `ops:invite --mobiles-param /sanchay/prod/invites/canary-founders`, and the parameter and the local file are deleted right after the run. No `command` array holds a mobile.
   - Both flags are described plainly as global and gated by the invite list, in the runbook and in the canary doc.
   - Every ops run uses F7's round-2 deployed form exactly: `--task-definition sanchay-prod-ops` (F1's family, whose current revision is the stack output `OpsTaskDefinitionArn`), container `ops`, and an override of `command` only, because the container already sets `SANCHAY_APP_ROLE=ops`.

```ts
  spliceGeneratedSection,
} from './canary-evidence.js';

const ARN = 'ARN-000000';
/** Last four characters of the tenant-default EUIN Cybrilla's Q12 answer names (P-04). */
const EUIN = '5678';

function snapshot(overrides: Partial<CanarySnapshot> = {}): CanarySnapshot {

    snapshotAt: '2026-11-25T10:00:00.000Z',
    expectedArn: ARN,

}

const statementBase = { source: 'CAMS' as const, date: '2026-11-25', arn: ARN, euinLast4: EUIN };
const fpBase = { euinLast4: EUIN };

function evidence(): CanaryEvidence {
  return {
    q12: { ref: 'docs/probes/cybrilla-answers-2026-11-13.md', expectedEuinLast4: EUIN },
    legs: [
      {
        leg: 'A_UPI',
        fp: fpBase,
        statement: { ...statementBase, units: '82.413' },
        bank: {
          debitSeen: true,
          debitDate: '2026-11-17',
          debitAmount: '1000.00',
          utrLast4: '1111',
        },
      },
      {
        leg: 'A_NETBANKING',
        fp: fpBase,
        statement: { ...statementBase, units: '41.200' },
        bank: { debitSeen: true, debitDate: '2026-11-17', debitAmount: '500.00', utrLast4: '2222' },
      },
      { leg: 'B_SIP', fp: fpBase, mandateVisibleInUpiApp: true },
      {
        leg: 'C_REDEMPTION',
        fp: fpBase,
        statement: { ...statementBase, redeemedUnits: '24.700', closingUnits: '57.713' },
        bank: {
          payoutSeen: true,
          payoutDate: '2026-11-24',
          payoutAmount: '300.00',
          utrLast4: '3333',
          creditedToFolioBank: true,
        },
      },
    ],
  };
}

function withEvidence<T>(leg: string, patch: (e: T) => T): CanaryEvidence {
  const ev = evidence();
  return { ...ev, legs: ev.legs.map((l) => (l.leg === leg ? (patch(l as T) as typeof l) : l)) };
}

function withLeg<T>(leg: string, patch: (l: T) => T): CanarySnapshot {
  const s = snapshot();
  return { ...s, legs: s.legs.map((l) => (l.leg === leg ? (patch(l as T) as typeof l) : l)) };
}

const failuresOf = (s: CanarySnapshot, e: CanaryEvidence, leg: string) =>
  evaluateCanary(s, e).legs.find((l) => l.leg === leg)?.failures;

type PurchaseEv = Extract<CanaryEvidence['legs'][number], { leg: 'A_UPI' | 'A_NETBANKING' }>;
type RedemptionEv = Extract<CanaryEvidence['legs'][number], { leg: 'C_REDEMPTION' }>;
type PurchaseDb = Extract<CanarySnapshot['legs'][number], { leg: 'A_UPI' | 'A_NETBANKING' }>;
type SipDb = Extract<CanarySnapshot['legs'][number], { leg: 'B_SIP' }>;

describe('evaluateCanary: every leg reconciled', () => {
  it('passes all four legs and both gates when FP, ledger, statement and bank agree', () => {
    const report = evaluateCanary(snapshot(), evidence());
    expect(report.legs.map((l) => [l.leg, l.pass, l.unitsDelta])).toEqual([
      ['A_UPI', true, '0.000'],
      ['A_NETBANKING', true, '0.000'],
      ['B_SIP', true, null],
      ['C_REDEMPTION', true, '0.000'],
    ]);
    expect(report).toMatchObject({ webhookVerified: true, go1: true, go2Registration: true });
  });
});

describe('evaluateCanary: lumpsum legs (G-E7 a)', () => {
  it('units differing by exactly 0.001 pass (inclusive); by 0.002 they are a UNITS_MISMATCH', () => {
    const at = (units: string) =>
      withEvidence<PurchaseEv>('A_UPI', (e) => ({ ...e, statement: { ...e.statement, units } }));
    expect(failuresOf(snapshot(), at('82.412'), 'A_UPI')).toEqual([]);
    expect(failuresOf(snapshot(), at('82.415'), 'A_UPI')).toEqual(['UNITS_MISMATCH']);
  });

  it('the statement must print the platform ARN (P-05)', () => {
    const printed = (arn: string) =>
      withEvidence<PurchaseEv>('A_UPI', (e) => ({ ...e, statement: { ...e.statement, arn } }));
    expect(failuresOf(snapshot(), printed(` ${ARN} `), 'A_UPI')).toEqual([]);
    expect(failuresOf(snapshot(), printed(''), 'A_UPI')).toEqual(['STATEMENT_ARN_MISSING']);
  });

  it('EUIN (P-04, BRIEF D7): compared with the Q12 answer and the statement, never required blank', () => {
    // The tenant-default EUIN FP stamps passes when Cybrilla's Q12 answer names it.
    expect(failuresOf(snapshot(), evidence(), 'A_UPI')).toEqual([]);
    // FP shows another EUIN than Q12 names, and the statement prints none.
    const drift = withEvidence<PurchaseEv>('A_UPI', (e) => ({
      ...e,
      fp: { euinLast4: '9999' },
      statement: { ...e.statement, euinLast4: null },
    }));
    expect(failuresOf(snapshot(), drift, 'A_UPI')).toEqual([
      'EUIN_NOT_AS_Q12',
      'STATEMENT_EUIN_DIFFERS',
    ]);
    // If Q12 says FP stamps none, none on the object and the statement passes too.
    const none = evidence();
    const blank: CanaryEvidence = {
      q12: { ref: 'docs/probes/cybrilla-answers-2026-11-13.md', expectedEuinLast4: null },
      legs: none.legs.map((l) =>
        l.leg === 'B_SIP'
          ? { ...l, fp: { euinLast4: null } }
          : { ...l, fp: { euinLast4: null }, statement: { ...l.statement, euinLast4: null } },
      ) as CanaryEvidence['legs'],
    };
    expect(evaluateCanary(snapshot(), blank).legs.every((l) => l.pass)).toBe(true);
    // Without the written answer no leg passes.
    const unanswered = { ...evidence(), q12: null };
    expect(failuresOf(snapshot(), unanswered, 'A_UPI')).toEqual(['EUIN_Q12_MISSING']);
    expect(failuresOf(snapshot(), unanswered, 'B_SIP')).toEqual(['EUIN_Q12_MISSING']);
  });

  it('the order must carry the platform ARN snapshot', () => {
    const s = withLeg<PurchaseDb>('A_UPI', (l) => ({ ...l, arn: 'ARN-999999' }));
    expect(failuresOf(s, evidence(), 'A_UPI')).toEqual(['ARN_MISMATCH']);
  });

  it('the UPI leg must have paid by UPI and the netbanking leg by netbanking', () => {
    const s = withLeg<PurchaseDb>('A_NETBANKING', (l) => ({
      ...l,
      payment: { method: 'UPI', status: 'SUCCESS' },
    }));
    expect(failuresOf(s, evidence(), 'A_NETBANKING')).toEqual(['PAYMENT_METHOD_WRONG']);
  });

  it('an unsettled order with no lot and no payment reports each gap', () => {
    const s = withLeg<PurchaseDb>('A_UPI', (l) => ({
      ...l,
      status: 'UNITS_PENDING',
      fpState: 'submitted',
      payment: null,
      ledgerUnits: null,
    }));
    expect(failuresOf(s, evidence(), 'A_UPI')).toEqual([
      'NOT_SETTLED',
      'FP_NOT_SUCCESSFUL',
      'PAYMENT_NOT_SUCCESS',
      'LEDGER_UNITS_MISSING',
    ]);
  });

  it('the bank debit must be seen and equal the order amount', () => {
    const debit = (debitSeen: boolean, debitAmount: string | null) =>
      withEvidence<PurchaseEv>('A_UPI', (e) => ({
        ...e,
        bank: { ...e.bank, debitSeen, debitAmount },
      }));
    expect(failuresOf(snapshot(), debit(false, null), 'A_UPI')).toEqual(['BANK_DEBIT_UNCONFIRMED']);
    expect(failuresOf(snapshot(), debit(true, '999.99'), 'A_UPI')).toEqual([
      'DEBIT_AMOUNT_MISMATCH',
    ]);
    expect(failuresOf(snapshot(), debit(true, '1000'), 'A_UPI')).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('an open recon break on the order blocks the leg', () => {
    const s = withLeg<PurchaseDb>('A_UPI', (l) => ({ ...l, openBreaks: ['FP_STATE_DRIFT'] }));
    expect(failuresOf(s, evidence(), 'A_UPI')).toEqual(['OPEN_RECON_BREAK']);
  });
});

describe('evaluateCanary: partial redemption (G-E7 c)', () => {
  it('payout must be seen and land in the folio bank', () => {
    const payout = (payoutSeen: boolean, creditedToFolioBank: boolean) =>
      withEvidence<RedemptionEv>('C_REDEMPTION', (e) => ({
        ...e,

      }));
    expect(failuresOf(snapshot(), payout(false, false), 'C_REDEMPTION')).toEqual([

      fpRedeemedUnits: null,

describe('evaluateCanary: SIP registration (G-E7 b, GO-2 only)', () => {

describe('evaluateCanary: gates', () => {
  it('a missing leg or missing evidence is never a pass', () => {
    const s = snapshot();
    const report = evaluateCanary(
      { ...s, legs: s.legs.filter((l) => l.leg !== 'C_REDEMPTION') },

    expect(report.legs.find((l) => l.leg === 'C_REDEMPTION')?.failures).toEqual(['MISSING']);
    expect(report.legs.find((l) => l.leg === 'A_UPI')?.failures).toEqual(['EVIDENCE_MISSING']);
    expect(report.go1).toBe(false);
  });

  it('GO-1 needs at least one signature-verified prod webhook', () => {
    const report = evaluateCanary(
      snapshot({
        webhooks: {
          windowStart: '2026-11-16T00:00:00+05:30',
          signedProcessed: 0,
          signedProcessedOnCanaryObjects: 0,
          unsigned: 2,
        },
      }),
      evidence(),
    );
    expect(report).toMatchObject({ webhookVerified: false, go1: false, go2Registration: true });
  });
});

describe('renderCanarySection and spliceGeneratedSection', () => {
  it('renders the leg table, the units and EUIN lines, the webhook line and both verdicts between the markers', () => {
    const section = renderCanarySection(evaluateCanary(snapshot(), evidence()));
    expect(section.startsWith(GENERATED_START)).toBe(true);
    expect(section.endsWith(GENERATED_END)).toBe(true);
    expect(section).toContain('| A_UPI | ord-a1 | PASS | 82.413 | 82.413 | 0.000 | — |');
    expect(section).toContain('C_REDEMPTION units: FP reported 24.7004; the ledger applied 24.700');
    expect(section).toContain(
      "Cybrilla's Q12 answer (`docs/probes/cybrilla-answers-2026-11-13.md`) says FP stamps the EUIN ending 5678.",
    );
    expect(section).toContain('| A_UPI | …5678 | …5678 |');
    expect(section).toContain('| B_SIP | …5678 | n/a |');
    expect(section).toContain('3 signature-verified and processed (2 on canary objects)');
    expect(section).toContain(
      '**GO-1 canary evidence (G-E7 a, c and the signed webhook): satisfied.**',
    );
    expect(section).toContain('**GO-2 registration evidence (G-E7 b, R-06): satisfied.**');
  });

  it('names the blockers when a gate is not satisfied', () => {
    const s = withLeg<PurchaseDb>('A_UPI', (l) => ({ ...l, ledgerUnits: null }));
    const section = renderCanarySection(evaluateCanary(s, evidence()));
    expect(section).toContain('NOT satisfied.** Blocking: A_UPI LEDGER_UNITS_MISSING.');
  });

  it('keeps the hand-written text around the markers and refuses a doc without them', () => {
    const doc = `# Canary\n\nintro\n\n${GENERATED_START}\nold\n${GENERATED_END}\n\n## Sign-off\nDev A\n`;
    const out = spliceGeneratedSection(doc, `${GENERATED_START}\nnew\n${GENERATED_END}`);
    expect(out).toBe(
      `# Canary\n\nintro\n\n${GENERATED_START}\nnew\n${GENERATED_END}\n\n## Sign-off\nDev A\n`,
    );
    expect(() => spliceGeneratedSection('# no markers', 'x')).toThrow(/markers/);
  });
});

describe('the committed files cannot carry PII', () => {
  it('the evidence schema refuses unknown keys, a full UTR, a full EUIN and a Q12 ref outside docs/probes', () => {
    const extra = {
      ...evidence(),
      legs: [{ leg: 'B_SIP', fp: fpBase, mandateVisibleInUpiApp: true, pan: 'X' }],
    };
    expect(canaryEvidenceSchema.safeParse(extra).success).toBe(false);
    const fullUtr = withEvidence<PurchaseEv>('A_UPI', (e) => ({
      ...e,
      bank: { ...e.bank, utrLast4: '412345678901' },
    }));
    expect(canaryEvidenceSchema.safeParse(fullUtr).success).toBe(false);
    const fullEuin = withEvidence<PurchaseEv>('A_UPI', (e) => ({
      ...e,
      fp: { euinLast4: 'E905678' },
    }));
    expect(canaryEvidenceSchema.safeParse(fullEuin).success).toBe(false);
    const looseRef = { ...evidence(), q12: { ref: 'answer from Ravi', expectedEuinLast4: EUIN } };
    expect(canaryEvidenceSchema.safeParse(looseRef).success).toBe(false);
    expect(canaryEvidenceSchema.safeParse(evidence()).success).toBe(true);
  });

  it('the snapshot schema accepts the snapshot and refuses an unmasked folio number', () => {
    expect(canarySnapshotSchema.safeParse(snapshot()).success).toBe(true);
    const unmasked = withLeg<PurchaseDb>('A_UPI', (l) => ({ ...l, folioLast4: '12345678' }));
    expect(canarySnapshotSchema.safeParse(unmasked).success).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe('decodeSavedJson', () => {
  it('reads tagged UTF-8 and PowerShell UTF-16LE files', () => {
    const json = JSON.stringify({ a: 1 });
    expect(decodeSavedJson(Buffer.from(`${SNAPSHOT_TAG}${json}\n`, 'utf8'))).toEqual({ a: 1 });
    const utf16 = Buffer.concat([Buffer.from([0xff, 0xfe]), Buffer.from(`${json}\r\n`, 'utf16le')]);
    expect(decodeSavedJson(utf16)).toEqual({ a: 1 });
  });

  it('finds the tagged line in a whole log stream (`get-log-events --output text` joins messages with tabs)', () => {
    const stream = [
      '{"level":30,"msg":"Nest application context started"}',
      `${SNAPSHOT_TAG}${JSON.stringify({ a: 1 })}`,
      '{"level":30,"msg":"closing"}',
    ].join('\t');
    expect(decodeSavedJson(Buffer.from(`${stream}\n`, 'utf8'))).toEqual({ a: 1 });
  });
});
```

```ts
async function attempt(
  orderId: string,
  method: 'UPI' | 'NETBANKING',
  status: 'FAILED' | 'SUCCESS',
) {
  await t.db.db.insert(paymentAttempts).values({

    returnRefExpiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 600_000),

}

/** One inbound_webhook_events row as E1 (or F7's ops:sync) writes it. */
async function webhook(fields: {
  objectId: string | null;
  signatureValid: boolean;
  status: 'RECEIVED' | 'PROCESSED' | 'FAILED';
  receivedAt: Date;
  eventType?: string;
  signatureMode?: 'HMAC' | 'SHARED_SECRET' | 'NONE';
}) {
  const { eventType = 'mf_purchase.updated', signatureMode = 'HMAC', ...rest } = fields;
  await t.db.db.insert(inboundWebhookEvents).values({
    provider: 'FP',
    eventId: newId('inbound_webhook_events'),
    eventType,
    objectType: 'mf_purchase',
    signatureMode,
    payloadSha256: randomBytes(32),
    ...rest,
  });
}

    await expect(

    await expect(

    ).rejects.toThrow(OpsCliError);
    expect(await auditRows()).toHaveLength(before);
  });
```
