- [ ] **Step 3: Minimal implementation**

Create `scripts/gate-evidence.ts`:
```ts
/**
 * GO-1 / GO-2 gate evidence (Task F23; spec §7, R-06, R-21). Plain Node 24 (type stripping).
 *   pnpm gate-evidence g-e4            rewrites the G-E4 block of the gate doc from docs/probes/smoke-*.md
 *   pnpm gate-evidence go-2 <file>     rewrites the GO-2 block from the saved `ops:gate-go2` output, and
 *                                      rewrites <file> itself to that one JSON line (UTF-8)
 * Optional flags: --probes=<dir> (default docs/probes), --doc=<file> (default docs/probes/gate-2026-11-27.md).
 * Exit 1 when the item is not met, so the command doubles as the check.
 */
import { readdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import process from 'node:process';

export const SMOKE_CHAINS = ['onboarding', 'lumpsum', 'sip', 'redemption'] as const;
export type SmokeChain = (typeof SMOKE_CHAINS)[number];

/** R-21: runs count from Mon 11-16; three distinct days are due by Wed 11-25. */
export const G_E4_WINDOW = { from: '2026-11-16', due: '2026-11-25', daysRequired: 3 } as const;

export interface SmokeRun {
  readonly file: string;
  readonly chain: SmokeChain;
  readonly env: 'sandbox' | 'fake' | 'unstamped';
  /** IST calendar day of the `Run at` timestamp; null when the line is missing. */
  readonly istDay: string | null;
  readonly steps: ReadonlyArray<{ name: string; status: string }>;
}

export type RunRejection =
  | 'ENV_NOT_SANDBOX'
  | 'ENV_UNSTAMPED'
  | 'NO_TIMESTAMP'
  | 'NO_STEPS'
  | 'STEP_SKIPPED'
  | 'STEP_NOT_PASSED'
  | 'BEFORE_WINDOW';

const SMOKE_FILE = /^smoke-(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})-([a-z]+)(-fake)?\.md$/;

/** IST is UTC+05:30 with no DST. */
export function istDayOf(iso: string): string {
  const ms = Date.parse(iso);
  if (Number.isNaN(ms)) throw new Error(`gate-evidence: bad timestamp "${iso}"`);
  return new Date(ms + 330 * 60_000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

/** Parses one D4 evidence file (`tools/fp-probes/src/evidence.ts`); null for any other file. */
export function parseSmokeEvidence(file: string, text: string): SmokeRun | null {
  const match = SMOKE_FILE.exec(file);
  const chain = match?.[2];
  if (match === null || !SMOKE_CHAINS.includes(chain as SmokeChain)) return null;
  const runAt = /^Run at (\S+?)\.?$/m.exec(text)?.[1];
  const envLine = /^Env: (\w+)$/m.exec(text)?.[1];
  const env = envLine === 'sandbox' || envLine === 'fake' ? envLine : 'unstamped';
  const steps = text
    .split(/\r?\n/)
    .filter((line) => line.startsWith('| ') && !line.startsWith('| Step |'))
    .map((line) => line.split(' | '))
    .map((cells) => ({ name: (cells[0] ?? '').slice(2), status: cells[1] ?? '' }));
  return {
    file,
    chain: chain as SmokeChain,
    env,
    istDay: runAt === undefined ? null : istDayOf(runAt),
    steps,
  };
}

/**
 * Why a run does not count toward G-E4, or null when it counts. A step D4 left SKIPPED (a placeholder
 * that names the task meant to wire it) is STEP_SKIPPED: the chain is not wired, which only the owner
 * can rule on. A FAILED step is STEP_NOT_PASSED.
 */
export function rejectionOf(run: SmokeRun, from: string): RunRejection | null {
  if (run.env === 'unstamped') return 'ENV_UNSTAMPED';
  if (run.env !== 'sandbox') return 'ENV_NOT_SANDBOX';
  if (run.istDay === null) return 'NO_TIMESTAMP';
  if (run.istDay < from) return 'BEFORE_WINDOW';
  if (run.steps.length === 0) return 'NO_STEPS';
  const notPassed = run.steps.filter((s) => s.status !== 'PASSED');
  if (notPassed.length === 0) return null;
  return notPassed.every((s) => s.status === 'SKIPPED') ? 'STEP_SKIPPED' : 'STEP_NOT_PASSED';
}

export interface ChainVerdict {
  readonly chain: SmokeChain;
  /** Distinct IST days with a fully PASSED sandbox run, ascending, each with its evidence file. */
  readonly days: ReadonlyArray<{ day: string; file: string }>;
  readonly met: boolean;
  /** The third qualifying day is on or before the R-21 due date. */
  readonly onTime: boolean;
  /** A sandbox run in the window still had one of D4's SKIPPED placeholder steps (STEP_SKIPPED). */
  readonly unwired: boolean;
  readonly rejected: ReadonlyArray<{ file: string; reason: RunRejection }>;
}

export interface GE4Verdict {
  readonly met: boolean;
  readonly onTime: boolean;
  /**
   * NOT MET while at least one unmet chain is not wired: G-E4 then needs the owner's ruling, and the
   * block and GO-1's G-E4 row say so instead of a plain NOT MET.
   */
  readonly ownerRulingRequired: boolean;
  readonly chains: readonly ChainVerdict[];
}

export interface GE4Window {
  readonly from: string;
  readonly due: string;
  readonly daysRequired: number;
}

export function evaluateGE4(
  runs: readonly SmokeRun[],
  window: GE4Window = G_E4_WINDOW,
): GE4Verdict {
  const chains = SMOKE_CHAINS.map((chain): ChainVerdict => {
    const mine = runs.filter((r) => r.chain === chain);
    const rejected: Array<{ file: string; reason: RunRejection }> = [];
    const days = new Map<string, string>();
    for (const run of mine) {
      const reason = rejectionOf(run, window.from);
      if (reason !== null) rejected.push({ file: run.file, reason });
      else if (run.istDay !== null && !days.has(run.istDay)) days.set(run.istDay, run.file);
    }
    const sorted = [...days.entries()]
      .sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b))
      .map(([day, file]) => ({ day, file }));
    const third = sorted[window.daysRequired - 1]?.day;
    return {
      chain,
      days: sorted,
      met: third !== undefined,
      onTime: third !== undefined && third <= window.due,
      unwired: rejected.some((r) => r.reason === 'STEP_SKIPPED'),
      rejected,
    };
  });
  const met = chains.every((c) => c.met);
  return {
    met,
    onTime: chains.every((c) => c.onTime),
    ownerRulingRequired: !met && chains.some((c) => !c.met && c.unwired),
    chains,
  };
}

function ge4Headline(verdict: GE4Verdict): string {
  if (verdict.met) return verdict.onTime ? 'MET' : 'MET after the due date';
  return verdict.ownerRulingRequired ? 'NOT MET: owner ruling required' : 'NOT MET';
}

export function renderGE4(verdict: GE4Verdict): string {
  const rows = verdict.chains.map((c) => {
    const notMet = c.unwired ? 'NOT MET (not wired)' : 'NOT MET';
    const status = c.met ? (c.onTime ? 'MET' : 'MET LATE') : notMet;
    const files = c.days.map((d) => `[${d.day}](${d.file})`).join(', ');
    return `| ${c.chain} | ${c.days.length} | ${files === '' ? '-' : files} | ${status} |`;
  });
  const rejected = verdict.chains.flatMap((c) =>
    c.rejected.map((r) => `- \`${r.file}\`: ${r.reason}`),
  );
  const unwired = verdict.chains.filter((c) => !c.met && c.unwired).map((c) => `\`${c.chain}\``);
  const ruling = verdict.ownerRulingRequired
    ? [
        `Not wired: ${unwired.join(', ')}. Their sandbox runs still carry D4's SKIPPED placeholder steps, so they cannot count. G-E4 also depends on sandbox ONDC purchases settling (probe P-07). GO-1 cannot be called on G-E4 until the owner rules: record the ruling in the decision record.`,
        '',
      ]
    : [];
  return [
    `G-E4 sandbox smoke (R-21: ${G_E4_WINDOW.daysRequired} distinct IST days from ${G_E4_WINDOW.from}, due ${G_E4_WINDOW.due}).`,
    '',
    '| Chain | Days | Evidence | Status |',
    '|---|---|---|---|',
    ...rows,
    '',
    `**G-E4: ${ge4Headline(verdict)}.**`,
    '',
    ...ruling,
    ...(rejected.length === 0 ? [] : ['Runs not counted:', '', ...rejected, '']),
  ].join('\n');
}

/** The JSON line `ops:gate-go2` prints (apps/api/src/modules/plans/go2-evidence.ts). */
export interface Go2Evidence {
  readonly kind: 'go2_evidence';
  readonly generatedAt: string;
  readonly planId: string;
  readonly planStatus: string;
  readonly mandateStatus: string;
  readonly mandateRail: string;
  readonly mandateApprovedAt: string | null;
  readonly firstInstalmentDate: string | null;
  readonly nextInstalmentDate: string | null;
  readonly fpPlanIdRecorded: boolean;
  readonly firstInstalment: {
    readonly orderStatus: string;
    readonly allottedUnits: string | null;
    readonly allottedNavDate: string | null;
  } | null;
}

export type Go2Reason =
  | 'MANDATE_NOT_APPROVED'
  | 'PLAN_NOT_ACTIVE'
  | 'FIRST_INSTALMENT_DATE_MISSING';

export interface Go2Verdict {
  readonly ready: boolean;
  readonly reasons: readonly Go2Reason[];
  /** Evidenced when it lands; never blocks GO-2 (R-06). */
  readonly debitAndAllotment: 'LANDED' | 'PENDING';
}

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}

const nullableString = (v: unknown): v is string | null => v === null || typeof v === 'string';

/**
 * Finds the evidence in what was saved from the ops task's log stream. F7's `aws logs get-log-events
 * --output text` prints the stream's messages on one line separated by tabs, and other tools prefix each
 * message with a timestamp and the stream name. JSON.stringify never writes a raw tab or newline, so a
 * candidate runs from its first `{` to the next tab or line break. The last one wins (the latest run).
 */
export function parseGo2Evidence(text: string): Go2Evidence {
  const line = text
    .split(/\r?\n|\t/)
    .filter((segment) => segment.includes('"go2_evidence"') && segment.includes('{'))
    .map((segment) => segment.slice(segment.indexOf('{')).trim())
    .at(-1);
  if (line === undefined) throw new Error('gate-evidence: no go2_evidence JSON line found');
  const v: unknown = JSON.parse(line);
  const fi = isRecord(v) ? v.firstInstalment : undefined;
  if (
    !isRecord(v) ||
    v.kind !== 'go2_evidence' ||
    typeof v.generatedAt !== 'string' ||
    typeof v.planId !== 'string' ||
    typeof v.planStatus !== 'string' ||
    typeof v.mandateStatus !== 'string' ||
    typeof v.mandateRail !== 'string' ||
    !nullableString(v.mandateApprovedAt) ||
    !nullableString(v.firstInstalmentDate) ||
    !nullableString(v.nextInstalmentDate) ||
    typeof v.fpPlanIdRecorded !== 'boolean' ||
    !(
      fi === null ||
      (isRecord(fi) &&
        typeof fi.orderStatus === 'string' &&
        nullableString(fi.allottedUnits) &&
        nullableString(fi.allottedNavDate))
    )
  ) {
    throw new Error('gate-evidence: the go2_evidence line does not have the expected fields');
  }
  return v as unknown as Go2Evidence;
}

/** R-06: mandate APPROVED + plan ACTIVE + FP first-instalment date recorded. */
export function evaluateGo2(e: Go2Evidence): Go2Verdict {
  const reasons: Go2Reason[] = [];
  if (e.mandateStatus !== 'APPROVED') reasons.push('MANDATE_NOT_APPROVED');
  if (e.planStatus !== 'ACTIVE') reasons.push('PLAN_NOT_ACTIVE');
  if (e.firstInstalmentDate === null) reasons.push('FIRST_INSTALMENT_DATE_MISSING');
  const landed =
    e.firstInstalment?.orderStatus === 'SETTLED' && e.firstInstalment.allottedUnits !== null;
  return { ready: reasons.length === 0, reasons, debitAndAllotment: landed ? 'LANDED' : 'PENDING' };
}

export function renderGo2(e: Go2Evidence, verdict: Go2Verdict): string {
  const mark = (ok: boolean) => (ok ? 'yes' : 'NO');
  const fi = e.firstInstalment;
  return [
    `Canary plan \`${e.planId}\`, read ${e.generatedAt} by \`ops:gate-go2\` (R-16 ops role).`,
    '',
    '| R-06 condition | Recorded value | Met |',
    '|---|---|---|',
    `| Mandate APPROVED (${e.mandateRail}) | ${e.mandateStatus}${e.mandateApprovedAt === null ? '' : ` at ${e.mandateApprovedAt}`} | ${mark(e.mandateStatus === 'APPROVED')} |`,
    `| Plan ACTIVE (FP plan id recorded: ${e.fpPlanIdRecorded ? 'yes' : 'no'}) | ${e.planStatus} | ${mark(e.planStatus === 'ACTIVE')} |`,
    `| FP first-instalment date recorded | ${e.firstInstalmentDate ?? 'none'} | ${mark(e.firstInstalmentDate !== null)} |`,
    '',
    `First instalment debit and allotment (evidenced when they land; not a GO-2 blocker): ${
      fi === null
        ? 'PENDING (no instalment order yet)'
        : `${verdict.debitAndAllotment} (order ${fi.orderStatus}, units ${fi.allottedUnits ?? '-'}, NAV date ${fi.allottedNavDate ?? '-'})`
    }.`,
    '',
    verdict.ready
      ? '**GO-2 evidence: MET.**'
      : `**GO-2 evidence: NOT MET** (${verdict.reasons.join(', ')}).`,
    '',
  ].join('\n');
}

/** Replaces the body between `<!-- <id>:BEGIN -->` and `<!-- <id>:END -->`, nothing else. */
export function replaceBlock(doc: string, id: string, body: string): string {
  const begin = `<!-- ${id}:BEGIN -->`;
  const end = `<!-- ${id}:END -->`;
  const from = doc.indexOf(begin);
  const to = doc.indexOf(end);
  if (from === -1 || to === -1 || to < from) {
    throw new Error(`gate-evidence: the gate doc has no ${id} markers`);
  }
  return `${doc.slice(0, from + begin.length)}\n${body.trimEnd()}\n${doc.slice(to)}`;
}

/** UTF-8, or UTF-16LE with a BOM (PowerShell 5.1's `>` redirection writes UTF-16LE). */
export function decodeText(buffer: Buffer): string {
  if (buffer[0] === 0xff && buffer[1] === 0xfe) return buffer.subarray(2).toString('utf16le');
  return buffer.toString('utf8').replace(/^\uFEFF/, '');
}

function flag(argv: readonly string[], name: string, fallback: string): string {
  return argv.find((a) => a.startsWith(`--${name}=`))?.slice(name.length + 3) ?? fallback;
}

function main(argv: readonly string[]): number {
  const [command, input] = argv.filter((a) => !a.startsWith('--'));
  const probes = flag(argv, 'probes', join('docs', 'probes'));
  const docPath = flag(argv, 'doc', join('docs', 'probes', 'gate-2026-11-27.md'));
  const doc = readFileSync(docPath, 'utf8');
  if (command === 'g-e4') {
    // Only smoke evidence files are read: docs/probes also holds other evidence and folders
    // (F24's incidents/), and reading a folder throws EISDIR.
    const runs = readdirSync(probes)
      .filter((file) => SMOKE_FILE.test(file))
      .flatMap((file) => {
        const run = parseSmokeEvidence(file, readFileSync(join(probes, file), 'utf8'));
        return run === null ? [] : [run];
      });
    const verdict = evaluateGE4(runs);
    const body = renderGE4(verdict);
    writeFileSync(docPath, replaceBlock(doc, 'G-E4', body));
    process.stdout.write(`${body}\n`);
    return verdict.met ? 0 : 1;
  }
  if (command === 'go-2' && input !== undefined) {
    const evidence = parseGo2Evidence(decodeText(readFileSync(input)));
    // The file is committed as evidence: keep only the evidence line, as UTF-8 (the saved stream also
    // holds the ops task's other log lines, and PowerShell 5.1's `>` writes UTF-16).
    writeFileSync(input, `${JSON.stringify(evidence)}\n`);
    const verdict = evaluateGo2(evidence);
    const body = renderGo2(evidence, verdict);
    writeFileSync(docPath, replaceBlock(doc, 'GO-2', body));
    process.stdout.write(`${body}\n`);
    return verdict.ready ? 0 : 1;
  }
  process.stderr.write(
    'usage: gate-evidence g-e4 | gate-evidence go-2 <saved ops:gate-go2 output>\n',
  );
  return 2;
}

if (import.meta.main) {
  process.exitCode = main(process.argv.slice(2));
}
```

```ts
import { mkdir, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import path from 'node:path';
import type { ChainResult, RunOptions } from './types.js';

/** IST calendar day (UTC+05:30, no DST): R-21 counts G-E4 days in IST. */
export function istDay(at: Date): string {
  return new Date(at.getTime() + 330 * 60_000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

/**
 * Writes `smoke-<IST day>-<chain>.md` (a `-fake` suffix for --env=fake, so a fake run can never
 * overwrite or pass for sandbox evidence) with an `Env:` line that F23's gate-evidence reads.
 */
export async function writeEvidence(
  dir: string,
  chain: string,
  result: ChainResult,
  env?: RunOptions['env'],
): Promise<string> {
  await mkdir(dir, { recursive: true });
  const at = new Date();
  const suffix = env === 'fake' ? '-fake' : '';
  const file = path.join(dir, `smoke-${istDay(at)}-${chain}${suffix}.md`);
  const lines = [
    `# FP sandbox smoke: ${chain}`,
    '',
    `Run at ${at.toISOString()}.`,
    '',
    ...(env === undefined ? [] : [`Env: ${env}`, '']),
    '| Step | Status | Detail |',
    '|---|---|---|',
    ...result.steps.map(
      (step) => `| ${step.name} | ${step.status} | ${step.detail.replace(/\|/g, '\\|')} |`,
    ),
    '',
  ];
  await writeFile(file, lines.join('\n'), 'utf8');
  return file;
}
```

  const scheme = await seedSipScheme(t);
  const [mandate] = await t.db.db
    .insert(mandates)
    .values({
      ...ACTOR,
      investorId: investor.investorId,
      bankAccountId: investor.bankId,
      rail: 'UPI_AUTOPAY',
      limitAmount: '100000.00',
      status: opts.mandateStatus,
      approvedAt: opts.mandateStatus === 'APPROVED' ? new Date('2026-11-19T06:10:00.000Z') : null,
    })
    .returning();
  if (mandate === undefined) throw new Error('mandate insert returned no row');
  const [plan] = await t.db.db
    .insert(plans)
    .values({
      ...ACTOR,
      investorId: investor.investorId,
      schemeId: scheme.id,
      amount: '5000.00',
      installmentDay: 25,
      firstInstalmentDateShown: '2026-11-25',
      firstInstalmentDate: opts.firstInstalmentDate,
      nextInstalmentDate: opts.firstInstalmentDate,
      mandateId: mandate.id,
      status: opts.planStatus,
      arn: 'ARN-000000',
      initiatedVia: 'web',
      userIp: '203.0.113.10',
      fpPlanId: opts.planStatus === 'ACTIVE' ? 'mfpp_canary' : null,
    })
    .returning();
  if (plan === undefined) throw new Error('plan insert returned no row');
  return { investor, scheme, planId: plan.id };
}

describe('ops:gate-go2 (an F7 ops runner command, BRIEF D5)', () => {
  const auditRows = () =>
    t.db.db.select().from(auditEvents).where(eq(auditEvents.action, OPS_GATE_GO2));

  it('returns the evidence as one JSON line and writes one SYSTEM audit row', async () => {
    const { planId } = await seedCanary(ready);
    const before = (await auditRows()).length;

    const line = await opsGateGo2(opsContextOf(t.app), ['--plan-id', planId]);

    expect(line).not.toContain('\n');
    expect(JSON.parse(line)).toMatchObject({
      kind: 'go2_evidence',
      planId,
      planStatus: 'ACTIVE',
      mandateStatus: 'APPROVED',
      firstInstalmentDate: '2026-11-25',
    });
    const rows = await auditRows();
    expect(rows).toHaveLength(before + 1);
    expect(rows.at(-1)).toMatchObject({
      actorType: 'SYSTEM',
      actorId: null,
      entityType: 'plans',
      entityId: planId,
    });
  });

  it('refuses a missing or malformed --plan-id and an unknown plan, and writes no audit row', async () => {
    const before = (await auditRows()).length;
    const run = (argv: string[]) => opsGateGo2(opsContextOf(t.app), argv);
    await expect(run([])).rejects.toThrow(/--plan-id is required/);
    await expect(run(['--plan-id', '42'])).rejects.toThrow(/must be a uuid/);
    await expect(run(['--plan-id=01930000-0000-7000-8000-00000000dead'])).rejects.toThrow(
      OpsCliError,
    );
    await expect(run(['--plan-id', '01930000-0000-7000-8000-00000000dead'])).rejects.toThrow(
      /no plan/,
    );
    expect(await auditRows()).toHaveLength(before);
  });
});

Create `apps/api/src/modules/plans/go2-evidence.ts`:
```ts
import { and, asc, eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import type { DbExecutor } from '../../db/client.js';
import { orders } from '../orders/orders.schema.js';
import { mandates, plans } from './plans.schema.js';

/**
 * The GO-2 evidence line (spec §7, R-06) for one canary SIP plan. Read-only; no FP call, no PII
 * (no PAN, mobile, bank number, UMRN or FP ids, only whether an FP plan id is recorded).
 * `scripts/gate-evidence.ts` (`parseGo2Evidence`) consumes exactly these keys.
 */
export interface Go2Evidence {
  kind: 'go2_evidence';
  generatedAt: string;
  planId: string;
  planStatus: string;
  mandateStatus: string;
  mandateRail: string;
  mandateApprovedAt: string | null;
  firstInstalmentDate: string | null;
  nextInstalmentDate: string | null;
  fpPlanIdRecorded: boolean;
  firstInstalment: {
    orderStatus: string;
    allottedUnits: string | null;
    allottedNavDate: string | null;
  } | null;
}

export async function readGo2Evidence(
  db: DbExecutor,
  planId: string,
  now: Date,
): Promise<Go2Evidence | null> {
  const [row] = await db
    .select({
      planId: plans.id,
      planStatus: plans.status,
      firstInstalmentDate: plans.firstInstalmentDate,
      nextInstalmentDate: plans.nextInstalmentDate,
      fpPlanId: plans.fpPlanId,
      mandateStatus: mandates.status,
      mandateRail: mandates.rail,
      mandateApprovedAt: mandates.approvedAt,
    })
    .from(plans)
    .innerJoin(mandates, eq(plans.mandateId, mandates.id))
    .where(eq(plans.id, planId))
    .limit(1);
  if (row === undefined) return null;
  const [first] = await db
    .select({
      orderStatus: orders.status,
      allottedUnits: orders.allottedUnits,
      allottedNavDate: orders.allottedNavDate,
    })
    .from(orders)
    .where(and(eq(orders.planId, planId), eq(orders.origin, 'SIP_INSTALMENT')))
    .orderBy(asc(orders.createdAt))
    .limit(1);
  return {
    kind: 'go2_evidence',
    generatedAt: now.toISOString(),
    planId: row.planId,
    planStatus: row.planStatus,
    mandateStatus: row.mandateStatus,
    mandateRail: row.mandateRail,
    mandateApprovedAt: row.mandateApprovedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
    firstInstalmentDate: row.firstInstalmentDate,
    nextInstalmentDate: row.nextInstalmentDate,
    fpPlanIdRecorded: row.fpPlanId !== null,
    firstInstalment: first ?? null,
  };
}
```

Create `apps/api/src/cli/ops-gate-go2.ts`:
```ts
import { readGo2Evidence } from '../modules/plans/go2-evidence.js';
import { OpsCliError, type OpsCommand, parseFlags, requireUuid } from './ops-common.js';

/** audit_events.action for this command (R-20: every ops command leaves one row). */
export const OPS_GATE_GO2 = 'OPS_GATE_GO2';

/**
 * `ops:gate-go2 --plan-id <uuid>` (F23; spec §7, R-06): prints the GO-2 evidence line for the canary SIP
 * plan, the JSON `pnpm gate-evidence go-2` reads. Read-only apart from its audit row: no FP call, no
 * status write, no PII. It names no operator (BRIEF D5 gives it no handle flag), so its audit row is a
 * SYSTEM row, F7's rule for a read-only report. Deployed, it runs in F7's form on F1's ops task
 * definition (container `ops`, login sanchay_app_login, session role pinned to sanchay_app).
 */
export const opsGateGo2: OpsCommand = async (ctx, argv) => {
  const flags = parseFlags(argv, { values: ['plan-id'] });
  const planId = requireUuid(flags, 'plan-id');
  const evidence = await readGo2Evidence(ctx.db, planId, ctx.clock.now());
  if (evidence === null) throw new OpsCliError(`no plan ${planId}`);
  await ctx.audit.record(null, {
    action: OPS_GATE_GO2,
    actorType: 'SYSTEM',
    entityType: 'plans',
    entityId: planId,
    reason: 'GO-2 evidence read (R-06)',
    data: { status: evidence.planStatus },
  });
  return JSON.stringify(evidence);
};
```

```ts
/**
 * Runbook lint (G-E8, spec §7; F24). Fails when one of the 13 required runbooks is missing, lacks the
 * shared shape, breaks the AGENTS.md command rules inside a code fence, names an alarm F1 does not
 * create, or contains a real-looking mobile number or PAN. Run with plain Node 24 (type stripping):
 * `node scripts/check-runbooks.ts` or `pnpm check-runbooks`. An optional first argument overrides the
 * directory (default docs/runbooks).
 */
import { existsSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import process from 'node:process';

export interface RequiredRunbook {
  readonly slug: string;
  readonly title: string;
}

export type ProblemCode =
  | 'MISSING'
  | 'TITLE'
  | 'OWNER'
  | 'SECTION_MISSING'
  | 'SECTION_ORDER'
  | 'AMPERSANDS'
  | 'FILTER_FORM'
  | 'ENV_TWIN'
  | 'ALARM'
  | 'PII'
  | 'INDEX';

export interface RunbookProblem {
  readonly file: string;
  readonly line: number;
  readonly code: ProblemCode;
  readonly message: string;
}

/**
 * Spec §7 G-E8, in the spec's order. `credential-rotation` is F1's and `otp-send-failure` is the S1 stub
 * (item 2, "SMS outage"); F24 extends both and writes the other eleven.
 */
export const REQUIRED_RUNBOOKS: readonly RequiredRunbook[] = [
  { slug: 'fp-outage', title: 'FP outage' },
  { slug: 'otp-send-failure', title: 'OTP send failure' },
  { slug: 'stuck-reconciling', title: 'Stuck RECONCILING' },
  { slug: 'units-pending', title: 'UNITS_PENDING' },
  { slug: 'refund', title: 'Refund' },
  { slug: 'payout-delayed', title: 'Payout delayed' },
  { slug: 'worker-down', title: 'Worker down' },
  { slug: 'kill-switch', title: 'Kill switch' },
  { slug: 'credential-rotation', title: 'credential rotation' },
  { slug: 'cert-in-6h', title: 'CERT-In 6 h report' },
  { slug: 'dpdp-breach', title: 'DPDP breach' },
  { slug: 'account-closure-dsr', title: 'Account closure and data requests' },
  { slug: 'assisted-contact-bank-change', title: 'Assisted contact and bank change' },
];

/** Every runbook has these H2 sections, in this order; other H2 sections may sit before or between them. */
export const REQUIRED_SECTIONS: readonly string[] = [
  'When to use',
  'Detect',
  'Act',
  'Verify',
  'Escalate',
  'Evidence',
];

/** F1's alarms (`infra/lib/alarms.ts` `ALARM_SUFFIXES`), all in prod: R-31 leaves no dev stack. */
export const KNOWN_ALARMS: readonly string[] = [
  'sanchay-prod-alb-5xx',
  'sanchay-prod-target-unhealthy',
  'sanchay-prod-worker-heartbeat-stale',
  'sanchay-prod-job-queue-age',
  'sanchay-prod-reconciling-sla',
  'sanchay-prod-money-invariant-breach',
  'sanchay-prod-webhook-signature-failures',
  'sanchay-prod-otp-send-failure-rate',
  'sanchay-prod-sms-cap-reached',
  'sanchay-prod-nav-age',
];

/** F1 names that share the `sanchay-<env>-` prefix but are not alarms: task families, ECR, the PITR copy. */
const OTHER_ENV_NAMES: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set([
  'migrate',
  'ops',
  'api',
  'web',
  'restore-test',
]);
const ENV_NAME = /\bsanchay-(prod|dev|\{env\}|<env>)-([a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*)/g;
const MOBILE = /(?<![\d-])[6-9]\d{9}(?!\d)/;
const PAN = /\b[A-Z]{5}\d{4}[A-Z]\b/;
const PS_ENV = /\$env:([A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*)\s*=/g;

/**
 * Null when `sanchay-<env>-<suffix>` is one of F1's alarms or another F1 resource. `{env}` and `<env>`
 * stand for prod, the only stack (R-31), so a `sanchay-dev-` name is always a problem.
 */
function alarmProblem(env: string, suffix: string): string | null {
  if (env === 'dev')
    return `sanchay-dev-${suffix}: there is no dev stack (R-31); write sanchay-prod-${suffix}`;
  if (OTHER_ENV_NAMES.has(suffix) || KNOWN_ALARMS.includes(`sanchay-prod-${suffix}`)) return null;
  return `sanchay-${env}-${suffix} is not one of F1's alarms (KNOWN_ALARMS)`;
}

export function checkRunbookText(slug: string, title: string, text: string): RunbookProblem[] {
  const file = `${slug}.md`;
  const lines = text.split(/\r?\n/);
  const problems: RunbookProblem[] = [];
  const add = (line: number, code: ProblemCode, message: string): void => {
    problems.push({ file, line, code, message });
  };

  if (lines[0] !== `# Runbook: ${title}`)
    add(1, 'TITLE', `first line must be "# Runbook: ${title}"`);
  if (!lines.some((l) => l.startsWith('Owner:'))) add(1, 'OWNER', 'needs an "Owner:" line');

  const headings = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const [i, l] of lines.entries()) {
    const m = /^## (.+?)\s*$/.exec(l);
    if (m?.[1] !== undefined && !headings.has(m[1])) headings.set(m[1], i + 1);
  }
  let lastLine = 0;
  let ordered = true;
  for (const section of REQUIRED_SECTIONS) {
    const at = headings.get(section);
    if (at === undefined) {
      add(1, 'SECTION_MISSING', `missing "## ${section}"`);
      continue;
    }
    if (at < lastLine) ordered = false;
    lastLine = at;
  }
  if (ordered === false)
    add(1, 'SECTION_ORDER', `sections must appear in the order: ${REQUIRED_SECTIONS.join(', ')}`);

  let inFence = false;
  const fenced: Array<{ line: number; text: string }> = [];
  for (const [i, l] of lines.entries()) {
    if (/^\s*```/.test(l)) {
      inFence = !inFence;
      continue;
    }
    if (inFence) fenced.push({ line: i + 1, text: l });
    if (MOBILE.test(l) || PAN.test(l))
      add(i + 1, 'PII', 'real-looking mobile number or PAN; use <mobile> / <pan>');
    for (const m of l.matchAll(ENV_NAME)) {
      const problem = alarmProblem(m[1] ?? '', m[2] ?? '');
      if (problem !== null) add(i + 1, 'ALARM', problem);
    }
  }
  for (const f of fenced) {
    if (/\s&&\s/.test(f.text))
      add(f.line, 'AMPERSANDS', 'no && in commands (AGENTS.md): one command per line');
    if (/--filter\s+@/.test(f.text)) add(f.line, 'FILTER_FORM', 'use --filter=@sanchay/<name>');
    for (const m of f.text.matchAll(PS_ENV)) {
      const name = m[1] ?? '';
      const twin = new RegExp(`^\\s*(?:[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*=\\S*\\s+)*${name}=\\S*\\s+\\S`);
      if (!fenced.some((g) => twin.test(g.text))) {
        add(
          f.line,
          'ENV_TWIN',
          `$env:${name} needs its Git Bash form (${name}=<v> <cmd>) in a code block`,
        );
      }
    }
  }
  return problems;
}

export function checkIndex(text: string, slugs: readonly string[]): RunbookProblem[] {
  const missing = slugs.filter((s) => !text.includes(`(${s}.md)`));
  if (missing.length === 0) return [];
  return [
    {
      file: 'README.md',
      line: 1,
      code: 'INDEX',
      message: `README.md does not link: ${missing.map((s) => `${s}.md`).join(', ')}`,
    },
  ];
}

export function checkRunbooksDir(dir: string): { checked: number; problems: RunbookProblem[] } {
  const problems: RunbookProblem[] = [];
  let checked = 0;
  for (const { slug, title } of REQUIRED_RUNBOOKS) {
    const path = join(dir, `${slug}.md`);
    if (!existsSync(path)) {
      problems.push({
        file: `${slug}.md`,
        line: 0,
        code: 'MISSING',
        message: 'required G-E8 runbook is missing',
      });
      continue;
    }
    checked += 1;
    problems.push(...checkRunbookText(slug, title, readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
  }
  const index = join(dir, 'README.md');
  if (existsSync(index)) {
    problems.push(
      ...checkIndex(
        readFileSync(index, 'utf8'),
        REQUIRED_RUNBOOKS.map((r) => r.slug),
      ),
    );
  } else {
    problems.push({
      file: 'README.md',
      line: 0,
      code: 'MISSING',
      message: 'runbook index is missing',
    });
  }
  return { checked, problems };
}

if (import.meta.main) {
  const dir = process.argv[2] ?? join('docs', 'runbooks');
  const { checked, problems } = checkRunbooksDir(dir);
  for (const p of problems)
    process.stderr.write(`${dir}/${p.file}:${p.line}: [${p.code}] ${p.message}\n`);
  if (problems.length > 0) {
    process.stderr.write(`check-runbooks: ${problems.length} problem(s) in ${dir}\n`);
    process.exitCode = 1;
  } else {
    process.stdout.write(`check-runbooks: ${checked} runbooks checked, no problems\n`);
  }
}
```

````markdown
# Runbooks

G-E8 (spec §7) requires these 13 runbooks before GO-1. `pnpm check-runbooks` (F24) fails the build when
one is missing, lacks the shared shape (When to use, Detect, Act, Verify, Escalate, Evidence), puts `&&` or
the space form of `--filter` in a command, gives a PowerShell `$env:` command without its Git Bash form,
names an alarm F1 does not create or a `sanchay-dev-` resource (R-31: there is no dev stack), or contains a
real-looking mobile number or PAN.

| # | Runbook | Typical trigger |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | [FP outage](fp-outage.md) | FP 5xx or timeouts, `sanchay-prod-webhook-signature-failures` |
| 2 | [OTP send failure](otp-send-failure.md) (SMS outage) | `sanchay-prod-otp-send-failure-rate`, `sanchay-prod-sms-cap-reached` |
| 3 | [Stuck RECONCILING](stuck-reconciling.md) | `sanchay-prod-reconciling-sla`, PROCESSING past T+2 |
| 4 | [UNITS_PENDING](units-pending.md) | `UNITS_PENDING_T3` / `UNITS_PENDING_T5` break, a ledger shortfall |
| 5 | [Refund](refund.md) | debit without a live order, refund overdue |
| 6 | [Payout delayed](payout-delayed.md) | `payout.watch` marks a payout DELAYED (after `payout_due_by`) |
| 7 | [Worker down](worker-down.md) | `sanchay-prod-worker-heartbeat-stale`, `sanchay-prod-job-queue-age`, `sanchay-prod-alb-5xx`, `sanchay-prod-target-unhealthy` |
| 8 | [Kill switch](kill-switch.md) | `sanchay-prod-money-invariant-breach`, any money incident |
| 9 | [Credential rotation](credential-rotation.md) | scheduled rotation, leaked secret (F1) |
| 10 | [CERT-In 6 h report](cert-in-6h.md) | any reportable cyber incident |
| 11 | [DPDP breach](dpdp-breach.md) | personal data breach |
| 12 | [Account closure and data requests](account-closure-dsr.md) | closure email, DPDP access/correction/erasure request |
| 13 | [Assisted contact and bank change](assisted-contact-bank-change.md) | investor asks to change mobile, email, bank or nominee |

Related references (not G-E8 items): [ops CLIs](ops-cli.md) (F7: every `ops:*` command, its flags, what it
writes and the one deployed run form), [database access](db-access.md) (F1: the logins, the migrate task and
the read-only SQL session over SSM) and [Android release](android-release.md) (F18).

Every name below is prod's: R-31 leaves one deployed stack, `SanchayMvpStack-prod`, and no dev stack or dev
domain.

## Alarm to runbook map

F1 creates these ten alarms in prod only (`infra/lib/alarms.ts`), on the SNS topic `sanchay-ops-alerts-prod`;
each notifies on ALARM and again on OK. The gauges come from the worker's `ops.gauges.emit` log line, once a
minute, and every gauge alarm reads its maximum per period. "N consecutive periods" means every one of the
last N periods breached. Every gauge alarm (all but `alb-5xx`, `target-unhealthy` and `otp-send-failure-rate`) also
counts a period without a gauge line as breaching (F1, RV-04-F1-6), so a stopped worker puts all seven gauge
alarms into ALARM together: start with [Worker down](worker-down.md).

| Alarm | Fires when (F1's threshold, period and evaluation periods) | Runbook |
|---|---|---|
| `sanchay-prod-alb-5xx` | more than 10 target 5xx responses (sum) in one 5-minute period | [Worker down](worker-down.md) (API section) |
| `sanchay-prod-target-unhealthy` | an api target fails `/api/v1/health` (unhealthy hosts above 0) in 3 consecutive one-minute periods | [Worker down](worker-down.md) (API section) |
| `sanchay-prod-worker-heartbeat-stale` | the newest worker heartbeat is older than 120 s in 3 consecutive one-minute periods; a period with no gauge line counts as breaching (no data means no worker) | [Worker down](worker-down.md) |
| `sanchay-prod-job-queue-age` | a due pg-boss job has waited more than 120 s in 2 consecutive one-minute periods | [Worker down](worker-down.md) |
| `sanchay-prod-reconciling-sla` | an order, plan or mandate has been RECONCILING for more than 2 hours (the gauge is above 0 in one 5-minute period) | [Stuck RECONCILING](stuck-reconciling.md) |
| `sanchay-prod-money-invariant-breach` | an OPEN CRITICAL recon break (the gauge is above 0 in one 5-minute period); it stays in ALARM until every CRITICAL break is resolved | [Kill switch](kill-switch.md), then the break table below |
| `sanchay-prod-webhook-signature-failures` | more than 3 FP webhooks with an invalid signature in one 5-minute period | [FP outage](fp-outage.md); a sustained burst from unknown sources also opens [CERT-In 6 h report](cert-in-6h.md) |
| `sanchay-prod-otp-send-failure-rate` | more than 5% of OTP sends failed in one 15-minute period, counted only when that period had at least 20 sends (sent plus failed) | [OTP send failure](otp-send-failure.md) |
| `sanchay-prod-sms-cap-reached` | SMS sent since 00:00 IST reach 1,800 or more (90% of the 2,000-a-day cap; the 2,001st is refused), read in one 5-minute period | [OTP send failure](otp-send-failure.md) |
| `sanchay-prod-nav-age` | NAV is missing for a business day after 11:00 IST (the business-days-behind gauge reaches 1) in one one-hour period | no G-E8 runbook: read the `nav.sync.daily` worker log and the AMFI file; release a quarantined NAV only after checking it on the AMC site, with `ops:nav-release --isin <isin> --approver1 <handle> --approver2 <handle>` (two founders; spec §4.6, D9) |

## CRITICAL break kinds

`sanchay-prod-money-invariant-breach` stays in ALARM while any CRITICAL break is OPEN, so read the kind first
(`SELECT id, kind, severity, entity_type, entity_id, created_at FROM app.v_recon_breaks_open ORDER BY severity, created_at;`):

| Kind | Raised by | Runbook | Leaves the open list |
|---|---|---|---|
| `INVARIANT_M1_PROVIDER_ID_WITHOUT_CONSENT`, `INVARIANT_M2_LOT_CONSERVATION`, `INVARIANT_M3_DUPLICATE_PAYMENT_SUCCESS`, `INVARIANT_M4_SETTLED_PURCHASE_LOT`, `INVARIANT_RESERVATIONS_OVER_HELD` | `integrity.invariants` (hourly at :05 IST, F7) | [Kill switch](kill-switch.md): orders off first | by itself, on the first hourly run after the data is right (`ops:resolve-break` refuses them) |
| `UNITS_PENDING_T5`, `LEDGER_UNITS_SHORTFALL`, `LEDGER_REVERSAL_CONSUMED_LOT`, `ALLOTMENT_INVALID`, `REDEMPTION_EXIT_INVALID`, `REDEMPTION_REVERSED` | the ledger (F4, F5) | [UNITS_PENDING](units-pending.md) | `ops:resolve-break` (two founders) once handled |
| `RECON_FP_OBJECT_UNKNOWN`, `RECON_ORDER_OUTCOME_DIFFERS` | `recon.fp.daily` (02:00 IST, F7) | [Kill switch](kill-switch.md), then [Stuck RECONCILING](stuck-reconciling.md) or [Refund](refund.md) | `ops:resolve-break` once handled |
| `MANDATE_CREATE_AMBIGUOUS` (F2), `PLAN_CANCEL_UNRESOLVED` (F28) | the SIP saga | [Stuck RECONCILING](stuck-reconciling.md) | `ops:resolve-break` once handled (refused while the mandate is still RECONCILING) |

## Rules every runbook follows

- Ops never writes to FP, and no ops command writes an order, plan, mandate or redemption status (spec §4.6,
  R-16). The only levers are F7's commands: `ops:sync`, `ops:kill-switch`, `ops:sip-switch`, `ops:refund-utr`,
  `ops:payout-ref`, `ops:invite`, `ops:nav-release` and `ops:resolve-break`. A freeze (`--off`) takes one
  operator; turning money flow back on, or recording money evidence, takes two different founders.
- Operators are named by handle: a lower-case id such as `f.anita` (2 to 32 characters from `a-z`, `0-9`, `.`,
  `_`, `-`, starting with a letter), never a name or an email. It lands in `audit_events.actor_id`.
- SQL is read-only, as `sanchay_readonly_login` over SSM ([database access](db-access.md), "Read-only SQL over
  SSM (spec §2.4)"), against F7's six views only: `app.v_reconciling_orders`, `app.v_units_pending`,
  `app.v_recon_breaks_open`, `app.v_payouts_due`, `app.v_ops_audit` and `app.v_pilot_invites_count`. No base
  table is readable: not `audit_events`, `pilot_invites`, `payment_attempts` or `order_events`, and no `*_enc`
  column.
- Evidence goes in `docs/probes/incidents/<yyyy-mm-dd>-<runbook>.md`: times in IST, order and challenge ids,
  alarm names, commands run and their output. Never a mobile number, email, PAN, bank account or name.

## Running an ops command

In a deployed environment every ops command is a one-off ECS task on F1's ops task definition (D6): family
`sanchay-prod-ops` (its current revision is the stack output `OpsTaskDefinitionArn`), container `ops`, which
already sets `SANCHAY_APP_ROLE=ops` and logs in as `sanchay_app_login` with the session role pinned to
`sanchay_app`. Never use the migrate task definition `sanchay-prod-migrate`, which logs in as the master. Each
runbook gives the `command` array for its step; everything else is the one form below, copied from
[ops CLIs](ops-cli.md), "Running a command in a deployed environment (the one form)" (if the two ever differ,
`ops-cli.md` wins). Every line runs unchanged in PowerShell 5.1 and Git Bash unless it says otherwise.

1. Read the stack outputs once (`AppSubnetIds`, `ServiceSecurityGroupId`):

```
aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name SanchayMvpStack-prod --query "Stacks[0].Outputs" --output table
```

2. Write `ops-overrides.json` outside the repo, in an editor, saved as UTF-8 (PowerShell 5.1's `>` writes
   UTF-16, which `file://` cannot read). Override only `command`, with the runbook's array, one element per
   flag and per value (a value with spaces stays one element):

```json
{"containerOverrides": [{"name": "ops", "command": ["node", "dist/main.js", "ops:sync", "--order", "<order-id>", "--by", "<handle>"]}]}
```

3. Run it (it prints the task ARN):

```
aws ecs run-task --cluster sanchay-prod --launch-type FARGATE --task-definition sanchay-prod-ops --network-configuration "awsvpcConfiguration={subnets=[<AppSubnetIds>],securityGroups=[<ServiceSecurityGroupId>],assignPublicIp=DISABLED}" --overrides file://ops-overrides.json --query "tasks[0].taskArn" --output text
```

4. Wait for it and read the exit code (0 done, 1 refused with nothing written, 2 usage):

```
aws ecs wait tasks-stopped --cluster sanchay-prod --tasks <task-arn>
aws ecs describe-tasks --cluster sanchay-prod --tasks <task-arn> --query "tasks[0].containers[0].exitCode" --output text
```

5. Read the result line from the stream `prod/ops/<task-id>` (the task id is the last part of the task ARN).
   PowerShell:

```
aws logs get-log-events --log-group-name /sanchay/prod/app --log-stream-name prod/ops/<task-id> --query "events[].message" --output text
```

   Git Bash (`MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1` stops Git Bash rewriting the log group into a Windows path):

```
MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 aws logs get-log-events --log-group-name /sanchay/prod/app --log-stream-name prod/ops/<task-id> --query "events[].message" --output text
```

6. Delete `ops-overrides.json`. No `command` ever holds a mobile number: `ops:invite` reads its list from an
   SSM SecureString (`--mobiles-param /sanchay/prod/invites/<name>`, one mobile per line; FR-20/FR-21). Follow
   [ops CLIs](ops-cli.md), "Inviting pilot investors": put the parameter just before the run, then, whatever
   the exit code, delete it and check that nothing is left under the prefix (the second line prints nothing).
   PowerShell:

```
aws ssm delete-parameter --name /sanchay/prod/invites/<name>
aws ssm describe-parameters --parameter-filters "Key=Name,Option=BeginsWith,Values=/sanchay/prod/invites/" --query "Parameters[].Name" --output text
```

   Git Bash:

```
MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 aws ssm delete-parameter --name /sanchay/prod/invites/<name>
MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 aws ssm describe-parameters --parameter-filters "Key=Name,Option=BeginsWith,Values=/sanchay/prod/invites/" --query "Parameters[].Name" --output text
```

On a local stack the same command is `pnpm ops:<command> <flags>` from the repo root, against the database in
`apps/api/.env`: the script builds the api and runs `node dist/cli/ops.js`, which forces `SANCHAY_APP_ROLE=ops`
(same line in both shells).
````
